intro.en: Alsace is a vineyard corridor east of the Vosges; grape, site and sweetness are separate dimensions.
intro.zh: Alsace 为 Vosges 东侧葡萄园带；品种、地块、甜度须分别理解。

body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: Alsace is a vineyard corridor east of the Vosges; grape, site and sweetness are separate dimensions.
body.zh: Alsace 为 Vosges 东侧葡萄园带；品种、地块、甜度须分别理解。

body.en: Alsace AOC was recognised in 1962, followed by separate Grand Cru developments.
body.zh: Alsace AOC 于 1962 年认可，后续另有 Grand Cru 发展。

body.en: Vineyards extend from the Strasbourg area toward Thann, between the Vosges and Rhine plain.
body.zh: 葡萄园从 Strasbourg 一带向 Thann 延伸，介于 Vosges 与莱茵平原。

body.en: The Vosges shelter the eastern slopes, favouring relatively dry conditions; exposure alters ripening.
body.zh: Vosges 遮蔽东侧坡地，形成相对干燥条件；坡向改变成熟。

body.en: Granite, sandstone, limestone, marl, schist and volcanic formations create strong site contrasts.
body.zh: 花岗岩、砂岩、石灰岩、泥灰岩、片岩与火山岩形成显著地块差异。

body.en: Jurassic and Oligocene marl-limestone retain moisture; the slopes face east and south.
body.zh: 侏罗纪、渐新世泥灰岩石灰岩保水，坡向东及南。

body.en: Riesling, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Gris and Muscat are central aromatic references.
body.zh: Riesling、Gewürztraminer、Pinot Gris、Muscat 为核心芳香参照。

body.en: They are distinct varieties; regional blends and labelling may involve both.
body.zh: 两者是不同品种；地方调配与酒标可能涉及两者。

body.en: Pinot Noir supplies red and rosé wines, including authorised red Grand Cru sites.
body.zh: Pinot Noir 生产红、桃红，也用于获准红 Grand Cru 地块。

body.en: Still whites range from dry to sweet; varietal aroma cannot establish residual sugar.
body.zh: 静止白酒从干到甜；品种香气不能确定残糖。

body.en: A regulated late-harvest mention, not a grape name.
body.zh: 受监管晚采标示，不是葡萄名。

body.en: Selected concentrated berries affected by noble rot are central to SGN.
body.zh: 挑选受贵腐影响的浓缩果粒是 SGN 核心。

body.en: Crémant d’Alsace is a separate bottle-fermented sparkling appellation.
body.zh: Crémant d’Alsace 为独立瓶中发酵起泡产区。

body.en: There are 51 named Grand Cru sites with individual specifications; exceptions prevent one universal grape rule.
body.zh: 51 个具名 Grand Cru 各有规范；存在例外，不能用统一品种规则概括。

body.en: Certain communal and lieu-dit indications have tighter conditions without automatically becoming Grand Cru.
body.zh: 某些市镇、地块标示有更严条件，但不自动成为 Grand Cru。

body.en: Mittelbergheim's Zotzenberg permits Sylvaner Grand Cru; this is a site-specific exception.
body.zh: Mittelbergheim 的 Zotzenberg 可用 Sylvaner 酿 Grand Cru，是地块特例。

body.en: Hengst, Kirchberg de Barr and Vorbourg permit Pinot Noir reds; Vorbourg's recognition was added in 2024.
body.zh: Hengst、Kirchberg de Barr、Vorbourg 允许 Pinot Noir 红酒；Vorbourg 认可于 2024 年加入。

body.en: Sylvaner Grand Cru Zotzenberg provides a bottle reference for the local exception.
body.zh: Sylvaner Grand Cru Zotzenberg 为地块例外提供酒款实例。

body.en: Réserve examples include Pinot Gris and Gewurztraminer; record the specific wine's sweetness and composition.
body.zh: Réserve 实例有 Pinot Gris、Gewurztraminer；应记录具体酒款甜度及组成。

body.en: Crémant d’Alsace Rosé uses Pinot Noir from around Ribeauvillé and is a dry sparkling reference.
body.zh: Crémant d’Alsace Rosé 用 Ribeauvillé 周边 Pinot Noir，为干型起泡参照。

body.en: Check sweetness before choosing food pairings.
body.zh: 配餐前核对甜度。

body.en: The local vineyard tradition survives within a strongly urbanised coastal setting.

body.en: Terraced vineyard slopes overlook the Nice area.

body.en: Sea and mountain air moderate Mediterranean conditions.

body.en: Neighbouring southwestern appellations with Bordeaux-family grapes and independent identities.
body.zh: 西南相邻产区，使用 Bordeaux 系品种但身份独立。

body.en: Dordogne trade and established local vineyards shaped wine production outside Bordeaux.
body.zh: Dordogne 贸易与地方葡萄园塑造 Bordeaux 之外的生产。

body.en: Bergerac follows the Dordogne; Duras lies southwest in Lot-et-Garonne.
body.zh: Bergerac 沿 Dordogne，Duras 在西南 Lot-et-Garonne。

body.en: Oceanic influence and autumn river humidity can favour noble rot in suitable years.
body.zh: 海洋影响及秋季河流湿度在合适年份有利贵腐。

body.en: Clay-limestone slopes contrast with gravel and alluvial sectors.
body.zh: 黏土石灰质坡地与砾石、冲积片区对照。

body.en: Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon dominate reds; Sémillon, Sauvignon and Muscadelle are white references.
body.zh: Merlot、Cabernet Franc、Cabernet Sauvignon 为红主轴；Sémillon、Sauvignon、Muscadelle 为白参照。

intro.en: An Atlantic wine region of separate appellations, red blends, dry whites, sweet wines and multiple estate-classification systems.
intro.zh: 大西洋葡萄酒区，含独立产区、红调配、干白、甜酒及多种酒庄分级。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: An Atlantic wine region of separate appellations, red blends, dry whites, sweet wines and multiple estate-classification systems.
body.zh: 大西洋葡萄酒区，含独立产区、红调配、干白、甜酒及多种酒庄分级。

body.en: The Paris Universal Exhibition under Napoleon III prompted the famous 1855 classification.
body.zh: Napoléon III 时期巴黎世博会促成著名 1855 分级。

body.en: Garonne and Dordogne join in the Gironde estuary; left- and right-bank identities depend on this geography.
body.zh: Garonne、Dordogne 汇成 Gironde 河口；左右岸身份取决于此地理。

body.en: Saint-Estèphe, Pauillac, Saint-Julien and Margaux lie along the Médoc bank; Moulis and Listrac lie farther inland.
body.zh: Saint-Estèphe、Pauillac、Saint-Julien、Margaux 位于 Médoc 河侧；Moulis、Listrac 更内陆。

body.en: Oceanic moderation and rainfall make ripening and disease management vintage-dependent.
body.zh: 海洋调节与降雨使成熟、病害管理依年份而变。

body.en: Médoc gravel terraces are important, but not universal across the left bank.
body.zh: Médoc 砾石河阶重要，但并非整个左岸通用。

body.en: Saint-Estèphe, Moulis and Listrac include clay-limestone terrain, complicating simple bank stereotypes.
body.zh: Saint-Estèphe、Moulis、Listrac 含黏土石灰质，不能只靠左右岸刻板概括。

body.en: Cabernet Sauvignon is central in Médoc; Merlot and Cabernet Franc are especially important in right-bank blends.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 对 Médoc 重要；Merlot、Cabernet Franc 对右岸调配尤其重要。

body.en: Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Muscadelle underpin major white-wine styles.
body.zh: Sauvignon Blanc、Sémillon、Muscadelle 构成主要白酒风格基础。

body.en: Dry white and noble-rot sweet-wine production pursue different harvest and fermentation outcomes.
body.zh: 干白与贵腐甜酒追求不同采收及发酵结果。

body.en: Médoc estates plus Château Haut-Brion in Graves form the red classification.
body.zh: Médoc 酒庄加 Graves 的 Château Haut-Brion 构成红酒名单。

body.en: The red classification has five ranks, from first to fifth growth; estates are ranked, not Burgundy-style Climats.
body.zh: 红酒由一级至五级，分级对象为酒庄，而非 Bourgogne 式 Climats。

body.en: Sauternes and Barsac have a separate 1855 sweet-white classification.
body.zh: Sauternes、Barsac 有独立 1855 甜白分级。

body.en: Graves has its own classification separate from the 1855 system.
body.zh: Graves 有独立于 1855 的自身分级。

body.en: Its estate classification is periodically revised; Saint-Émilion Grand Cru AOC alone does not mean Grand Cru Classé.
body.zh: 酒庄分级定期修订；Saint-Émilion Grand Cru AOC 本身不等于 Grand Cru Classé。

body.en: A separate Médoc classification for red wines; it is not a subset of the 1855 list.
body.zh: Médoc 红酒另一分级，不是 1855 名单子集。

body.en: A distinct Médoc classification associated with smaller craft-oriented estates; not a grape or a synonym for Cru Bourgeois.
body.zh: 与较小手工经营酒庄相关的 Médoc 独立分级；不是品种，也不是 Cru Bourgeois 同义词。

body.en: Appellation describes protected origin; classification describes a separate historical estate-ranking context.
body.zh: 法定产区描述受保护产地；分级是另一历史酒庄等级体系。

body.en: Located in Pauillac and a first growth in the 1855 classification.
body.zh: 位于 Pauillac，为 1855 一级庄。

body.en: The Graves exception in the red 1855 classification illustrates why geography and ranking must both be retained.
body.zh: 1855 红酒分级的 Graves 例外，说明须同时保留地理与等级。

body.en: Use the actual bottle, vintage and maturation when planning decanting.
body.zh: 按具体酒款、年份及成熟状态安排醒酒。

body.en: A hierarchy of regional, village and vineyard names connects grape varieties to specific sites.
body.zh: 大区、村庄及葡萄园名称层级，将品种与特定地块相连。

body.en: Monastic organisation and later appellation delimitation shaped the historical Climats.
body.zh: 修道院组织及后续法定划界塑造历史 Climats。

body.en: Chablis and Grand Auxerrois are separate study areas north of the Côte d’Or.
body.zh: Chablis 与 Grand Auxerrois 为 Côte d’Or 以北独立学习片区。

body.en: Côte de Nuits and Côte de Beaune form the central Côte d’Or sequence.
body.zh: Côte de Nuits、Côte de Beaune 构成 Côte d’Or 主轴。

body.en: Côte Chalonnaise leads south toward Mâconnais.
body.zh: Côte Chalonnaise 向南连接 Mâconnais。

body.en: The Chablis Grand Cru hillside lies on the Serein's right bank northeast of town.
body.zh: Chablis Grand Cru 山坡位于 Serein 右岸、镇东北方。

body.en: Spring frost is important, especially in the north; southern influences increase toward Mâconnais.
body.zh: 春霜尤其影响北部；向 Mâconnais 南方影响加强。

body.en: Jurassic limestones and marls, clay content and slope deposits differ between sites.
body.zh: 侏罗纪石灰岩、泥灰岩、黏土含量及坡积物因地块而变。

body.en: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay dominate; Aligoté adds a distinct white-wine identity.
body.zh: Pinot Noir、Chardonnay 为主；Aligoté 增加独立白酒身份。

body.en: Whole-bunch use, extraction, lees and oak vary by producer; they are not fixed by the word Bourgogne.
body.zh: 整串、萃取、酒泥、用桶因酒庄而变，并非 Bourgogne 一词即可确定。

body.en: Regional, village, village Premier Cru and Grand Cru form the familiar hierarchy.
body.zh: 大区、村庄、村庄 Premier Cru、Grand Cru 为常用层级。

body.en: A named, delimited vineyard identity incorporating place and human history; not meteorological climate.
body.zh: 具名划定葡萄园身份，包含地理及人文历史；不是气象气候。

body.en: A vineyard designation within a village appellation, not a region-wide producer ranking.
body.zh: 村庄产区内葡萄园标示，不是全区酒庄排名。

body.en: Petit Chablis, Chablis, Chablis Premier Cru and Chablis Grand Cru are distinct label levels.
body.zh: Petit Chablis、Chablis、Chablis Premier Cru、Chablis Grand Cru 为不同酒标层级。

body.en: One Chablis Grand Cru AOC contains Blanchot, Bougros, Les Clos, Grenouilles, Les Preuses, Valmur and Vaudésir.
body.zh: 一个 Chablis Grand Cru AOC 含 Blanchot、Bougros、Les Clos、Grenouilles、Les Preuses、Valmur、Vaudésir。

body.en: A regional Aligoté appellation recognised in 1937.
body.zh: 1937 年认可的大区 Aligoté 产区。

body.en: The village Aligoté identity is separate from regional Bourgogne Aligoté.
body.zh: 村庄 Aligoté 身份独立于大区 Bourgogne Aligoté。

body.en: Bouzeron supplies a direct village Aligoté reference.
body.zh: Bouzeron 为村庄 Aligoté 的直接实例。

body.en: Beaune Clos des Mouches Premier Cru Rouge is a named Pinot Noir reference, distinct from the estate's white of the same Climat.
body.zh: Beaune Clos des Mouches Premier Cru Rouge 为具名 Pinot Noir 实例，与同地块白酒分开。

body.en: Morey-Saint-Denis Premier Cru Clos des Monts Luisants is an Aligoté wine: village reputation alone cannot identify the grape.
body.zh: Morey-Saint-Denis Premier Cru Clos des Monts Luisants 为 Aligoté；不能仅由村庄声誉推断品种。

body.en: Compare neighbouring sites with a fixed producer and vintage.
body.zh: 固定酒庄与年份比较相邻地块。

body.en: Regional Bourgogne white appellation dedicated to Aligoté.
body.zh: 专门对应 Aligoté 的 Bourgogne 大区白酒产区。

body.en: Aligoté is documented in Burgundy from the seventeenth century; the AOC was recognised in 1937.
body.zh: Aligoté 在 Burgundy 文献可追至十七世纪；AOC 于 1937 年认可。

body.en: The regional appellation spans eligible Bourgogne vineyard territory rather than one village.
body.zh: 大区产区跨合格 Bourgogne 葡萄园地域，不是单一村庄。

body.en: Semi-continental conditions and site exposure affect ripening and acidity.
body.zh: 半大陆性条件、地块朝向影响成熟酸度。

body.en: Limestone, marl and clay proportions vary among sites.
body.zh: 石灰岩、泥灰岩、黏土比例随地块。

body.en: Aligoté is the sole grape; Aligoté doré and vert terminology does not establish separate canonical varieties.
body.zh: Aligoté 为单一品种；doré、vert 术语不构成独立标准品种。

body.en: Usually dry and high in acidity; stainless steel, lees work and oak vary by producer.
body.zh: 通常干、高酸；不锈钢、酒泥处理、橡木依酒庄。

body.en: Bourgogne Aligoté is regional; Bouzeron is a separate village AOC and must not be collapsed into it.
body.zh: Bourgogne Aligoté 为大区，Bouzeron 为独立村庄 AOC，不能合并。

body.en: Regional Aligoté bottling; vintage and élevage are producer-specific.

body.en: Mountain influence meets the warmer Rhône corridor; slope exposure matters.
body.zh: 山地影响与较暖 Rhône 走廊相遇，坡向重要。

body.en: Limestone, marl, slope scree and glacial deposits vary locally.
body.zh: 石灰岩、泥灰岩、崩积物、冰川沉积随地变化。

body.en: Chardonnay, Altesse, Gamay, Pinot Noir, Mondeuse and Poulsard have distinct roles.

body.en: Malbec is central; Merlot and Tannat may complement it.

intro.en: A group of inland Loire appellations, particularly known for Sauvignon Blanc, with important red and other white identities.
intro.zh: Loire 内陆产区群，以 Sauvignon Blanc 突出，也有重要红酒及其他白酒。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: A group of inland Loire appellations, particularly known for Sauvignon Blanc, with important red and other white identities.
body.zh: Loire 内陆产区群，以 Sauvignon Blanc 突出，也有重要红酒及其他白酒。

body.en: Independent appellation histories developed around river crossings and local trade.
body.zh: 独立产区史围绕河流渡口、地方贸易发展。

body.en: Sancerre and Pouilly face one another across the Loire; Quincy and Reuilly lie farther west.
body.zh: Sancerre、Pouilly 隔 Loire 相望，Quincy、Reuilly 更西。

body.en: Temperate continental conditions bring frost risk and variable ripening.
body.zh: 温和大陆性条件带来霜冻及成熟波动。

body.en: Terres blanches are marl-rich clay-limestone; caillottes are stony limestone; flint clay and Quincy's sand/gravel terraces differ.
body.zh: Terres blanches 为富泥灰岩黏土石灰质，caillottes 为多石石灰质；燧石黏土、Quincy 砂砾河阶不同。

body.en: Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir are central; Chasselas and Pinot Gris have specific local roles.
body.zh: Sauvignon Blanc、Pinot Noir 为核心，Chasselas、Pinot Gris 各有地方角色。

body.en: Leading white variety.
body.zh: 最主要白品种。

body.en: Leading red variety; several distinct appellation uses.
body.zh: 主要红品种，各法定产区使用不同。

body.en: Coteaux du Giennois and Châteaumeillant blends.
body.zh: Coteaux du Giennois 与 Châteaumeillant 混酿。

body.en: Rosé use in Reuilly and Châteaumeillant.
body.zh: 用于 Reuilly 与 Châteaumeillant 桃红。

body.en: Sancerre includes white, red and rosé; Pouilly-Fumé is a Sauvignon white identity.
body.zh: Sancerre 有白、红、桃红，Pouilly-Fumé 为 Sauvignon 白酒身份。

body.en: Pouilly-Fumé and Pouilly-sur-Loire are distinct; the latter is associated with Chasselas.
body.zh: Pouilly-Fumé 与 Pouilly-sur-Loire 不同，后者关联 Chasselas。

role.zh: 最主要白品种。

role.en: Leading red variety; several distinct appellation uses.

role.en: IGP Coteaux de Tannay, not Pouilly-Fumé.
role.zh: 用于 IGP Coteaux de Tannay，并非 Pouilly-Fumé。

intro.en: Northeastern French sparkling-wine appellation based on cool-climate grapes, blending and bottle fermentation; neighbouring still-wine AOCs are separate.
intro.zh: 法国东北部起泡酒产区，以凉爽气候葡萄、调配和瓶中发酵为核心；相邻静止酒 AOC 另列。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Appellation
body.zh: 法定产区

body.en: Northeastern French sparkling-wine appellation based on cool-climate grapes, blending and bottle fermentation; neighbouring still-wine AOCs are separate.
body.zh: 法国东北部起泡酒产区，以凉爽气候葡萄、调配和瓶中发酵为核心；相邻静止酒 AOC 另列。

body.en: The 1927 law established the delimited vineyard area; AOC recognition followed in 1936.
body.zh: 1927 年法律界定葡萄园范围，1936 年获 AOC。

body.en: Montagne de Reims, Vallée de la Marne, Côte des Blancs and Côte des Bar provide the main geographical reference points.
body.zh: Montagne de Reims、Vallée de la Marne、Côte des Blancs、Côte des Bar 是主要地理参照。

body.en: Oceanic and continental influences combine; spring frost, rainfall and slow ripening affect viticulture.
body.zh: 海洋性与大陆性结合；春霜、降雨、缓慢成熟影响栽培。

body.en: Chalk is important alongside limestone, marl, clay and sand; Côte des Bar is not geologically identical to Côte des Blancs.
body.zh: 除白垩外，还有石灰岩、泥灰岩、黏土、砂；Côte des Bar 地质不等于 Côte des Blancs。

body.en: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier dominate; minority grapes require separate identification.
body.zh: Chardonnay、Pinot Noir、Meunier 为主，少量品种须另作识别。

body.en: Arbane, Petit Meslier, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris retain authorised minority roles.
body.zh: Arbane、Petit Meslier、Pinot Blanc、Pinot Gris 保留获准的少量角色。

body.en: Recognised as a principal authorised variety in July 2025; this legal category does not imply large plantings.
body.zh: 2025 年 7 月获认可为法定主要品种；法律类别不表示种植面积很大。

body.en: The Comité Champagne’s September 2026 account describes a VIFA convention, at most 5% of the holding’s planted area (excluding untreated zones) and at most 10% in a blend; monitoring and sample provision are required.
body.zh: Comité Champagne 2026 年 9 月资料说明：VIFA 协议下，最多占酒庄种植面积 5%（不含不处理区域），最多占调配 10%；要求技术跟踪及样品提供。

body.en: A 4,000 kg marc corresponds to 2,550 L of permitted must: 2,050 L cuvée and 500 L taille.
body.zh: 每 4,000 kg 一批葡萄对应 2,550 L 许可汁液：2,050 L cuvée、500 L taille。

body.en: These are successive press fractions, not finished-wine quality ranks. Keeping them separate creates blending options.
body.zh: 这是连续压榨分段，不是成酒质量分级；分开保存提供调配选择。

body.en: Base-wine lots are assembled before tirage; grape, site and reserve-wine choices influence the final style.
body.zh: 基酒在 tirage 前调配；品种、地块、储备酒选择影响成酒风格。

body.en: Bottling with the fermentation preparation starts the bottle-fermentation stage and maturation clock.
body.zh: 装瓶加入发酵准备物，启动瓶中发酵阶段及陈年计时。

body.en: At least 15 months before release, including at least 12 months on lees.
body.zh: 上市前至少 15 个月，其中至少 12 个月接触酒泥。

body.en: Vintage Champagne requires at least three years; many producers mature wines longer.
body.zh: 年份 Champagne 至少三年；许多生产者延长陈年。

body.en: Yeast autolysis contributes texture and mature aromas during lees ageing.
body.zh: 酵母自溶在酒泥陈年中贡献质感与成熟香气。

body.en: Slow oxygen exchange also participates in maturation; lees time alone does not reveal dosage.
body.zh: 缓慢氧交换也参与成熟；酒泥时间本身不能说明补糖量。

body.en: A separate still-wine appellation, not an unsparkling version within Champagne AOC.
body.zh: 独立静止酒产区，不是 Champagne AOC 内的无气泡版本。

body.en: A distinct still-rosé appellation whose geographical and production identity must be retained.
body.zh: 独立静止桃红产区，须保留其地理与生产身份。

body.en: The estate's technical account provides a concrete reference for cuvée and taille press fractions.
body.zh: 酒庄技术资料为 cuvée 与 taille 提供具体生产实例。

body.en: Its ageing account separates legal minima from the longer maturation selected by a house.
body.zh: 其陈年资料区分法定最低要求与酒庄自选的更长陈年。

body.en: Compare dosage, reserve wines and lees age independently.
body.zh: 分别比较补糖、储备酒与酒泥陈年。

role.zh: Champagne 三大主要种植品种之一。

role.zh: 2025 年 7 月列为法定主要品种，种植仍极少。

role.zh: Champagne 的 VIFA 试验品种，与传统欧亚种另列。

role.zh: 仅指 Aube 原产背景，不表示 Champagne 许可。

body.en: Six Cognac crus are Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne, Borderies, Fins Bois, Bons Bois and Bois Ordinaires.
body.zh: Cognac 六 crus：Grande Champagne、Petite Champagne、Borderies、Fins Bois、Bons Bois、Bois Ordinaires。

body.en: Atlantic moderation supports relatively acidic grapes for distillation wine.
body.zh: 大西洋调节有利较高酸度的蒸馏基酒葡萄。

body.en: Chalky Champagne terrains contrast with Borderies and outer-cru soil mosaics.

body.en: Ugni Blanc dominates, with Folle Blanche, Colombard, Montils, Sémillon and Folignan among authorised references.
body.zh: Ugni Blanc 为主，另有 Folle Blanche、Colombard、Montils、Sémillon、Folignan 等获准参照。

intro.en: A mountainous Mediterranean island with distinct coastal, inland and local-variety identities.
intro.zh: 多山地中海岛屿，海岸、内陆及地方品种身份各异。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: A mountainous Mediterranean island with distinct coastal, inland and local-variety identities.
body.zh: 多山地中海岛屿，海岸、内陆及地方品种身份各异。

body.en: Patrimonio recognition dates to 1968 and Ajaccio to 1984; local viticultural history is much older.
body.zh: Patrimonio 于 1968 年、Ajaccio 于 1984 年认可，地方栽培史更早。

body.en: The estate traces native-variety work to the 1960s and its first Collection wines to 2006.
body.zh: 酒庄将本地品种工作追至 1960 年代，首批 Collection 酒为 2006 年。

body.en: Altitude, slope aspect and maritime exposure separate vineyard settings around the island.
body.zh: 海拔、坡向、面海程度使全岛葡萄园环境不同。

body.en: Barbaggio, Farinole, Oletta, Patrimonio, Poggio-d’Oletta, Saint-Florent and Santo-Pietro-di-Tenda.
body.zh: Barbaggio、Farinole、Oletta、Patrimonio、Poggio-d’Oletta、Saint-Florent、Santo-Pietro-di-Tenda。

body.en: The Gulf of Saint-Florent provides the northern geographical reference.
body.zh: Saint-Florent 湾为北部地理参照。

body.en: Summer dryness is modified by mountains, winds and coastal exposure.
body.zh: 夏季干燥受山地、风与海岸暴露调节。

body.en: Western Ajaccio has a granite-based setting.
body.zh: 西部 Ajaccio 以花岗岩环境为重点。

body.en: Limestone-rich northern Patrimonio contrasts with western granitic areas.
body.zh: 北部 Patrimonio 富石灰质，与西部花岗岩区对照。

body.en: A key Patrimonio red identity; retain the canonical variety link rather than duplicating local spelling.
body.zh: Patrimonio 关键红品种身份；保留标准品种链接，不因地方拼写重复建种。

body.en: Central to Ajaccio's red-wine identity.
body.zh: Ajaccio 红酒身份核心。

body.en: A central island white reference, with regional spelling linked to the canonical variety.
body.zh: 岛屿核心白品种参照；地方拼写连接标准品种。

body.en: Abbatucci cultivates numerous native varieties, documenting conservation and actual wine use.
body.zh: Abbatucci 栽培多种本地品种，记录保育与实际酿酒使用。

body.en: Ajaccio, Patrimonio, Corse and Muscat du Cap Corse have distinct protected identities.
body.zh: Ajaccio、Patrimonio、Corse、Muscat du Cap Corse 各有受保护身份。

body.en: Calvi, Coteaux du Cap Corse, Figari, Porto-Vecchio and Sartène are geographical additions in the Corse framework.
body.zh: Calvi、Coteaux du Cap Corse、Figari、Porto-Vecchio、Sartène 为 Corse 体系内附加地理名。

body.en: Some regional summaries count those additions as appellations; this does not make all nine independent PDOs.
body.zh: 部分概述将附加名计作产区，不表示九项全为独立 PDO。

body.en: Estate cultivation alone does not prove Ajaccio AOC authorisation for every rare variety.

intro.en: Jura combines local grapes, topped-up whites and sous-voile styles; wider Franche-Comté heritage extends beyond these AOCs.
intro.zh: Jura 结合地方品种、添桶白酒与酒膜风格；更广 Franche-Comté 传统不限于这些 AOC。

body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region

body.en: Jura combines local grapes, topped-up whites and sous-voile styles; wider Franche-Comté heritage extends beyond these AOCs.
body.zh: Jura 结合地方品种、添桶白酒与酒膜风格；更广 Franche-Comté 传统不限于这些 AOC。

body.en: AOC recognition in 1936 places Arbois among the earliest French wine appellations.
body.zh: 1936 年认可使 Arbois 成为法国最早一批葡萄酒 AOC。

body.en: Vineyards cluster around Arbois, Poligny and Lons-le-Saunier on the western Jura foothills.
body.zh: 葡萄园聚集于 Jura 西侧山麓 Arbois、Poligny、Lons-le-Saunier 周边。

body.en: Cold winters, warm summers and significant rainfall shape the vineyard cycle.
body.zh: 寒冬、温暖夏季及较多降雨塑造生长周期。

body.en: Blue and grey marls and limestone provide key geological references.
body.zh: 蓝、灰泥灰岩及石灰岩为主要地质参照。

body.en: Chardonnay and Savagnin are the principal white references.
body.zh: Chardonnay、Savagnin 为主要白品种参照。

body.en: Poulsard, Trousseau and Pinot Noir form the core red-grape set.
body.zh: Poulsard、Trousseau、Pinot Noir 构成红品种核心。

body.en: Topping up limits headspace and oxygen exposure; Savagnin can be made ouillé without becoming vin jaune.
body.zh: 添桶减少顶部空间与氧接触；Savagnin 可以添桶酿造，并不成为 vin jaune。

body.en: A surface yeast veil produces biological ageing distinct from simple air oxidation.
body.zh: 表面酵母膜形成生物陈年，与简单空气氧化不同。

body.en: Vin jaune is made from Savagnin.
body.zh: Vin jaune 用 Savagnin。

body.en: The reference duration is six years and three months from harvest, including long ageing without topping up under voile.
body.zh: 参照期限为采收后六年三个月，其中长时间不添桶、酒膜下陈年。

body.en: The traditional bottle holds 62 cl; this does not establish a fixed evaporation percentage.
body.zh: 传统酒瓶容量 62 cl；不能据此断言固定蒸发比例。

body.en: Harvested grapes are dried to concentrate must; this is not the same process as fortification or voile ageing.
body.zh: 采收后葡萄干燥浓缩汁液；与强化、酒膜陈年不同。

body.en: A mistelle combining grape must and grape spirit; not a Savagnin synonym.
body.zh: 葡萄汁与葡萄烈酒组成的 mistelle；不是 Savagnin 同义名。

body.en: Distilled grape-pomace spirit, distinct from Macvin and vin jaune.
body.zh: 葡萄渣蒸馏酒，与 Macvin、vin jaune 不同。

label.zh: 四个 vin jaune 产地

body.en: Arbois, Côtes du Jura, L’Étoile and Château-Chalon are the geographical vin jaune references.
body.zh: Arbois、Côtes du Jura、L’Étoile、Château-Chalon 为 vin jaune 地理参照。

body.en: An individual appellation, not a synonym for all Jura vin jaune.
body.zh: 独立产区，不是全部 Jura vin jaune 的同义名。

body.en: Pupillin is a geographical designation associated with Arbois, not an additional grape.
body.zh: Pupillin 为 Arbois 相关地理标示，不是另一品种。

body.en: Côtes du Jura Vin Jaune provides a specific Savagnin and 62 cl clavelin reference.
body.zh: Côtes du Jura Vin Jaune 为 Savagnin 与 62 cl clavelin 的具体实例。

body.en: The Arbois estate works across Arbois, Arbois-Pupillin, Château-Chalon, Crémant and Macvin identities.
body.zh: Arbois 酒庄涉及 Arbois、Arbois-Pupillin、Château-Chalon、Crémant、Macvin。

body.en: Compare ouillé and sous-voile Savagnin before generalising about Jura oxidation.
body.zh: 先比较添桶及酒膜 Savagnin，再讨论 Jura 氧化风格。

body.en: Geographical wine region

body.en: A Mediterranean wine region containing many AOCs and IGPs; broad regional geography differs from Languedoc AOC.
body.zh: 地中海酒区，含多个 AOC、IGP；广义地区与 Languedoc AOC 不同。

body.en: Languedoc AOC replaced Coteaux du Languedoc in 2007; historical labels retain historical names.
body.zh: Languedoc AOC 于 2007 年替代 Coteaux du Languedoc；历史酒标保留当时名称。

body.en: Coastal plains, inland hills and the Cévennes foothills create strongly contrasting sites.
body.zh: 海岸平原、内陆丘陵、Cévennes 山麓形成明显不同地块。

body.en: North of Montpellier near the Cévennes foothills; distinct from hotter coastal plains.
body.zh: Montpellier 以北、Cévennes 山麓附近，与更热海岸平原不同。

body.en: Summer dryness and sunshine are moderated by elevation, exposure and distance from the sea.
body.zh: 夏季干旱与日照受海拔、坡向、距海远近调节。

body.en: Limestone, clay, schist, sandstone and alluvial materials vary by appellation and site.
body.zh: 石灰岩、黏土、片岩、砂岩、冲积物依产区地块而变。

body.en: The limestone massif is a clear local geographical and geological anchor.
body.zh: 石灰岩山体是明确地方地理、地质定位。

body.zh: 大区 Languedoc AOC 摘要列 Grenache、Syrah、Mourvèdre 为主要参照。

body.zh: Carignan、Cinsaut 及地方白品种扩展地区面貌，许可依 AOC 不同。

body.en: Experimental or conservation planting does not establish appellation authorisation.
body.zh: 试验或保育种植不等于法定产区许可。

body.en: The syndicate describes multivariety Languedoc AOC wines; this is not a universal recipe for every nearby appellation.
body.zh: 工会说明 Languedoc AOC 为多品种酒；不是每个邻近产区通用配方。

body.en: Corbières, Minervois, Saint-Chinian, Faugères, La Clape and Terrasses du Larzac require separate dossiers.
body.zh: Corbières、Minervois、Saint-Chinian、Faugères、La Clape、Terrasses du Larzac 须独立档案。

body.zh: 2017 年获独立 AOC 认可。

body.zh: 独立受保护产区，应保留完整地理名，不是全部 Piquepoul 酒的泛称。

body.en: Limoux's still and sparkling appellation identities must be distinguished rather than grouped as one wine style.
body.zh: Limoux 静止及起泡产区身份须分开，不能归为一种风格。

body.en: A broad IGP with extensive varietal labelling; not a synonym for Languedoc AOC.
body.zh: 广域 IGP，广泛使用品种标示，不是 Languedoc AOC 同义名。

body.en: A rare-grape bottling's actual IGP, AOC or Vin de France category must be read from its own producer information.

intro.zh: 沿 Loire 与支流由西向东的一系列独立酒区，不是单一法定产区。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region

body.en: A west–east sequence of independent wine regions along the Loire and its tributaries, not one appellation.
body.zh: 沿 Loire 与支流由西向东的一系列独立酒区，不是单一法定产区。

body.en: River trade and monastic vineyards helped establish distinct local wine economies.
body.zh: 河运与修道院葡萄园帮助形成不同地方酒业。

body.en: Nantais → Anjou-Saumur → Touraine → Centre-Loire.
body.zh: Nantais→Anjou-Saumur→Touraine→Centre-Loire。

body.en: Oceanic influence dominates westward; continental influence increases inland to the east.
body.zh: 西部海洋性明显，向东内陆大陆性加强。

body.en: Nantais crystalline rocks and Anjou schist differ from the chalky tuffeau of Saumur and Touraine.
body.zh: Nantais 结晶岩、Anjou 片岩，与 Saumur、Touraine 白垩质 tuffeau 不同。

body.en: Marly terres blanches, stony limestone caillottes and flint-rich clays are distinct geological families.
body.zh: 泥灰岩 terres blanches、多石石灰质 caillottes、富燧石黏土为不同类群。

body.en: Alluvial sand and gravel terraces contrast with the marl and flint of other Centre-Loire sites.
body.zh: 冲积砂砾河阶与其他 Centre-Loire 地块泥灰岩、燧石不同。

body.en: Le Haut-Lieu: deeper clay; Le Mont: flint-bearing soils; Clos du Bourg: limestone.
body.zh: Le Haut-Lieu：较深黏土；Le Mont：含燧石；Clos du Bourg：石灰岩。

body.en: Melon de Bourgogne, Chenin Blanc, Cabernet Franc and Sauvignon Blanc anchor different regional identities.
body.zh: Melon de Bourgogne、Chenin Blanc、Cabernet Franc、Sauvignon Blanc 对应不同区域身份。

body.en: Muscadet uses Melon de Bourgogne, not Muscat; Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine includes named communal crus.
body.zh: Muscadet 用 Melon de Bourgogne，不是 Muscat；Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine 有具名村庄 crus。

body.en: A key Anjou Chenin white-wine identity.
body.zh: Anjou 重要 Chenin 白酒身份。

body.en: Coteaux du Layon and related sweet-wine identities require separate study of concentration and protected names.
body.zh: Coteaux du Layon 及相关甜酒须另学浓缩方式、受保护名称。

body.en: Saumur-Champigny, Chinon, Bourgueil and Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil are distinct red-wine references.
body.zh: Saumur-Champigny、Chinon、Bourgueil、Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil 为不同红酒参照。

body.en: Separate Chenin appellations on opposite Loire banks near Tours; both include still and sparkling expressions.
body.zh: Tours 附近 Loire 两岸的独立 Chenin 产区，兼有静止、起泡。

body.en: Sauvignon Blanc reference points; Sancerre also makes Pinot Noir red and rosé.
body.zh: Sauvignon Blanc 核心；Sancerre 亦有 Pinot Noir 红、桃红。

body.en: The broad IGP is distinct from the many AOCs and descends from the earlier Jardin de la France designation.
body.zh: 广域 IGP 独立于各 AOC，源自早期 Jardin de la France 名称。

body.en: Crémant de Loire, Saumur and Vouvray have separate rules despite shared bottle-fermentation principles.
body.zh: Crémant de Loire、Saumur、Vouvray 虽同有瓶中发酵，规则各异。

body.en: Dry, sweet, still and sparkling wines coexist; no single Loire recipe covers them all.
body.zh: 干、甜、静止、起泡并存，没有统一 Loire 配方。

body.en: Founded in 1928 by Victor and Gaston Huet at Vouvray, with Chenin as its reference grape.
body.zh: 1928 年由 Victor、Gaston Huet 在 Vouvray 创立，以 Chenin 为核心。

body.en: Le Haut-Lieu, Le Mont and Clos du Bourg are the estate's principal site identities.
body.zh: Le Haut-Lieu、Le Mont、Clos du Bourg 为主要地块。

body.en: Compare dry and sweet Chenin while holding producer and site constant.
body.zh: 固定酒庄及地块比较干、甜 Chenin。

intro.en: Northeastern regional umbrella containing distinct Toul, Moselle and Meuse wine identities.

body.en: Northeastern regional umbrella containing distinct Toul, Moselle and Meuse wine identities.

body.en: Contraction through industrialisation, disease and war preceded modern revival; Côtes de Toul gained AOC in 1998.
body.zh: 工业化、病害、战争造成萎缩，后现代复兴；Côtes de Toul 1998 年获 AOC。

body.zh: Toul 在 Nancy 以西，Moselle 葡萄园更北，Meuse 另属 IGP。

body.en: Cool inland conditions favour sheltered slopes and careful frost management.
body.zh: 凉爽内陆条件使遮蔽坡地、避霜重要。

body.en: Sedimentary clay-limestone slopes are central in the Toul area.
body.zh: Toul 一带以沉积黏土石灰质坡为核心。

body.en: Gamay, Pinot Noir and Auxerrois are key Toul references; Moselle has different permissions.
body.zh: Gamay、Pinot Noir、Auxerrois 为 Toul 重点，Moselle 许可不同。

body.zh: Corsica 北部产区，关联 Niellucciu 与富石灰质地块。

body.en: AOC recognition dates to 1968.
body.zh: 1968 年获 AOC。

body.en: Around the Gulf of Saint-Florent, across seven specified communes.
body.zh: Saint-Florent 湾周边，跨七个规定市镇。

body.en: Mediterranean conditions combine maritime exposure, wind and hillside differences.
body.zh: 地中海条件结合面海、风、坡地差异。

body.en: Limestone and clay-rich terrain contrasts with western Corsican granite.
body.zh: 石灰岩及富黏土地形与 Corsica 西部花岗岩对照。

body.en: Niellucciu anchors reds and rosés; Vermentinu is the white reference.
body.zh: Niellucciu 为红、桃红核心；Vermentinu 为白参照。

body.en: Nielluccio: principal for red/rosé.
body.zh: Nielluccio：红酒／桃红主要品种。

body.en: Sole white grape; red/rosé accessory.

body.en: Grenache: red/rosé accessory.

body.en: Colour and extraction separate red, rosé and white identities.
body.zh: 酒色、萃取区分红、桃红、白身份。

body.en: Distinct from Muscat du Cap Corse even where production territories overlap.
body.zh: 即使生产地域重合，仍独立于 Muscat du Cap Corse。

body.en: The Mediterranean wine territory spans much of Languedoc-Roussillon.
body.zh: 地中海酒区范围跨 Languedoc-Roussillon 大部分地区。

body.en: Coastal and inland sites differ in heat, wind and elevation.
body.zh: 海岸、内陆地块在热量、风、海拔上不同。

body.en: A broad mosaic of limestone, clay, sand and other materials prevents one terroir prescription.
body.zh: 石灰岩、黏土、砂等广泛组合，不存在单一风土配方。

body.en: A wide authorised grape range includes international and local varieties.
body.zh: 广泛许可品种包含国际及地方品种。

intro.en: Mediterranean southeastern France, with several independent AOCs and red, white and rosé traditions.
intro.zh: 法国东南地中海区域，含多个独立 AOC 及红、白、桃红传统。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: Mediterranean southeastern France, with several independent AOCs and red, white and rosé traditions.
body.zh: 法国东南地中海区域，含多个独立 AOC 及红、白、桃红传统。

body.en: Côtes de Provence was recognised in 1977; other Provençal AOCs have their own histories.
body.zh: Côtes de Provence 于 1977 年认可；其他 AOC 各有历史。

body.en: Parts of Var, Bouches-du-Rhône and Alpes-Maritimes; not the whole Provence wine region.
body.zh: 涉及 Var、Bouches-du-Rhône、Alpes-Maritimes 部分地区，不等于整个 Provence 酒区。

body.en: Bandol, Le Beausset, La Cadière-d’Azur, Le Castellet, Évenos, Ollioules, Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer and Sanary-sur-Mer.
body.zh: Bandol、Le Beausset、La Cadière-d’Azur、Le Castellet、Évenos、Ollioules、Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer、Sanary-sur-Mer。

body.en: Bellet's hillsides are near Nice, unlike the more westerly Bandol vineyards.
body.zh: Bellet 坡地靠近 Nice，与更西侧 Bandol 不同。

body.en: Warm dry summers, wind and coastal or inland differences affect ripening and water balance.
body.zh: 温暖干燥夏季、风及海岸内陆差异影响成熟与水分。

body.en: Northern and western Côtes de Provence are predominantly limestone.
body.zh: Côtes de Provence 北、西侧主要为石灰岩。

body.en: Maures and Estérel in southern/eastern sectors provide crystalline-rock contrasts.
body.zh: 南、东侧 Maures、Estérel 提供结晶岩对照。

body.en: Bellet includes rounded pebbles cemented as conglomerate, often on terraced slopes.
body.zh: Bellet 含圆砾胶结砾岩，常见梯田坡地。

body.en: Sainte-Victoire, Fréjus, La Londe, Pierrefeu and Notre-Dame des Anges are named Côtes de Provence expressions; verify each current legal wording.
body.zh: Sainte-Victoire、Fréjus、La Londe、Pierrefeu、Notre-Dame des Anges 为具名表达，各自现行法定措辞须核对。

body.en: Bandol, Cassis, Palette and Bellet are separate from Côtes de Provence.
body.zh: Bandol、Cassis、Palette、Bellet 独立于 Côtes de Provence。

body.en: AOC recognition dates to 1941; Mourvèdre is central, especially in structured reds.
body.zh: 1941 年获 AOC；Mourvèdre 为核心，尤其结构型红酒。

body.en: A small independent appellation near Aix-en-Provence, with its own grape specification.
body.zh: Aix-en-Provence 附近小型独立产区，有自身品种规范。

body.en: A Provençal location does not automatically authorise Côtes de Provence on a label.
body.zh: 位于 Provence 不自动获准在酒标使用 Côtes de Provence。

body.en: Bandol's key red grape does not describe its separate white-wine composition.
body.zh: Bandol 核心红品种不能用来概括其白酒组成。

body.en: Clos Cibonne documents a specific Tibouren tradition rather than generic Grenache rosé.
body.zh: Clos Cibonne 记录特定 Tibouren 传统，不能泛化为 Grenache 桃红。

body.en: Bandol makes red, rosé and white; different colour rules must be kept separate.
body.zh: Bandol 生产红、桃红、白；不同酒色规则须分开。

body.en: Clos Cibonne's Tradition and Prestige ranges illustrate differences in élevage within Provence.
body.zh: Clos Cibonne Tradition、Prestige 系列体现 Provence 内不同陈年处理。

body.en: The Le Pradet estate's Tibouren Tradition and Prestige Caroline/Olivier are named producer references.
body.zh: Le Pradet 酒庄的 Tibouren Tradition、Prestige Caroline／Olivier 为具名酒款参照。

body.en: An actual Bellet producer reference with a hillside and poudingue account.
body.zh: Bellet 实际酒庄参照，提供坡地与 poudingue 资料。

body.en: Assess rosé by grape, texture and élevage as well as colour.
body.zh: 除颜色外，按品种、质感与陈年处理评估桃红。

intro.en: A north–south wine corridor with many independent AOCs; Rhône Valley geography is broader than Côtes du Rhône AOC.
intro.zh: 南北向葡萄酒走廊，含许多独立 AOC；Rhône Valley 地理范围广于 Côtes du Rhône AOC。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: A north–south wine corridor with many independent AOCs; Rhône Valley geography is broader than Côtes du Rhône AOC.
body.zh: 南北向葡萄酒走廊，含许多独立 AOC；Rhône Valley 地理范围广于 Côtes du Rhône AOC。

body.en: Côtes du Rhône gained AOC status in 1937; individual crus have their own recognition histories.
body.zh: Côtes du Rhône 于 1937 年获 AOC；各 cru 有独立认可史。

body.en: Louis-Alexandre Faure made the cited first sparkling wine in 1829; AOC recognition followed in 1936.
body.zh: 记载首款起泡酒由 Louis-Alexandre Faure 于 1829 年制作；1936 年获 AOC。

body.en: The river corridor links the Vienne area with Avignon; steep northern slopes contrast with wider southern landscapes.
body.zh: 河流走廊连接 Vienne 与 Avignon；北部陡坡与南部较开阔地貌不同。

body.en: Right bank in Ardèche, between Saint-Joseph to the north and Saint-Péray to the south.
body.zh: Ardèche 的右岸，北邻 Saint-Joseph、南邻 Saint-Péray。

body.en: Steep east- and southeast-facing slopes form protected vineyard settings.
body.zh: 陡峭东、东南坡形成受遮蔽葡萄园环境。

body.en: Northern conditions are more continental; the south is Mediterranean with important Mistral influence.
body.zh: 北部较大陆性，南部地中海性，Mistral 影响重要。

body.en: Granite-derived slopes are important but not universal; limestone and sedimentary deposits also occur.
body.zh: 花岗岩风化坡地重要，但并非处处如此；也有石灰岩及沉积物。

body.en: Clay, limestone, sand and rounded galets vary across southern appellations.
body.zh: 黏土、石灰岩、砂、圆砾 galets 随南部产区变化。

body.en: Gores are decomposed-granite soils; chaillées are dry-stone terrace walls.
body.zh: Gores 为风化花岗岩土壤；chaillées 为干砌石梯田墙。

body.en: Crussol limestone, granite, loess, clay and alluvium refute a single-soil northern Rhône model.
body.zh: Crussol 石灰岩、花岗岩、黄土、黏土、冲积物反驳北 Rhône 单一土壤模型。

body.en: Syrah anchors northern reds; Grenache and multivariety blends become central in the south.
body.zh: Syrah 为北部红酒核心；南部 Grenache 及多品种调配更突出。

body.en: Viognier defines Condrieu and Château-Grillet; Marsanne and Roussanne define other northern white identities.
body.zh: Viognier 对应 Condrieu、Château-Grillet；其他北部白酒侧重 Marsanne、Roussanne。

body.en: Côtes du Rhône → Côtes du Rhône Villages → individual crus is the familiar hierarchy.
body.zh: Côtes du Rhône→Côtes du Rhône Villages→独立 crus 为常用层级。

body.en: Côte-Rôtie, Condrieu, Château-Grillet, Saint-Joseph, Crozes-Hermitage, Hermitage, Cornas and Saint-Péray.
body.zh: Côte-Rôtie、Condrieu、Château-Grillet、Saint-Joseph、Crozes-Hermitage、Hermitage、Cornas、Saint-Péray。

body.en: Red wine from Syrah alone; AOC recognition dates to 1938.
body.zh: 仅 Syrah 红酒；1938 年获 AOC。

body.en: Still and traditional-method sparkling whites use Marsanne and Roussanne near Valence on the right bank.
body.zh: Valence 附近右岸，用 Marsanne、Roussanne 酿静止及传统法起泡白酒。

body.en: Single-variety Cornas contrasts with northern whites and southern red blends; permitted composition is appellation-specific.
body.zh: 单品种 Cornas 与北部白、南部红调配不同；许可组成依产区而定。

body.en: Condrieu is a direct producer reference for Viognier.
body.zh: Condrieu 为 Viognier 的直接酒庄实例。

body.en: Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rouge illustrates the southern multivariety blend tradition.
body.zh: Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rouge 展示南部多品种调配传统。

body.en: Contrast Cornas, Condrieu and Châteauneuf-du-Pape using actual grape and cellar data.
body.zh: 依据实际品种及酿造资料比较 Cornas、Condrieu、Châteauneuf-du-Pape。

intro.en: A southern French region combining dry wines and fortified vins doux naturels beside the Mediterranean and Pyrenees.
intro.zh: 地中海与比利牛斯旁法国南部地区，兼有干酒及强化 vins doux naturels。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: A southern French region combining dry wines and fortified vins doux naturels beside the Mediterranean and Pyrenees.
body.zh: 地中海与比利牛斯旁法国南部地区，兼有干酒及强化 vins doux naturels。

body.en: Banyuls, Maury and Rivesaltes were early modern appellation identities associated with vin doux naturel.
body.zh: Banyuls、Maury、Rivesaltes 为与 vin doux naturel 相关的早期现代法定身份。

body.en: Agly, Têt and Tech structure the vineyard geography.
body.zh: Agly、Têt、Tech 构成葡萄园地理主轴。

body.en: Corbières, Canigou, Albères and the Mediterranean frame the region.
body.zh: Corbières、Canigou、Albères 与地中海界定周边。

body.en: Dry sunny conditions and strong winds interact with altitude and maritime exposure.
body.zh: 干燥日照、强风与海拔、面海程度共同作用。

body.en: Maury's inland schist and Banyuls/Collioure's sea-facing schist terraces differ in mesoclimate.
body.zh: Maury 内陆片岩与 Banyuls／Collioure 面海片岩梯田局地气候不同。

body.en: Clay, limestone, gravel and sandy materials prevent a one-soil regional description.
body.zh: 黏土、石灰岩、砾石、砂质材料使全区单一土壤描述不成立。

body.en: Grenache Noir, Blanc and Gris have separate roles across dry and fortified styles.
body.zh: Grenache Noir、Blanc、Gris 在干、强化酒中各有角色。

body.en: Muscat-based sweet wines have a different aromatic grape basis from Grenache-led VDN.
body.zh: Muscat 甜酒的芳香品种基础不同于 Grenache 主导 VDN。

body.en: Collioure, Côtes du Roussillon, Côtes du Roussillon Villages and Maury sec are key dry-wine identities.
body.zh: Collioure、Côtes du Roussillon、Côtes du Roussillon Villages、Maury sec 为重点干酒身份。

body.en: Banyuls, Banyuls Grand Cru, Maury, Rivesaltes and Muscat de Rivesaltes are key sweet fortified references.
body.zh: Banyuls、Banyuls Grand Cru、Maury、Rivesaltes、Muscat de Rivesaltes 为强化甜酒重点。

body.en: Grenat uses Grenache Noir and emphasises a different expression from ambré and tuilé.
body.zh: Grenat 用 Grenache Noir，表达不同于 ambré、tuilé。

body.en: The cited official summary requires at least 50% Grenache Noir; tuilé is a style designation, not a grape.
body.zh: 所引官方摘要规定至少 50% Grenache Noir；tuilé 为风格名，不是品种。

body.en: Muscat de Rivesaltes includes the Banyuls and Maury areas; overlapping geography does not make the wines identical.
body.zh: Muscat de Rivesaltes 覆盖 Banyuls、Maury 地区；地域重合不使酒相同。

body.en: The coastal wine landscape supports distinct fortified and dry appellation identities.
body.zh: 同一海岸葡萄酒景观支持不同强化、干酒产区身份。

body.en: Grape spirit interrupts fermentation, retaining grape sugar; naturel does not mean unfortified.
body.zh: 葡萄烈酒中断发酵、保留葡萄糖；naturel 不表示未强化。

body.en: VDN may emphasise fresh fruit or prolonged oxidative ageing; fortification alone does not establish either style.
body.zh: VDN 可重鲜果或长期氧化陈年，强化本身不能确定风格。

body.en: Produces both dry wines and VDN; not every bottle from the estate is sweet.
body.zh: 兼做干酒与 VDN，并非全庄酒都是甜酒。

body.en: Its sweet-wine collection includes vintage and long oxidative-ageing expressions.
body.zh: 甜酒系列含年份型及长期氧化陈年型。

body.en: 20-, 30- and 40-year oxidative sweet wines are age expressions, not interchangeable with harvest vintage.
body.zh: 20、30、40 年氧化甜酒为年龄表达，不能与采收年份互换。

body.en: Contrast fruit-preserving VDN and oxidative VDN with different dishes.
body.zh: 针对保果味与氧化型 VDN 安排不同配餐。

body.en: Gascon appellation combining red, rosé and white wines with active local-grape conservation.
body.zh: Gascon 产区，兼红、桃红、白及活跃地方品种保育。

body.en: Reorganisation in the 1970s and 1981 recognition preceded AOC status in 2011.
body.zh: 1970 年代重组、1981 年认可，后于 2011 年获 AOC。

body.en: Vineyards lie in Gers around the Adour river system.
body.zh: 葡萄园位于 Gers 的 Adour 水系周边。

body.en: Atlantic influence varies with exposure and inland position.
body.zh: 大西洋影响随坡向、内陆位置变化。

body.en: Clay-limestone and gravelly or sandy sectors create varied sites.
body.zh: 黏土石灰质、砾石及砂质片区形成不同地块。

body.en: Tannat is a red anchor; Gros Manseng, Petit Courbu and Arrufiac are white references.
body.zh: Tannat 为红重点；Gros Manseng、Petit Courbu、Arrufiac 为白参照。

intro.en: An Alpine mosaic of lake shores, valleys and steep slopes with sharply local grape identities.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯湖岸、谷地与陡坡组合，品种身份具有鲜明地方性。

body.en: France
body.zh: 法国

body.en: Geographical wine region
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: An Alpine mosaic of lake shores, valleys and steep slopes with sharply local grape identities.
body.zh: 阿尔卑斯湖岸、谷地与陡坡组合，品种身份具有鲜明地方性。

body.en: Historic local vineyard names predate the modern Savoie and Roussette de Savoie framework.
body.zh: 历史地方葡萄园名早于现代 Savoie、Roussette de Savoie 体系。

body.en: Local wine is documented from 1145; AOC recognition dates to 1942.
body.zh: 当地葡萄酒文献可追至 1145 年；1942 年获 AOC。

body.en: Combe de Savoie, Chautagne, Lac du Bourget, Léman shores and Ayze require separate mapping.
body.zh: Combe de Savoie、Chautagne、Lac du Bourget、Léman 湖岸、Ayze 须分别定位。

body.en: Altitude, slope aspect and lake moderation matter alongside the general Alpine influence.
body.zh: 海拔、坡向、湖泊调节与整体阿尔卑斯影响同样重要。

body.en: Limestone scree, moraine, clay-marl, alluvium and local schist-bearing materials create varied sites.
body.zh: 石灰岩崩积、冰碛、黏土泥灰岩、冲积物及局部片岩形成不同地块。

body.en: Central to light-bodied local whites, especially Apremont, Abymes and Chignin references.
body.zh: 地方轻盈白酒核心，重点参照 Apremont、Abymes、Chignin。

body.en: The grape behind Roussette de Savoie.
body.zh: Roussette de Savoie 对应品种。

body.en: A central red grape, with Arbin an important geographical reference.
body.zh: 核心红品种，Arbin 为重要地理参照。

body.en: The Savoyard name for Roussanne; distinct from Altesse.
body.zh: Roussanne 的 Savoie 名，与 Altesse 不同。

body.en: Chasselas on Léman shores and Gringet around Ayze broaden the regional identity.
body.zh: Léman 湖岸 Chasselas、Ayze 周边 Gringet 扩展地区身份。

body.en: An Altesse white appellation separate from Savoie AOC.
body.zh: Altesse 白酒产区，独立于 Savoie AOC。

body.en: Frangy, Marestel, Monterminod and Monthoux can supplement Roussette de Savoie under their own conditions.
body.zh: Frangy、Marestel、Monterminod、Monthoux 可按各自条件附加于 Roussette de Savoie。

body.en: A Roussanne identity; not an Altesse wine.
body.zh: Roussanne 身份，不是 Altesse 酒。

body.en: A geographical wine name for Mondeuse, not a different grape.
body.zh: Mondeuse 的地理酒名，不是另一品种。

body.en: Separate from Savoie and Bugey; still whites and sparkling wines have distinct grape conditions.
body.zh: 独立于 Savoie、Bugey；静止白及起泡有不同品种条件。

body.en: Altesse is the still-wine reference unless the Molette variety is explicitly indicated.
body.zh: 静止酒以 Altesse 为参照，明确标示 Molette 时例外。

body.en: Molette and Altesse may be joined by Chasselas in sparkling blends.
body.zh: 起泡调配中 Molette、Altesse 可加入 Chasselas。

body.en: The family estate sits at Chignin-Torméry on the Torméry hillside.
body.zh: 家族庄位于 Chignin-Torméry 的 Torméry 坡地。

body.en: Its Vin de Savoie Chignin and Chignin-Bergeron wines illustrate local identities; do not conflate every producer named Quenard.
body.zh: Vin de Savoie Chignin、Chignin-Bergeron 展示地方身份；不能混同所有名为 Quenard 的酒庄。

body.en: Compare Jacquère, Altesse and Roussanne for structure and weight.
body.zh: 从结构及酒体比较 Jacquère、Altesse、Roussanne。

role.en: Leading regional white; Apremont and Abymes.
role.zh: 区域重要白葡萄，见于 Apremont、Abymes。

role.en: Roussette tradition; Marestel, Frangy and others.
role.zh: Roussette 传统；Marestel、Frangy 等地。
重要 Savoie 红葡萄。
Ayze、Bonneville、Marignier 的特色品种。

role.en: Lakeside Haute-Savoie: Crépy, Marignan, Marin, Ripaille.
role.zh: 湖畔 Haute-Savoie：Crépy、Marignan、Marin、Ripaille。

role.en: Bergeron around Chignin, Francin and Montmélian.
role.zh: Chignin、Francin、Montmélian 一带称 Bergeron。

role.en: Established in Chautagne, Chignin and Jongieux.
role.zh: 见于 Chautagne、Chignin、Jongieux。

body.en: Local wine is documented from 1145; AOC recognition dates to 1942.
body.zh: 当地酒文献可追至 1145 年；1942 年获 AOC。

body.en: Corbonod and the two communes named Seyssel in Ain and Haute-Savoie.
body.zh: Corbonod 及 Ain、Haute-Savoie 两个名为 Seyssel 的市镇。

body.en: Steep Rhône-facing slopes create local conditions within Alpine foothills.
body.zh: 面向 Rhône 陡坡在阿尔卑斯山麓形成地方气候。

body.en: Limestone-derived and glacial slope deposits provide geological references.

body.en: Still Altesse is the reference unless Molette is explicitly indicated; sparkling may also include Chasselas.
body.zh: 静止以 Altesse 为参照，明确 Molette 时例外；起泡可含 Chasselas。

body.zh: 静态 Molette 及起泡混酿，与砂质磨拉石土相关。

body.zh: 静止白与 mousseux 须分别理解。

intro.en: Adriatic central Italian region between mountains and coast, combining Montepulciano reds, Cerasuolo rosé and distinct white-grape traditions.
intro.zh: 亚得里亚海与山地间的意大利中部大区，融合 Montepulciano 红酒、Cerasuolo 桃红及不同白葡萄传统。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: An administrative region with numerous independent denominations.
body.zh: 行政大区，包含多个独立法定产区。

body.en: Montepulciano d’Abruzzo, Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo and Trebbiano d’Abruzzo are separate DOCs.
body.zh: Montepulciano d’Abruzzo、Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo、Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 为不同 DOC。

body.en: Montepulciano DOC dates to 1968; Trebbiano DOC to 1972.
body.zh: Montepulciano DOC 为 1968 年，Trebbiano DOC 为 1972 年。

body.en: Colline Teramane became DOCG in 2003; Cerasuolo obtained independent DOC status in 2010.
body.zh: Colline Teramane 于 2003 年成 DOCG，Cerasuolo 于 2010 年独立 DOC。

body.en: Gran Sasso and Majella are major inland reference points; the Adriatic lies east.
body.zh: Gran Sasso、Majella 为重要内陆参照，亚得里亚海在东侧。

body.en: Delimited wine zones occur in Teramo, Pescara, Chieti and L’Aquila.
body.zh: Teramo、Pescara、Chieti、L’Aquila 均有划定产酒区。

body.en: Mountain proximity promotes ventilation and diurnal variation; coastal and inland ripening conditions differ.
body.zh: 近山促进通风、昼夜温差，海岸与内陆成熟条件有别。

body.en: Teramo’s legal geographic account describes wetter autumn and a July rainfall minimum.
body.zh: Teramo 规范地理说明描述秋季较湿、七月降雨最低。

body.en: Clay-silt hills with looser coastal interlayers; not a uniform limestone landscape.
body.zh: 黏粉土丘陵夹沿海较疏松层，并非一致石灰岩地貌。

body.en: Terre Aquilane includes older fluvial-alluvial terraces with loose deposits and variable depth.
body.zh: Terre Aquilane 有较老河流冲积阶地、疏松沉积及不同深度。

body.en: The white DOC admits Trebbiano Abruzzese and/or Trebbiano Toscano as principal grapes.
body.zh: 白酒 DOC 主葡萄可为 Trebbiano Abruzzese 和／或 Trebbiano Toscano。

body.en: Cococciola centres on Chieti; Montonico on Bisenti/Cermignano; Pecorino and Passerina have named Abruzzo DOC categories.
body.zh: Cococciola 核心 Chieti，Montonico 核心 Bisenti／Cermignano；Pecorino、Passerina 有 Abruzzo DOC 类别。

body.en: Pergola abruzzese remains characteristic alongside modern trellised vineyards.
body.zh: Pergola abruzzese 仍具特色，也有现代棚架园。

body.en: Colline Teramane DOCG vineyards may not exceed 550 m; maximum grape yield is 9.5 t/ha.
body.zh: Colline Teramane DOCG 园不超过 550 米，葡萄最高 9.5 吨／公顷。

body.en: Basic Montepulciano DOC minimum 85%; Colline Teramane minimum 90%, with Sangiovese up to 10%.
body.zh: 基础 Montepulciano DOC 至少 85%；Colline Teramane 至少 90%，Sangiovese 最多 10%。

body.en: Casauria now has independent DOCG registration; Tullum is another Abruzzo DOCG.
body.zh: Casauria 已独立登记 DOCG，Tullum 也是 Abruzzo DOCG。

body.en: Montepulciano supports both red wines and Cerasuolo rosé, with different extraction.
body.zh: Montepulciano 可酿红酒、Cerasuolo 桃红，萃取不同。

body.en: Abruzzo DOC includes a wider grape and sparkling range than Trebbiano d’Abruzzo alone.
body.zh: Abruzzo DOC 品种、起泡范围比单独 Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 更广。

body.en: Torano Nuovo estate documents separate Montepulciano, Trebbiano and Cerasuolo bottles; decanting practices are producer-specific.
body.zh: Torano Nuovo 酒庄分别记录三类酒；换瓶去沉淀为酒庄实践。

body.en: Compare Montepulciano red and Cerasuolo to separate grape identity from extraction; deeper pink does not prove sweetness.
body.zh: 比较红酒、Cerasuolo 区分品种与萃取，较深粉红不证明甜度。

已记录地方种植或保育。
主要红、桃红葡萄。
白酒 DOC 主品种。

Colline Teramane 辅助。

note.en: Estate red; preserve vintage-specific classification.
note.zh: 酒庄红酒，保留年份分类。

note.en: Separate white-wine reference.
note.zh: 独立白酒参照。

coverage.zh: 依据一手资料的区域概览与精选关联产区，非所有获准葡萄或葡萄酒名称的穷尽清单。

intro.en: Northern Basilicata Aglianico DOC, including still and red sparkling wines, separate from the Superiore DOCG.
intro.zh: Basilicata 北部 Aglianico DOC，含静止与红起泡，与 Superiore DOCG 分开。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Basilicata
body.zh: Basilicata

body.en: DOC recognized in 1971.
body.zh: 1971 年认可 DOC。

body.en: Aglianico del Vulture Superiore became a separate DOCG in 2010.
body.zh: Aglianico del Vulture Superiore 于 2010 年成为独立 DOCG。

body.en: Fifteen communes in Potenza province; three outlying Atella territories are excluded by the boundary clause.
body.zh: Potenza 省十五市镇；边界条款排除 Atella 三块外飞地。

body.en: Eligible vineyards are between 200 and 700 m.
body.zh: 合资格葡萄园海拔 200–700 米。

body.en: Summer dryness and substantial day–night variation coexist with rain risk during the late October–November harvest period.
body.zh: 夏季干燥及明显昼夜温差，与 10 月下旬至 11 月采收期降雨风险并存。

body.en: Volcanic materials coexist with sedimentary formations. Porous tuff can retain water useful during the dry season.
body.zh: 火山物质与沉积岩层并存，多孔凝灰岩可保存旱季所需水分。

body.en: The specification permits Aglianico del Vulture N. and/or Aglianico N.; the library links the Aglianico cultivar without inventing a second grape.
body.zh: 法规允许 Aglianico del Vulture N. 和／或 Aglianico N.；库内关联 Aglianico 品种，不另造第二品种。

body.en: Maximum 10 t/ha; alberello and simple trellised systems are traditional references.
body.zh: 最高 10 t/ha；alberello 与简单篱架为传统架式参照。

body.en: Still red and red Spumante; Superiore belongs to the separate DOCG.
body.zh: 静止红与红 Spumante；Superiore 属另一 DOCG。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%; still wine may range from dry to abboccato with residual sugar up to 10 g/L.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 12.5%；静止酒可干至 abboccato，残糖最多 10 g/L。

body.en: Still DOC wine cannot be released before 1 September of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 静止 DOC 不得早于采收翌年 9 月 1 日上市。

body.en: Red sparkling wine uses bottle refermentation and at least nine months of processing; approved sweetness spans Brut to Extra Dry.
body.zh: 红起泡采用瓶中二发，制作期至少九个月；获准甜度从 Brut 至 Extra Dry。

body.en: Compare the DOC and Superiore DOCG by yield, maturation and release dates before assessing producer extraction and oak choices.
body.zh: 比较 DOC、Superiore DOCG 时先核产量、熟成、上市日期，再判断酒庄萃取与橡木选择。

role.en: Exclusive grape identity under the legal Aglianico wording.
role.zh: 法规 Aglianico 名称下的唯一葡萄身份。

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.
coverage.zh: 依据一手资料的区域概览与精选关联产区，非所有获准葡萄或葡萄酒名称的穷尽清单。

intro.en: Still-red Aglianico DOCG with lower yields and longer compulsory maturation than the neighbouring DOC category.
intro.zh: 静止红 Aglianico DOCG，产量更低，法定熟成长于相邻 DOC 类别。

body.en: DOCG / PDO
body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Basilicata
body.zh: Basilicata

body.en: DOCG established in 2010.
body.zh: 2010 年设 DOCG。

body.en: The same fifteen-commune Vulture production zone in Potenza province, with the specified Atella exclusions.
body.zh: Potenza 省同一十五市镇 Vulture 产区，保留指定 Atella 排除范围。

body.en: Eligible sites occupy the 200–700 m band.
body.zh: 合资格地块海拔 200–700 米。

body.en: Volcanic materials and sedimentary layers create varied soils around Vulture; the DOCG is not one identical volcanic soil.
body.zh: Vulture 周边火山物质与沉积层形成不同土壤，DOCG 并非单一相同火山土。

body.en: Aglianico del Vulture N. and/or Aglianico N. in the legal text.
body.zh: 法规采用 Aglianico del Vulture N. 和／或 Aglianico N. 名称。

body.en: Maximum 8 t/ha, lower than the DOC’s 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 最高 8 t/ha，低于 DOC 的 10 t/ha。

body.en: Maximum conversion 65%, corresponding to 52 hl/ha at the maximum grape yield.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 65%，在最高葡萄产量下为 52 hl/ha。

body.en: Still red only; minimum total alcohol 13.5% and total acidity 4.5 g/L.
body.zh: 仅静止红，最低总酒精度 13.5%，总酸 4.5 g/L。

body.en: Not before 1 November of the third year after harvest; at least twelve months in wood and twelve months in bottle.
body.zh: 不得早于采收后第三年 11 月 1 日；至少十二个月木桶及十二个月瓶陈。

body.en: Not before 1 November of the fifth year after harvest; at least twenty-four months wood and twelve months bottle.
body.zh: 不得早于采收后第五年 11 月 1 日；至少二十四个月木桶及十二个月瓶陈。

body.en: Paternoster currently identifies Don Anselmo as Aglianico del Vulture Superiore DOCG. Historical DOC-labelled vintages must retain their original category.
body.zh: Paternoster 当前将 Don Anselmo 标为 Aglianico del Vulture Superiore DOCG；历史 DOC 酒标年份应保留原分类。

body.en: Assess tannin, development and sediment before decanting; the compulsory maturation period does not itself guarantee peak drinking maturity.
body.zh: 醒酒前评估单宁、发展及沉淀；达到法定熟成年限不代表已在最佳适饮期。

role.zh: 唯一葡萄身份。

wines.name: Don Anselmo Aglianico del Vulture Superiore DOCG

note.en: Current producer designation; historical labels remain vintage-specific.
note.zh: 酒庄当前分类；历史酒标按年份保留。

intro.en: Vintage traditional-method sparkling PDO, white and rosé.
intro.zh: 标示年份的传统法起泡 PDO，含白及桃红。

body.en: Vintage traditional-method sparkling PDO, white and rosé.
body.zh: 标示年份的传统法起泡 PDO，含白及桃红。

body.en: DOC decree 2002; DOCG decree 21 February 2011.
body.zh: DOC 法令 2002；DOCG 法令 2011 年 2 月 21 日。

body.en: Hill country in Asti, Cuneo and Alessandria, on the Tanaro’s right bank.
body.zh: Asti、Cuneo、Alessandria 丘陵，位于 Tanaro 右岸。

body.en: Vintage traditional-method sparkling PDO, white and rosé.
body.zh: 标示年份的传统法起泡 PDO，含白及桃红。

body.en: DOC decree 2002; DOCG decree 21 February 2011.
body.zh: DOC 法令 2002；DOCG 法令 2011 年 2 月 21 日。

body.en: Hill country in Asti, Cuneo and Alessandria, on the Tanaro’s right bank.
body.zh: Asti、Cuneo、Alessandria 丘陵，位于 Tanaro 右岸。

body.en: Vineyards must be at least 250 m above sea level.
body.zh: 葡萄园海拔须至少 250 米。

body.en: Calcareous-clay marl of moderate fertility; wet valley floors excluded.
body.zh: 中等肥力的石灰黏土泥灰岩；排除湿润谷底。

body.en: Pinot Nero and/or Chardonnay 90–100%; permitted non-aromatic grapes ≤10%.
body.zh: Pinot Nero 及／或 Chardonnay 90–100%；获准非芳香葡萄 ≤10%。

body.en: Guyot or cordon; new/replanted vineyards ≥4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: Guyot 或单臂式；新植／重植 ≥4,000 株/公顷。

body.en: 11 t/ha; grape-to-wine yield ≤65%.
body.zh: 11 吨/公顷；葡萄成酒率 ≤65%。

body.en: At least 30 months, including lees ageing from bottle fermentation.
body.zh: 至少 30 个月，包含瓶中发酵后酒泥陈酿。

body.en: At least 36 months.
body.zh: 至少 36 个月。

body.en: Vintage is mandatory; blending up to 15% from another vintage is permitted.
body.zh: 必须标年份；允许最多 15% 其他年份调配。

body.en: Sec, demi-sec and dolce categories are excluded.
body.zh: 排除 sec、demi-sec、dolce 类别。

body.en: Secondary fermentation in bottle is compulsory.
body.zh: 必须瓶中二次发酵。

body.en: Vinification, processing, ageing and bottling within Piemonte, with vested-right exceptions.
body.zh: 酿造、加工、陈年及装瓶在 Piemonte 内；历史权利例外另计。

body.en: Fine persistent mousse and complex bottle-fermentation aromas.
body.zh: 细密持久慕斯及复杂瓶中发酵香气。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

intro.en: Autonomous Bolzano province: Alpine valleys, diverse elevations and both local and international grapes.
intro.zh: Bolzano 自治省：阿尔卑斯谷地、多样海拔及本地和国际品种。

body.en: Geographical wine territory
body.zh: 地理葡萄酒区域

body.en: A geographical province; Alto Adige DOC is a denomination within it.
body.zh: 地理省份；Alto Adige DOC 是其中的法定名称。

body.en: Moscato Rosa wine was exhibited in Bolzano in 1886.
body.zh: 1886 年 Bolzano 展览已有 Moscato Rosa 酒。

body.en: Adige/Etsch, Eisack/Isarco and Vinschgau/Val Venosta.
body.zh: Adige／Etsch、Eisack／Isarco、Vinschgau／Val Venosta。

body.en: A warm basin contrasted with higher, cooler vineyards.
body.zh: 温暖盆地与较高、凉爽葡萄园形成对比。

body.en: Valley winds, slopes and elevation create marked local differences.
body.zh: 谷风、坡面、海拔造成明显局部差异。

body.en: Eisacktal and Vinschgau favour cooler-site white styles.
body.zh: Eisacktal、Vinschgau 有利于凉地白酒风格。

body.en: Porphyry, limestone, dolomite, glacial and river deposits coexist.
body.zh: 斑岩、石灰岩、白云岩、冰川及河流沉积并存。

body.en: Bolzano-Gries alluvial gravels and sands are associated with Lagrein.
body.zh: Bolzano-Gries 冲积砾石、沙土与 Lagrein 相关。

body.en: Lagrein and the Schiava group are separate identities.
body.zh: Lagrein 与 Schiava 群为不同身份。

body.en: Pinot Blanc, Chardonnay, Sauvignon and Gewürztraminer are key references.
body.zh: Pinot Blanc、Chardonnay、Sauvignon、Gewürztraminer 为核心参照。

body.en: A rare aromatic red with functionally female flowers and low yields.
body.zh: 罕见芳香红品种，功能性雌花且低产。

body.en: UGA designations link specified origins and permitted grapes.
body.zh: UGA 名称连接指定产地与允许品种。

body.en: A provincial origin does not automatically establish DOC eligibility.
body.zh: 省内产地本身不自动证明 DOC 资格。

body.en: Still dry whites and reds coexist with sweet aromatic specialities.
body.zh: 静止干白、干红与芳香甜酒并存。

body.en: Cooperatives, estates and independent growers all form part of the region.
body.zh: 合作社、庄园与独立种植者共同构成产区。

intro.en: Concentrated dry-style red from dried Valpolicella grapes.
intro.zh: 由 Valpolicella 风干葡萄酿成的浓缩干型风格红酒。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Separate DOCG since 2010.
body.zh: 2010 年起为独立 DOCG。

body.en: Recognised as a wine type within the 1968 DOC.
body.zh: 1968 年 DOC 已认可此类型。

body.en: Verona province, north of the city and east towards the Lessini valleys.
body.zh: Verona 省，城市北侧并向东延入 Lessini 谷地。

body.en: Negrar, Marano, Fumane, Sant’Ambrogio and San Pietro in Cariano form the historical core.
body.zh: Negrar、Marano、Fumane、Sant’Ambrogio、San Pietro in Cariano 构成历史核心。

body.en: A separate geographical mention referring to the Valpantena valley.
body.zh: 指 Valpantena 谷地的独立地理标示。

body.en: Lessini relief and proximity to Lake Garda create varied exposures and airflow.
body.zh: Lessini 地形与 Garda 湖邻近性形成多样朝向及气流。

body.en: Calcareous and dolomitic rocks, basalt, morainic and river deposits occur.
body.zh: 石灰质及白云岩、玄武岩、冰碛及河流沉积并存。

body.en: Corvina/Corvinone and Rondinella underpin the wine.
body.zh: Corvina／Corvinone 与 Rondinella 构成基础。

body.en: Corvina and/or Corvinone 45–95%; Rondinella 5–30%.
body.zh: Corvina 和／或 Corvinone 45–95%；Rondinella 5–30%。

body.en: Other permitted red grapes may total 25%, subject to category and individual limits.
body.zh: 其他获准红品种合计可至 25%，须满足类别及单品种限制。

body.en: At least two years from 1 January after harvest.
body.zh: 自采收后 1 月 1 日起至少两年。

body.en: At least four years from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少四年。

body.en: Veneto decree 20024/2026 authorises vinification from 2 November 2026 for the 2026 harvest only.
body.zh: Veneto 20024/2026 号令允许 2026 年采收葡萄自 2026 年 11 月 2 日起酿造，仅限该年份。

body.en: Selected sound bunches dry in ventilated fruttai before fermentation.
body.zh: 挑选健康果穗，在通风 fruttai 风干后发酵。

body.en: Normally not before 1 December; authorised vintage exceptions may apply.
body.zh: 通常不得早于 12 月 1 日酿造，可有获准年份例外。

body.en: Full body, warmth and dried-fruit character; concentration does not make it Recioto.
body.zh: 饱满、温热、干果特征；浓缩不等于 Recioto。

body.en: Minimum actual alcohol 14% vol.; the sugar ceiling is alcohol-dependent.
body.zh: 实际酒精至少 14%；残糖上限与酒精相关。

intro.en: Glera-led sparkling DOCG of the Asolo hills and Montello in Treviso.
intro.zh: Treviso 的 Asolo 丘陵及 Montello、以 Glera 为主的起泡 DOCG。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG, separate from Prosecco DOC and Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG.
body.zh: DOCG，与 Prosecco DOC、Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG 独立。

body.en: DOCG recognition dates to 2009.
body.zh: 2009 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Asolo hills and Montello in Treviso province.
body.zh: Treviso 省 Asolo 丘陵及 Montello。

body.en: The delimited hillside origin is smaller than the nine-province Prosecco DOC.
body.zh: 划定丘陵产地小于九省 Prosecco DOC。

body.en: Glera at least 85%.
body.zh: Glera 至少 85%。

body.en: Verdiso, Bianchetta Trevigiana, Perera and Glera Lunga may complete the blend.
body.zh: Verdiso、Bianchetta Trevigiana、Perera、Glera Lunga 可补充混酿。

body.en: The code also regulates traditional use of Pinot and Chardonnay base wines for spumante.
body.zh: 规章也规范起泡酒传统使用 Pinot、Chardonnay 基酒。

body.en: Asolo Prosecco and Colli Asolani Prosecco are regulated forms of the designation.
body.zh: Asolo Prosecco、Colli Asolani Prosecco 为受规范名称形式。

body.en: Superiore accompanies the spumante designation.
body.zh: Superiore 用于 spumante 类型。

body.en: Fresh, floral sparkling white wine.
body.zh: 清新、花香型起泡白酒。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante are different pressure categories.
body.zh: Frizzante、spumante 为不同压力类别。

body.en: Asolo is its own DOCG, not a Conegliano Valdobbiadene Rive.
body.zh: Asolo 为独立 DOCG，不是 Conegliano Valdobbiadene 的 Rive。

body.en: Do not apply the wider Prosecco DOC rosé specification to this DOCG.
body.zh: 不可套用广域 Prosecco DOC 桃红规范。

intro.en: Aromatic Piemonte PDO encompassing Asti spumante, Moscato d’Asti and late-harvest wine.
intro.zh: 涵盖 Asti 起泡、Moscato d’Asti 及晚采酒的 Piemonte 芳香 PDO。

body.en: Aromatic Piemonte PDO encompassing Asti spumante, Moscato d’Asti and late-harvest wine.
body.zh: 涵盖 Asti 起泡、Moscato d’Asti 及晚采酒的 Piemonte 芳香 PDO。

body.en: DOC 1967; DOCG 1993.
body.zh: 1967 DOC；1993 DOCG。

body.en: March 2026 consolidated rules add rosato/rosé spumante, including metodo classico.
body.zh: 2026 年 3 月整合法规增加 rosato／rosé 起泡，包含传统法。

body.en: Aromatic Piemonte PDO encompassing Asti spumante, Moscato d’Asti and late-harvest wine.
body.zh: 涵盖 Asti 起泡、Moscato d’Asti 及晚采酒的 Piemonte 芳香 PDO。

body.en: DOC 1967; DOCG 1993.
body.zh: 1967 DOC；1993 DOCG。

body.en: March 2026 consolidated rules add rosato/rosé spumante, including metodo classico.
body.zh: 2026 年 3 月整合法规增加 rosato／rosé 起泡，包含传统法。

body.en: Delimited parts of Asti, Alessandria and Cuneo.
body.zh: Asti、Alessandria、Cuneo 的划定地区。

body.en: Canelli, Santo Stefano Belbo, Castiglione Tinella, Strevi and Acqui Terme.
body.zh: Canelli、Santo Stefano Belbo、Castiglione Tinella、Strevi、Acqui Terme。

body.en: Continental; sunny hillside exposure supports ripening.
body.zh: 大陆性；向阳坡地有助成熟。

body.en: Cassinasco sandstone contrasts with eastern Sant’Agata marls and gypsum-bearing formations.
body.zh: Cassinasco 砂岩与东部 Sant’Agata 泥灰岩及含石膏地层形成对比。

body.en: Moscato Bianco ≥97%; other permitted aromatic white grapes ≤3%.
body.zh: Moscato Bianco ≥97%；其他获准芳香白葡萄 ≤3%。

body.en: Moscato Bianco 70–90%; Brachetto 10–30%.
body.zh: Moscato Bianco 70–90%；Brachetto 10–30%。

body.zh: Caserta 省十九市镇，加 Napoli 省 Giugliano in Campania、Qualiano、Sant’Antimo。

body.zh: Asprinio 至少 85%；其他合资格白葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Asprinio 100%.
body.zh: Asprinio 100%。

body.en: Vines climb living poplar supports, reaching heights that require ladders for vineyard work and harvest.
body.zh: 葡萄攀附活杨树支撑，形成需梯子作业、采收的高架系统。

body.en: Modern lower training systems also exist; the Asprinio study compares alberata with espalier rather than treating all Aversa vineyards as alberata.
body.zh: 现代低架系统亦存在；Asprinio 研究比较 alberata 与篱架，并非所有 Aversa 葡萄园均为 alberata。

body.en: Aversa is the protected DOC name; Asprinio identifies its principal grape and traditional wine identity.
body.zh: Aversa 为受保护 DOC 名，Asprinio 说明主要葡萄与传统酒身份。

body.en: High natural acidity supports both dry still wines and sparkling production; the pure-variety requirement is stricter for sparkling.
body.zh: 高天然酸度支持干型静止与起泡酿造，起泡的纯品种要求更严格。

body.en: Use acidity and restrained aroma as structural reference points; compare training and cellar choices only where bottle-specific evidence is available.
body.zh: 以酸度与克制香气为结构参照，架式与酒窖选择须有酒款具体证据再比较。

role.zh: 静止至少 85%，起泡 100%。

body.en: Lighter fresh-fruit expression contrasts with Amarone appassimento concentration.
body.zh: 较轻清新果味与 Amarone 风干浓缩对比。

intro.en: Southern region whose vineyards span Vulture’s Aglianico, warmer Matera, inland Alta Val d’Agri and heritage-grape recovery around Pollino.
intro.zh: 南部大区，涵盖 Vulture Aglianico、较暖 Matera、内陆 Alta Val d’Agri 及 Pollino 传统葡萄保育。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Vulture DOC and Superiore DOCG are separate; Matera, Grottino di Roccanova and Terre dell’Alta Val d’Agri broaden the regional picture.
body.zh: Vulture DOC、Superiore DOCG 独立；另有 Matera、Grottino di Roccanova、Terre dell’Alta Val d’Agri。

body.en: Vulture is one northern zone, not a proxy for all Basilicata climates or soils.
body.zh: Vulture 只是北部一区，不能代表全 Basilicata 气候土壤。

body.en: Vulture DOC dates to 1971; Superiore DOCG to 2010.
body.zh: Vulture DOC 始于 1971，Superiore DOCG 为 2010。

body.en: ALSIA investigates old local accessions; names and later registrations need genetic reconciliation.
body.zh: ALSIA 调查老地方材料；名称、后续登记需遗传核对。

body.en: Vulture vineyards lie in Potenza province around an extinct volcano, with a 200–700 m legal vineyard band.
body.zh: Vulture 园在 Potenza 省死火山周边，法定海拔 200–700 米。

body.en: Matera has Ionian coastal and hill settings; Alta Val d’Agri centres on Viggiano, Grumento Nova and Moliterno; Guarnaccino on Chiaromonte.
body.zh: Matera 有爱奥尼亚海岸丘陵；Alta Val d’Agri 核心三个市镇；Guarnaccino 核心 Chiaromonte。

body.en: Dry summers precede wetter October–November, when late Aglianico may still be harvested.
body.zh: 旱夏后十至十一月较湿，晚熟 Aglianico 仍可能采收。

body.en: Ionian–Metapontine and Bradano areas are among the region’s warmest, with marked summer drought.
body.zh: Ionian–Metapontine、Bradano 为地区最暖区之一，夏旱明显。

body.en: Volcanic and sedimentary deposits alternate; tuff supports summer water storage.
body.zh: 火山、沉积材料交替，凝灰岩有助夏季蓄水。

body.en: Coastal plains, marine terraces and Bradanic hills include calcareous sands and conglomerates.
body.zh: 海岸平原、海成阶地、Bradanic 丘陵含石灰质砂及砾岩。

body.en: Aglianico is central to Vulture; Guarnaccino has documented Chiaromonte red and rosé bottlings.
body.zh: Aglianico 核心 Vulture；Guarnaccino 有 Chiaromonte 红、桃红装瓶。

body.en: Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon dominate Alta Val d’Agri reds; Matera also uses Sangiovese, Primitivo and Greco.
body.zh: Merlot／Cabernet Sauvignon 主导 Alta Val d’Agri；Matera 另用 Sangiovese、Primitivo、Greco。

body.en: Traditional alberello and simple trellises are permitted in Vulture.
body.zh: Vulture 允许传统 alberello、简单棚架。

body.en: Vulture DOC maximum 10 t/ha; Superiore DOCG 8 t/ha.
body.zh: Vulture DOC 最高 10 吨／公顷，Superiore DOCG 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Superiore starts 1 November in the third year after harvest, with 12 months wood/12 bottle; Riserva fifth year with 24 wood/12 bottle.
body.zh: Superiore 采收后第三年 11 月 1 日起，12 月木桶／12 月瓶陈；Riserva 第五年、24／12 月。

body.en: Rosso minimum Sangiovese 60%/Primitivo 30%; Moro minimum Cabernet Sauvignon 60%/Primitivo 20%/Merlot 10%.
body.zh: Rosso 至少 Sangiovese 60%／Primitivo 30%；Moro 至少 Cabernet Sauvignon 60%／Primitivo 20%／Merlot 10%。

body.en: The DOC includes red sparkling with bottle refermentation and at least nine months processing.
body.zh: DOC 含瓶中再发酵红起泡，制作至少九个月。

body.en: Superiore and Riserva are still red categories; the DOC’s sparkling type does not transfer automatically.
body.zh: Superiore、Riserva 为静止红类别，DOC 起泡不自动转入。

body.en: Paternoster Don Anselmo currently carries Superiore DOCG; 600 Grotte documents Il Nero, Nostos and Rhodalys from Guarnaccino.
body.zh: Paternoster Don Anselmo 当前 Superiore DOCG；600 Grotte 有 Guarnaccino 的 Il Nero、Nostos、Rhodalys。

body.en: Check DOC versus DOCG and still versus sparkling; assess tannin, acidity and actual vintage development before aeration.
body.zh: 核对 DOC／DOCG、静止／起泡，醒酒前评单宁酸度及实际年份发展。

note.zh: 现 Superiore DOCG，旧瓶保留原标示。
