body.zh: 采收次年9月1日起上市。

body.en: Two years from 1 January following harvest, including at least one in oak.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起2年，其中至少1年橡木熟成。

role.zh: 主要红葡萄选项，0–100%。
主要红葡萄选项，0–100%。
主要红葡萄选项，0–100%。
白混酿或品种型。
白混酿或品种型。

intro.en: Precisely delimited Cabernet-led red denomination within Castagneto Carducci, distinct from Bolgheri DOC.
intro.zh: Castagneto Carducci 内精确划界、Cabernet 主导的红酒产区，与 Bolgheri DOC 独立。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Red wine only.
body.zh: 只限红葡萄酒。

body.en: Independent DOC since 2013, previously a Bolgheri subzone.
body.zh: 2013年起独立 DOC，此前为 Bolgheri 子区。

body.en: A specifically bounded portion of Castagneto Carducci in Livorno.
body.zh: Livorno 省 Castagneto Carducci 中精确划定区域。

body.en: Defined sites include the Sassicaia and Castiglioncello areas; not all Bolgheri vineyards qualify.
body.zh: 边界涉及 Sassicaia 及 Castiglioncello 一带，并非所有 Bolgheri 葡萄园均合资格。

body.en: Minimum 80%.
Other authorised Tuscan red grapes up to 20%; the legal rule is broader than a producer’s usual Cabernet Franc blend.
body.zh: 其他托斯卡纳许可红葡萄最多20%；法律范围较酒庄常用 Cabernet Franc 配方更广。

body.en: Maximum 7 t/ha.
body.zh: 每公顷最多7吨。

body.en: All grapes must come from the specifically delimited DOC area.
body.zh: 所有果实须来自该 DOC 精确划定范围。

body.en: At least two years from 1 January after harvest.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起至少2年。

body.en: At least 18 months in oak containers no larger than 225 litres.
body.zh: 至少18个月在不超过225升橡木容器中熟成。

role.zh: 传统辅助葡萄。

intro.en: Brachetto d’Acqui and Acqui are alternative names of one DOCG.
intro.zh: Brachetto d’Acqui 与 Acqui 是同一 DOCG 的两种名称。

body.en: Brachetto d’Acqui and Acqui are alternative names of one DOCG.
body.zh: Brachetto d’Acqui 与 Acqui 是同一 DOCG 的两种名称。

body.en: DOC 1969; DOCG 1996.
body.zh: 1969 DOC；1996 DOCG。

body.en: Arturo Bersano developed tank-method Brachetto around the 1950s.
body.zh: Arturo Bersano 约于 1950 年代发展罐式法 Brachetto。

body.en: Brachetto d’Acqui and Acqui are alternative names of one DOCG.
body.zh: Brachetto d’Acqui 与 Acqui 是同一 DOCG 的两种名称。

body.en: DOC 1969; DOCG 1996.
body.zh: 1969 DOC；1996 DOCG。

body.en: Arturo Bersano developed tank-method Brachetto around the 1950s.
body.zh: Arturo Bersano 约于 1950 年代发展罐式法 Brachetto。

body.en: Alto Monferrato across Asti and Alessandria; Acqui Terme is a key town.
body.zh: 横跨 Asti、Alessandria 的 Alto Monferrato；Acqui Terme 为核心市镇。

body.en: Calcareous-clay marl hillsides; Nizza has clay and Acqui sand/silt variations.
body.zh: 石灰黏土泥灰岩坡地；Nizza 偏黏土，Acqui 有砂及粉砂差异。

body.en: Brachetto ≥97%; other Piemonte-permitted grapes ≤3%.
body.zh: Brachetto ≥97%；其他 Piemonte 获准葡萄 ≤3%。

body.en: New vineyards ≥4,000 vines/ha; vertical training, commonly Guyot.
body.zh: 新园 ≥4,000 株/公顷；直立架式，常用 Guyot。

body.en: Base ceiling 8 t/ha, subject to authorised annual regional adjustments.
body.zh: 基本上限 8 吨/公顷，可依获准年度大区措施调整。

body.en: Red or rosé, dry to sweet; actual alcohol ≥5%; pressure ≤2.5 bar.
body.zh: 红或桃红、干至甜；实际酒精度 ≥5%；压力 ≤2.5 bar。

body.en: Red or rosé; extra brut to dolce; actual alcohol ≥6%.
body.zh: 红或桃红；extra brut 至 dolce；实际酒精度 ≥6%。

body.en: Sweet red; actual alcohol ≥11%, residual sugar ≥50 g/l.
body.zh: 甜红；实际酒精度 ≥11%，残糖 ≥50 克/升。

body.en: Not before 1 October following harvest.
body.zh: 不得早于采收翌年 10 月 1 日。

body.en: Natural tank or bottle fermentation; processing ≥1 month including bottle refinement.
body.zh: 自然罐式或瓶中发酵；工序 ≥1 个月，含瓶中精熟。

body.en: Passito grapes may dry on the vine and/or in suitable rooms.
body.zh: Passito 葡萄可在藤上及／或适宜室内风干。

body.en: Aromatic does not mean obligatorily sweet: the DOCG also permits dry and rosé wines.
body.zh: 芳香不代表必须甜型：DOCG 亦允许干型及桃红。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

intro.en: Vicenza foothill DOC particularly associated with Vespaiola, as dry Vespaiolo and sweet Torcolato.
intro.zh: Vicenza 山麓 DOC，尤其关联 Vespaiola，酿干型 Vespaiolo、甜型 Torcolato。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC encompassing white and red types.
body.zh: 涵盖白、红类型的 DOC。

body.en: Recognised in 1969; the first DOC in Vicenza province.
body.zh: 1969 年获认可，是 Vicenza 省首个 DOC。

body.en: Foothills north of Vicenza, centred on Breganze.
body.zh: Vicenza 北部山麓，以 Breganze 为中心。

body.en: The local white grape behind Vespaiolo and Torcolato.
body.zh: Vespaiolo、Torcolato 背后的本地白品种。

body.en: Vespaiola retains marked acidity useful in both dry and sweet styles.
body.zh: Vespaiola 保有明显酸度，适合干、甜风格。

body.en: Vespaiolo and Torcolato are wine types, not separate grape varieties.
body.zh: Vespaiolo、Torcolato 为酒类型，非不同品种。

body.en: Dry white wine showing the grape’s freshness.
body.zh: 干白表达品种清新特征。

body.en: Selected bunches are air-dried before sweet-wine production.
body.zh: 精选果穗风干后酿甜酒。

body.en: The same grape produces substantially different dry and dried-grape expressions.
body.zh: 同品种呈现不同干型、风干风格。

body.en: Torcolato combines concentrated fruit with supporting acidity.
body.zh: Torcolato 结合浓缩果味与支撑酸度。

body.en: Vespaiolo emphasises freshness without the dried-grape sweetness.
body.zh: Vespaiolo 强调清新，无风干甜酒的甜度。

role.en: Documented local grape or specified appellation component.
role.zh: 有记录的本地品种或法定产区组分。

intro.en: Long-aged Sangiovese from the municipality of Montalcino; Brunello is a local grape name.
intro.zh: Montalcino 市镇的长陈年 Sangiovese；Brunello 是地方葡萄名称。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: 100% Sangiovese, locally Brunello.
body.zh: 100% Sangiovese，当地称 Brunello。

body.en: DOC in 1966; DOCG in 1980.
body.zh: 1966年 DOC，1980年 DOCG。

body.en: The delimited Montalcino area in Siena province, southern inland Tuscany.
body.zh: Siena 省 Montalcino 划定范围，位于托斯卡纳内陆南部。

body.en: A hill landscape with varied exposures; Monte Amiata influences protection from weather to the southeast.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向多样，东南方向 Monte Amiata 影响气候屏障。

body.en: Sangiovese alone; neither Cabernet nor Merlot is permitted in the blend.
body.zh: 只用 Sangiovese，配方不允许 Cabernet 或 Merlot。

body.en: The base specification ceiling is 8 t/ha; annual measures may reduce operational yields.
body.zh: 基础规范上限每公顷8吨，年度措施可能下调实际限额。

body.en: 1 January of the fifth year after the harvest year; Riserva in the sixth.
body.zh: 采收年份之后第5年的1月1日；Riserva 为第6年。

body.en: A 2021 Brunello can be released in 2026; a 2021 Riserva in 2027.
body.zh: 2021 Brunello 最早2026年上市；2021 Riserva 最早2027年。

body.en: At least two years in oak.
body.zh: 至少2年橡木熟成。

body.en: At least four months in bottle; six for Riserva.
body.zh: 至少4个月瓶陈；Riserva 为6个月。

body.en: Assess firm tannin and acidity, bottle development and sediment before decanting.
body.zh: 醒酒前判断单宁酸度、瓶中发展及沉淀。

body.en: Roast meat, game and mushroom dishes are useful comparative pairings.
body.zh: 烤肉、野味与蘑菇菜可作为配餐比较。

role.en: Exclusive grape; Brunello is the local name.
role.zh: 唯一品种，Brunello 是地方名称。

intro.en: Calabria links the Gaglioppo tradition of Cirò, late-ripening inland red varieties and the aromatic passito of Bianco. Modern genetic research is essential where historical names have overlapped.
intro.zh: Calabria 包括 Cirò 的 Gaglioppo、内陆晚熟红葡萄及 Bianco 芳香风干酒；历史名称多有交叠，须结合现代遗传研究。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Cirò and Cirò Marina form the Classico DOCG; the broader DOC also includes delimited Melissa and Crucoli land.
body.zh: Cirò 与 Cirò Marina 构成 Classico DOCG；较广 DOC 还含 Melissa、Crucoli 的划定地块。

body.en: The passito DOC covers Bianco and part of Casignana in the Locride district.
body.zh: 风干 DOC 包括 Locride 的 Bianco 及部分 Casignana。

body.en: Pecorello is associated with Cosenza/Donnici, Marsigliana Nera with Lamezia and Prunesta with Tyrrhenian Reggio.
body.zh: Pecorello 关联 Cosenza／Donnici，Marsigliana Nera 关联 Lamezia，Prunesta 关联第勒尼安海一侧 Reggio。

body.en: Established in 1969.
Cirò Classico became a separate DOCG in 2025.
body.zh: Cirò Classico 于 2025 年成为独立 DOCG。

body.en: A distinct aromatic sweet-wine tradition based on grape drying, rather than Cirò’s non-aromatic white grape.
body.zh: 为独立的芳香风干甜酒传统，不能等同于 Cirò 的非芳香白葡萄。

body.en: Sangiovese × Mantonico Bianco; Nerello Mascalese shares the same parents.
body.zh: Sangiovese × Mantonico Bianco；Nerello Mascalese 同双亲。

body.en: Magliocco Dolce and Magliocco Canino are distinct; authenticated 2021 research also separates Magliocco Dolce from Greco Nero.
body.zh: Magliocco Dolce、Magliocco Canino 不同；2021 鉴定研究亦将 Dolce 与 Greco Nero 分开。

body.en: Greco Bianco and Mantonico Bianco are different varieties; the local aromatic Greco di Bianco belongs to the Malvasia identity.
body.zh: Greco Bianco、Mantonico Bianco 不同；当地芳香 Greco di Bianco 属 Malvasia 身份。

body.en: Harvest commonly late September to early October in the ARSAC account.
body.zh: ARSAC 记载常于九月下旬至十月上旬采收。

body.en: Magliocco Dolce ripens in October and tolerates hot dry conditions; Canino is reported more drought-sensitive.
body.zh: Magliocco Dolce 十月成熟、较耐炎热干旱；Canino 记载为较怕旱。

body.en: New/replanted vineyards require at least 4,000 vines/ha; maximum yield 8 t/ha.
body.zh: 新植／重植至少 4,000 株／公顷，最高 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Gaglioppo at least 80%.
body.zh: Gaglioppo 至少 80%。

body.en: Red only, Gaglioppo ≥90%; remaining grapes may be Magliocco and Greco Nero as named in the specification.
body.zh: 仅红酒，Gaglioppo 至少 90%；余量可用规范所称 Magliocco、Greco Nero。

body.en: At least 95% local Greco; up to 5% other suitable whites.
body.zh: 当地 Greco 至少 95%，最多 5% 其他获准白葡萄。

body.en: At least 36 months, including six in wood, from 1 January after harvest.
body.zh: 自采收后次年 1 月 1 日起至少 36 个月，其中六个月木桶。

body.en: Sun drying on racks or permitted forced-air systems concentrates the grapes.
body.zh: 在架上日晒或使用获准强制通风设备使葡萄浓缩。

body.en: High acidity supports dry structured whites as well as dried-grape wines.
body.zh: 高酸可支撑有结构干白，也适于风干酒。

body.en: Can retain high acidity alongside substantial sugar, with deep colour; fungal pressure requires attention.
body.zh: 高糖同时可保留高酸、色深，须关注真菌病害。

body.en: A distinct Cosenza white, usually harvested in early to mid September.
body.zh: 独立 Cosenza 白葡萄，通常九月上至中旬采收。

body.en: Aromatic concentrated sweet wine; first release not before 1 November after the harvest year.
body.zh: 芳香浓缩甜酒，最早采收后次年 11 月 1 日上市。

body.en: An unqualified legal word “Magliocco” is not sufficient to resolve every accession to Magliocco Dolce.
body.zh: 法规未附种加词的 Magliocco，不能自动将所有材料归为 Magliocco Dolce。

body.en: The aromatic local Greco di Gerace belongs with the Malvasia di Lipari/Sardegna identity.
body.zh: 芳香地方 Greco di Gerace 对应 Malvasia di Lipari／Sardegna 身份。

body.en: ARSAC notes Magliocco Canino called Nocera around Scilla; this does not make the authenticated varieties identical.
body.zh: ARSAC 记载 Scilla 曾称 Magliocco Canino 为 Nocera，并不表示经鉴定两者相同。

body.en: The Saracena/ARSAC Guarnaccia material was genetically distinct from the national-register Guarnaccia Bianca profile in Fanelli et al. (2021); the Sardinian Granatza synonym is therefore not transferred automatically.
body.zh: Fanelli 等（2021）发现 Saracena／ARSAC Guarnaccia 与国家注册 Guarnaccia Bianca 不同；因此不自动套用 Sardegna Granatza 同义关系。

role.en: Cirò DOC and Cirò Classico DOCG principal grape.
role.zh: Cirò DOC、Cirò Classico DOCG 主体。

role.en: Cirò Bianco; distinct from the aromatic Bianco passito grape.
role.zh: Cirò 白酒，与 Bianco 芳香风干品种不同。
Calabria 内陆重要红葡萄。
独立的 Magliocco 身份。
经鉴定研究中的独立基因型。
Locride 白葡萄、Gaglioppo 亲本。

role.en: Local Greco di Bianco / Greco di Gerace.
role.zh: 当地 Greco di Bianco／Greco di Gerace。

role.en: Documented regional cultivation or conservation; see the grape dossier for exact locality and identity.
role.zh: 有文献的区域种植或保育；具体地点及身份见品种档案。

role.en: Documented regional cultivation or conservation; see the grape dossier for exact locality and identity.
role.zh: 有文献的区域种植或保育；具体地点及身份见品种档案。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: Tyrrhenian region combining inland Irpinia and Sannio, volcanic Naples, islands, Caserta and the Amalfi coast. Local cultivar identities are fundamental.
intro.zh: 第勒尼安大区，兼有 Irpinia、Sannio 内陆，Napoli 火山区、岛屿、Caserta、Amalfi 海岸，地方品种精确身份至关重要。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Avellino, Benevento, Caserta, Napoli and Salerno form distinct wine landscapes.
body.zh: Avellino、Benevento、Caserta、Napoli、Salerno 各有不同葡萄酒地貌。

body.en: Taurasi, Greco di Tufo, Fiano di Avellino and Aglianico del Taburno are the four DOCG references.
body.zh: 四个 DOCG 参照为 Taurasi、Greco di Tufo、Fiano di Avellino、Aglianico del Taburno。

body.en: Regional work distinguishes Roviello/Greco Musc’ from Greco and identifies sampled Cascolo as Sciascinoso.
body.zh: 地区研究将 Roviello／Greco Musc’ 与 Greco 区分，所测 Cascolo 鉴为 Sciascinoso。

body.en: Caprettone separately registered in 2014; Uva del Conte entered the regional list in February 2026.
body.zh: Caprettone 2014 独立登记，Uva del Conte 2026 二月进入地区名录。

body.en: Irpinia surrounds Avellino’s valleys and hills; Sannio centres on Benevento.
body.zh: Irpinia 关联 Avellino 河谷丘陵，Sannio 核心 Benevento。

body.en: Campi Flegrei is near Naples, Ischia is an island DOC, and Amalfi includes Furore, Ravello and Tramonti.
body.zh: Campi Flegrei 近 Napoli，Ischia 为岛屿 DOC，Amalfi 含 Furore、Ravello、Tramonti。

body.en: Inland Aglianico’s long cycle can extend to late October–November; altitude and exposure affect ripening.
body.zh: 内陆 Aglianico 长周期可至十月末、十一月；海拔坡向影响成熟。

body.en: Campi Flegrei has tuff, ash, pumice and lapilli; some sandy sites retain ungrafted vines.
body.zh: Campi Flegrei 有凝灰岩、灰、浮石、火山砾，部分砂地留自根藤。

body.en: Irpinia also has clay, marl and limestone; Fiorduva sites are described as dolomitic limestone.
body.zh: Irpinia 也有黏土、泥灰、石灰岩；Fiorduva 地块为白云质石灰岩。

body.en: Coda di Volpe, Caprettone and Pallagrello Bianco are separate; Camaiola is distinct from Piedmont Barbera.
body.zh: Coda di Volpe、Caprettone、Pallagrello Bianco 独立；Camaiola 非 Piemonte Barbera。

body.en: Biancolella and Forastera anchor Ischia whites; Per’ e Palummo is Piedirosso.
body.zh: Biancolella、Forastera 主导 Ischia 白酒；Per’ e Palummo 即 Piedirosso。

body.en: Asprinio climbs living tree supports in alberata aversana, requiring tall ladders and skilled harvesting.
body.zh: Asprinio 以 alberata aversana 攀活树，需高梯、熟练采收。

body.en: Regional cultivar registration does not automatically authorize every PDO blend.
body.zh: 地区品种登记不自动授权所有 PDO 配比。

body.en: Aglianico minimum 85%; three years including one in wood, Riserva four including 18 months wood; clock starts 1 December of harvest year.
body.zh: Aglianico 至少 85%；三年含一年木桶，Riserva 四年含十八月木桶；采收年 12 月 1 日起算。

body.en: Traditional-method sparkling categories received final EU amendment approval in June 2025, following the earlier proposal.
body.zh: 传统法起泡类别在早前提案后于 2025 六月获最终欧盟修订批准。

body.en: Named Caprettone, Falanghina, Piedirosso and Aglianico categories each require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: Caprettone、Falanghina、Piedirosso、Aglianico 专名各至少 85% 对应葡萄。

body.en: Traditional-method bottle refermentation: minimum 18 months on lees, 36 for Spumante Riserva.
body.zh: 传统法瓶中再发酵，酒泥至少 18 月，Spumante Riserva 36 月。

body.en: Fenile 30%, Ginestra 30%, Ripoli 40%; late-picked barrel-fermented dry white.
body.zh: Fenile 30%、Ginestra 30%、Ripoli 40%；晚采桶发酵干白。

body.en: Mastroberardino Radici, Casa D’Ambra’s island wines and Vestini Campagnano’s recovered varieties supply different benchmarks.
body.zh: Mastroberardino Radici、Casa D’Ambra 岛酒、Vestini Campagnano 保育葡萄提供不同参照。

body.en: Compare fragrant, often less tannic Piedirosso with structured Aglianico, then assess vintage and extraction.
body.zh: 对比芳香常较温和 Piedirosso 与结构型 Aglianico，再评年份萃取。

intro.en: Maritime volcanic DOC west of Naples, closely associated with Falanghina Flegrea and Piedirosso.

body.en: The Phlegraean area west of Naples combines coastal exposure, hills and volcanic craters.
body.zh: Napoli 西侧 Phlegraean 地带结合海岸、丘陵与火山口。

body.en: Tuff, ash, pumice and lapilli contribute to variable, often loose soils; selected sandy sites sustain ungrafted vines.
body.zh: 凝灰岩、火山灰、浮石及火山砾形成不同、常疏松土壤，部分砂质地块保留自根藤。

body.en: Falanghina 50–70%; eligible white complements within the permitted balance.
body.zh: Falanghina 50–70%，其余合资格白葡萄按余量规范。

body.en: Piedirosso at least 50%, Aglianico at least 30%, other eligible red grapes up to 20%.
body.zh: Piedirosso 至少 50%，Aglianico 至少 30%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Named Falanghina and Piedirosso wines require at least 90% of the named grape. Falanghina Flegrea is the local identity reference.
body.zh: 标示 Falanghina 或 Piedirosso 至少含所标葡萄 90%；当地 Falanghina 身份参照为 Falanghina Flegrea。

body.en: Bianco and Rosso coexist with varietal wines, Piedirosso Riserva, Rosato and Passito, and Falanghina Spumante and Passito.
body.zh: 含 Bianco、Rosso、品种酒、Piedirosso Riserva、Rosato、Passito，以及 Falanghina Spumante、Passito。

body.en: Red extraction, rosé production, dried-grape wines and sparkling fermentation create distinct profiles from the same local grape base.
body.zh: 红酒萃取、桃红、干化葡萄与起泡发酵，使相同地方葡萄形成不同酒型。

body.en: Piedirosso commonly shows a lighter tannic frame than Aglianico; blend composition and extraction must inform comparisons.
body.zh: Piedirosso 单宁结构通常比 Aglianico 轻，比较时须纳入配比与萃取。

role.en: Local white reference; legal Falanghina blend rules apply.
role.zh: 地方白葡萄参照，适用法规 Falanghina 配比。

role.en: Principal red grape and named varietal.
role.zh: 主要红葡萄及标示品种。

body.en: Youthful fruit-led category from the same broad red-grape framework.

body.zh: Frascati DOC、Frascati Superiore DOCG、Cannellino di Frascati DOCG 为不同法律条目。

body.en: Frascati, Grottaferrata and Monte Porzio Catone, with parts of Rome and Montecompatri.
body.zh: Frascati、Grottaferrata、Monte Porzio Catone 全境，以及 Rome、Montecompatri 部分地区。

body.en: Alban Hills southeast of Rome.
body.zh: Rome 东南的 Alban Hills。

body.en: Permeable volcanic soils: well drained, dry but not arid.
body.zh: 通透火山土，排水良好、干爽但不干旱。

body.en: The zone rises from lower slopes toward roughly 500 m.
body.zh: 产区由较低坡地上升至约500米。

body.en: Malvasia Bianca di Candia and/or Malvasia del Lazio together at least 70%.
body.zh: Malvasia Bianca di Candia 和／或 Malvasia del Lazio 合计至少70%。

body.en: Bellone, Bombino Bianco, Greco, Trebbiano Toscano and Trebbiano Giallo: up to 30%.
body.zh: Bellone、Bombino Bianco、Greco、Trebbiano Toscano、Trebbiano Giallo 合计最多30%。

body.en: Minimum residual sugar 35 g/L.
body.zh: 残糖至少35克／升。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%; total includes potential alcohol from residual sugar.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少12.5%，总量包含残糖潜在酒精。

body.en: Late harvest is required; partial drying is permitted.
body.zh: 要求晚收，允许部分风干。

body.en: Enrichment is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止增糖。

辅助葡萄。

intro.zh: 覆盖全岛的 Cannonau DOC，另设较小 Classico 区及三个子区。

body.en: Cannonau di Sardegna DOC
body.zh: Cannonau di Sardegna DOC

body.en: DOC established in 1972.
body.zh: DOC 建于 1972 年。

body.en: Entire Sardegna region.
body.zh: 整个 Sardegna 大区。

body.en: Nuoro and Ogliastra as delimited in the specification.
body.zh: 规范界定的 Nuoro 与 Ogliastra。

body.en: Oliena/Nepente di Oliena: Oliena and part of Orgosolo.
body.zh: Oliena／Nepente di Oliena：Oliena 及部分 Orgosolo。

body.en: Castiadas, Muravera, San Vito, Villaputzu and Villasimius.
body.zh: Castiadas、Muravera、San Vito、Villaputzu、Villasimius。

body.en: Jerzu and Cardedu.
body.zh: Jerzu 与 Cardedu。

body.en: At least 85%; Classico at least 90%.
body.zh: 至少 85%，Classico 至少 90%。

body.en: Cannonau is the Sardinian name of Garnacha Tinta/Grenache Noir.
body.zh: Cannonau 为 Garnacha Tinta／Grenache Noir 的 Sardegna 名称。

body.en: Red, rosato, Riserva, Classico, Passito and Liquoroso.
body.zh: 红、桃红、Riserva、Classico、风干及加强型。

body.en: Maximum 11 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 11 吨／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.en: Usually 70%; Passito maximum 55%.
body.zh: 通常 70%，Passito 最高 55%。

body.en: At least two years, including six months in wood.
body.zh: 至少两年，其中六个月木桶。

body.en: At least two years, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 至少两年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: Minimum actual alcohol 18% for Secco, 16% for Dolce; at least six months in wood.
body.zh: Secco 实际酒精至少 18%，Dolce 至少 16%，木桶至少六个月。

role.zh: Cannonau 至少 85%，Classico 至少 90%。

body.en: Mountain-foot Nebbiolo PDO at the Aosta Valley border.
body.zh: Aosta Valley 边界山前 Nebbiolo PDO。

body.en: DOC since 1967.

body.en: Picutener and Pugnet are local Nebbiolo forms, not automatically separate cultivars.

body.en: Monte Maletto slopes at approximately 350–700 metres.
body.zh: Monte Maletto 坡地，约 350–700 米。

body.en: Stone structures absorb daytime heat and release it at night.
body.zh: 石结构白天吸热、夜间释放。

body.en: Morainic rocks and dry-stone terraces.
body.zh: 冰碛岩石与干砌石梯田。

body.en: Nebbiolo is the defining grape.
body.zh: Nebbiolo 为核心葡萄。

body.en: Pergolas stand on tapered stone pillars.
body.zh: 棚架由渐细石柱支撑。

body.en: 24 months, including 12 in oak or chestnut.
body.zh: 24 个月，含 12 个月橡木或栗木。

body.en: 36 months, including 12 in wood.
body.zh: 36 个月，含 12 个月木质容器。

body.en: Vinification and ageing zone includes Carema and Ivery in Pont-Saint-Martin as specified.
body.zh: 指定酿造熟成区包括 Carema 与 Pont-Saint-Martin 的 Ivery。

body.en: Required oak/chestnut vessels have a maximum capacity of 40 hl in the consortium account.
body.zh: 协会说明规定橡木／栗木容器最高 40 百升。

body.en: Cantina dei Produttori Nebbiolo di Carema lists a 100% Nebbiolo oak-aged wine.
body.zh: Cantina dei Produttori Nebbiolo di Carema 列有 100% Nebbiolo 橡木熟成酒。

role.en: Regional grape; see its specific PDO and cultivation record.

intro.zh: Sardegna 西南部 Carignano DOC，Superiore 有具体灌木藤及熟化要求。

body.en: Carignano del Sulcis DOC
body.zh: Carignano del Sulcis DOC

body.en: DOC established in 1977.
body.zh: DOC 建于 1977 年。

body.en: Sulcis in southwestern Sardegna.
body.zh: Sardegna 西南部 Sulcis。

body.en: Carignano is the local name of Carignan.
body.zh: Carignano 为 Carignan 当地名称。

body.en: Carignano at least 85%.
body.zh: Carignano 至少 85%。

body.en: Other suitable black grapes may make up the balance.
body.zh: 余量可用其他获准黑葡萄。

body.en: Rosso, Rosato, Novello, Riserva, Superiore and Passito.
body.zh: 红、桃红、新酒、珍藏、Superiore、风干。

body.en: Up to 11 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 11 吨／公顷。

body.en: Up to 7.5 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 7.5 吨／公顷。

body.en: Alberello or supported alberello.
body.zh: 灌木式或有支撑灌木式。

body.en: At least two years ageing, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: 至少两年，其中瓶陈至少六个月。

body.en: Natural drying, with permitted partial dehydration by ventilation.
body.zh: 自然风干，可用通风进行部分脱水。

body.en: Maximum 50%.
Minimum total alcohol 13%.

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 16%, actual 14%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 16%，实际 14%。

body.en: Minimum six months, including three months in bottle.
body.zh: 至少六个月，其中瓶陈三个月。

role.zh: Carignano 至少 85%。

intro.en: Historic Tuscan red blending Sangiovese with a required Cabernet component, centred on Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano.
intro.zh: 历史托斯卡纳红酒，将 Sangiovese 与必需 Cabernet 组分结合，以 Carmignano、Poggio a Caiano 为中心。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Carmignano was among the territories delimited by Cosimo III’s wine decree.
body.zh: Carmignano 是 Cosimo III 葡萄酒法令划界地区之一。

body.en: The local Cabernet tradition predates the modern Super Tuscan movement.
body.zh: 当地 Cabernet 传统早于现代 Super Tuscan 潮流。

body.en: Hills of Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano, Prato province.
body.zh: Prato 省 Carmignano 与 Poggio a Caiano 丘陵。

body.en: Western side of the Florence–Prato area, around the Montalbano hills.
body.zh: Florence–Prato 一带西侧，环绕 Montalbano 丘陵。

body.en: At least 50%.
Cabernet Sauvignon and/or Cabernet Franc: 10–20%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 和／或 Cabernet Franc 为10–20%。

body.en: Canaiolo Nero at most 20%.
body.zh: Canaiolo Nero 最多20%。

body.en: Eligible soils derive from alberese marly limestone, Eocene clay schists and Oligocene sandstone.
body.zh: 合资格土壤源自 alberese 泥灰质石灰岩、始新世黏土片岩及渐新世砂岩。

body.en: Eligible hillside vineyards lie no higher than 400 m.
body.zh: 合资格坡地葡萄园海拔不超过400米。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 8 t/ha; maximum wine recovery 70%.
body.zh: 葡萄产量每公顷最多8吨；出酒率最多70%。

body.en: Emergency irrigation is permitted; forcing practices are prohibited.
body.zh: 允许救急灌溉；禁止催产措施。

body.en: At least eight months in oak and/or chestnut; Riserva requires at least twelve months.
body.zh: 橡木及／或栗木桶至少8个月；Riserva 至少12个月。

body.en: Vinification, compulsory ageing and bottling take place in Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano.
body.zh: 酿造、强制陈年及装瓶在 Carmignano 与 Poggio a Caiano 进行。

body.en: Standard: 1 June in the second year after harvest; Riserva: 29 September in the third year after harvest.
body.zh: 基础酒为采收后第二年的6月1日；Riserva 为采收后第三年的9月29日。

body.en: Trebbiano Toscano, Canaiolo Bianco and Malvasia del Chianti together may total up to 10%; other authorised black grapes may contribute up to 10%.
body.zh: Trebbiano Toscano、Canaiolo Bianco、Malvasia del Chianti 合计最多10%；其他许可黑葡萄最多10%。

body.en: Barco Reale di Carmignano is a separate DOC.
body.zh: Barco Reale di Carmignano 是独立 DOC。

body.en: The local rosé tradition belongs to the related Carmignano wine family, not the red DOCG type.
body.zh: 当地桃红传统属于相关 Carmignano 酒系，并非红酒 DOCG 酒型。

role.zh: 必需 Cabernet 组。
必需 Cabernet 组。
辅助葡萄。

body.zh: Trieste、Gorizia 两省划定区域，近斯洛文尼亚。

body.zh: 亚得里亚海岸上方喀斯特台地及坡地。

body.en: Coastal proximity and exposed plateau sites create varied conditions.
body.zh: 海岸邻近性及开放台地造成多样条件。

body.en: Karst limestone and pockets of red clay-rich terra rossa.
body.zh: 喀斯特石灰岩及局部富黏土红色 terra rossa。

body.en: Vitovska and Malvasia Istriana are local references.
body.zh: Vitovska、Malvasia Istriana 为本地参照。

body.en: Terrano is the local red identity linked to Teran.
body.zh: Terrano 为与 Teran 对应的本地红品种。

body.en: Wines from this geographical landscape may carry DOC or other legally eligible labels.
body.zh: 该地理景观中的酒可依法使用 DOC 或其他标签。

body.en: Both direct pressing and producer-specific skin maceration occur.
body.zh: 存在直接压榨及部分酒庄浸皮风格。

body.en: Maceration can deepen white-wine colour; it is not mandatory for all Carso wines.
body.zh: 浸皮可加深白酒颜色，并非所有 Carso 酒强制。

body.en: Standard and Riserva; not the same as a similarly named provincial subzone of another DOC.
body.zh: 常规、Riserva；不同于其他 DOC 同名省级子区。

body.en: One year including two months in bottle, from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起一年，其中两月瓶陈。

body.en: Three years including one year wood and two months bottle, from the same date.
body.zh: 同日起三年，其中一年木桶、两月瓶陈。

body.en: Maximum 70%; enrichment is prohibited.
body.zh: 最高 70%，禁止 enrichment。

body.en: Dry red fruit, spice and tannic structure; standard total alcohol minimum 12.5%.
body.zh: 干型红果、香料、单宁结构；常规总酒精最低 12.5%。

body.en: Hills in Gorizia province along the Slovenian frontier.
body.zh: Gorizia 省沿斯洛文尼亚边境丘陵。

body.en: Distinct from the adjoining Friuli Colli Orientali DOC.
body.zh: 区别于邻近 Friuli Colli Orientali DOC。

body.en: Eocene marl and sandstone layers form the local ponca.
body.zh: 始新世泥灰岩、砂岩层构成本地 ponca。

body.en: Friulano, Ribolla Gialla and Malvasia Istriana are regional references.
body.zh: Friulano、Ribolla Gialla、Malvasia Istriana 为地方参照。

body.en: Sauvignon, Pinot Gris, Pinot Blanc and Chardonnay also contribute.

body.zh: Collio Bianco 中 Müller-Thurgau、Traminer Aromatico 合计最多 15%。

body.en: Pressed whites coexist with producer-specific skin-contact expressions.
body.zh: 直接压榨白酒与部分酒庄浸皮风格并存。

body.en: Vessel and maturation choices differ among producers.
body.zh: 容器及熟成选择因酒庄而异。

body.en: The consortium suggests 10–12°C for Collio Bianco.
body.zh: 协会为 Collio Bianco 建议 10–12°C。

body.en: Collio is an origin, not a synonym for orange wine.
body.zh: Collio 是产地，不是橙酒同义词。

body.zh: Conegliano 与 Valdobbiadene 之间十五市镇。

body.en: Steep, closely spaced hills distinguish this origin from the wider DOC plain.
body.zh: 陡峭密集丘陵有别于广域 DOC 平原。

body.en: A 107-hectare delimited hill area in Valdobbiadene.
body.zh: Valdobbiadene 内划定的 107 公顷丘陵区。

body.en: San Pietro di Barbozza, Santo Stefano and Saccol.
body.zh: San Pietro di Barbozza、Santo Stefano、Saccol。

body.en: Glera is the principal variety; traditional local complements contribute to blends.
body.zh: Glera 为主，传统本地辅助品种参与混酿。

body.en: Verdiso and Glera Lunga are separate grape identities.
body.zh: Verdiso、Glera Lunga 各为独立品种。

body.en: Forty-three specified Rive origins are recognised.
body.zh: 认可四十三个指定 Rive 产地。

body.en: Rive wines require hand harvesting and vintage indication.
body.zh: Rive 要求手工采收、标年份。

body.en: Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze is a specifically delimited expression.
body.zh: Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze 为指定划区表达。

body.en: Pressure fermentation preserves floral and fresh-fruit expression.
body.zh: 压力二次发酵保留花香与清新果香。

body.en: Rive identifies a named origin; it is not a separate grape.
body.zh: Rive 标明具体产地，并非品种。

body.en: Brut and Extra Dry are dosage categories, not geographical quality ranks.
body.zh: Brut、Extra Dry 为甜度类别，非地理质量等级。

intro.zh: Lepini 山麓产区，Bellone 与 Nero Buono 地位突出。

body.en: DOC

body.en: Lazio
body.zh: Lazio

body.en: Bianco and Rosso, plus named Bellone and Nero Buono.
body.zh: Bianco、Rosso，以及 Bellone、Nero Buono 品种型。

body.en: Cori is a denomination; Nero Buono is the grape often qualified “di Cori”.
body.zh: Cori 是产区，Nero Buono 为常加“di Cori”的葡萄名称。

body.en: All Cori and part of Cisterna di Latina.
body.zh: Cori 全境及 Cisterna di Latina 部分地区。

body.en: Vine-growing land ranges approximately 40–463 m.
body.zh: 葡萄种植地约40至463米。

body.en: Marine carbonate materials associated with the Lepini foothills.
body.zh: 与 Lepini 山麓相关的海相碳酸盐材料。

body.en: Hill sites are important to the local Bellone and Nero Buono tradition.
body.zh: 丘陵地块是 Bellone、Nero Buono 地方传统的重要基础。

body.en: Minimum 50% Bellone, 20% Malvasia del Lazio and 15% Greco.
body.zh: Bellone 至少50%、Malvasia del Lazio 至少20%、Greco 至少15%。

body.en: Minimum 50% Nero Buono, 20% Montepulciano and 15% Cesanese.
body.zh: Nero Buono 至少50%、Montepulciano 至少20%、Cesanese 至少15%。

body.en: At least 85% Bellone.
body.zh: 至少85% Bellone。

body.en: At least 85% Nero Buono.
body.zh: 至少85% Nero Buono。

intro.en: Salerno coastal DOC with Furore, Ravello and Tramonti subzones and a remarkable surviving local grape heritage.
intro.zh: Salerno 海岸 DOC，含 Furore、Ravello、Tramonti 子区，并保留重要地方葡萄遗产。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC established on 10 August 1995; the specification was subsequently amended, including in 2011.
body.zh: 1995 年 8 月 10 日设 DOC，之后包括 2011 年有规范修订。

body.en: Furore, Ravello and Tramonti have separate delimited subzones.
body.zh: Furore、Ravello、Tramonti 各有独立划界子区。

body.en: Furore includes steep sea-facing terraces; Tramonti lies farther inland. They should not be treated as one uniform growing environment.
body.zh: Furore 有陡峭向海梯田，Tramonti 更偏内陆，不应视为统一种植环境。

body.en: Marisa Cuomo documents dolomitic limestone at 200–550 m with southern exposure for Fiorduva.
body.zh: Marisa Cuomo 注明 Fiorduva 地块为白云质石灰岩、海拔 200–550 米、南向。

body.en: Basic white, passito and sparkling, and Ravello/Tramonti whites, require Falanghina and/or Biancolella at least 40%. Furore has a separate white formula.
body.zh: 基础白、Passito、起泡及 Ravello/Tramonti 白酒要求 Falanghina 和／或 Biancolella 至少 40%；Furore 白酒另有配方。

body.en: Fenile, Ginestra, Ripolo and Pepella are important white-grape references; Tintore is closely associated with Tramonti.
body.zh: Fenile、Ginestra、Ripolo、Pepella 为重要地方白葡萄参照；Tintore 紧密关联 Tramonti。

body.en: Fiorduva vineyards employ pergola/raggiera and espalier systems on terraces; the estate reports very late harvest into late October.
body.zh: Fiorduva 梯田采用 pergola/raggiera 与篱架；酒庄注明非常晚采，至 10 月下旬。

body.en: White, white Passito and Spumante, red, red Passito and rosé are distinguished in the specification.
body.zh: 法规区分白酒、白 Passito、Spumante、红酒、红 Passito 与桃红。

body.en: 30% Fenile, 30% Ginestra and 40% Ripoli; this wine-specific blend must not replace the general DOC rules.
body.zh: 30% Fenile、30% Ginestra、40% Ripoli；该酒特定配比不可替代全 DOC 规范。

body.en: Super-ripe grapes, low-temperature fermentation in oak barrels and approximately three months fermentation are producer-reported choices.
body.zh: 过熟葡萄、橡木桶低温发酵、约三个月发酵期，均为酒庄所述选择。

body.en: Compare richness, acidity and oak influence independently; Fiorduva represents a concentrated premium style within a broader denomination.
body.zh: 分别判断饱满度、酸度与橡木；Fiorduva 是广泛法定区内的浓缩高端风格实例。

role.zh: 主要白葡萄组成。

body.zh: 南部 Langhe 的 Dolcetto 干红 DOCG。

body.zh: Dogliani 档案保存 1593 年提名 Dolcetto 的记录。

body.en: DOC 1974; DOCG 2005.
body.zh: 1974 DOC；2005 DOCG。

body.en: Dry Dolcetto DOCG in the southern Langhe.
body.zh: 南部 Langhe 的 Dolcetto 干红 DOCG。

body.en: Dogliani archives preserve a named Dolcetto reference from 1593.
body.zh: Dogliani 档案保存 1593 年提名 Dolcetto 的记录。

body.en: DOC 1974; DOCG 2005.
body.zh: 1974 DOC；2005 DOCG。

body.en: Dogliani, Farigliano and Clavesana are central references.
body.zh: Dogliani、Farigliano、Clavesana 为核心参考。

body.en: Higher, cooler southern Langhe near the Ligurian Apennines and Maritime Alps.
body.zh: 靠近 Ligurian Apennines 与 Maritime Alps 的较高、较凉南部 Langhe。

body.en: Former seabed ridges were shaped into branching hills by rivers.
body.zh: 古海床山脊经河流塑造成分支丘陵。

body.en: 100% Dolcetto.
body.zh: 100% Dolcetto。

body.en: 8 t/ha; Superiore 7 t/ha.
body.zh: 8 吨/公顷；Superiore 7 吨/公顷。

body.en: 7.2 t/ha; Superiore Vigna 6.3 t/ha at full vineyard maturity.
body.zh: 完全成熟葡萄园 7.2 吨/公顷；Superiore Vigna 6.3 吨/公顷。

body.en: 12 months from 15 October of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 10 月 15 日起 12 个月。

body.en: Not before 1 November following harvest.
body.zh: 不得早于采收翌年 11 月 1 日。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12%; Superiore 13%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 12%；Superiore 13%。

body.en: Named MGA identify delimited places; 76 were formalised in 2018.
body.zh: MGA 标示划定地点；2018 年正式确立 76 个。

body.en: Enrichment is prohibited for Superiore.
body.zh: Superiore 禁止增浓。

body.en: Deep ruby, dark fruit, dry palate and characteristic almond finish.
body.zh: 深宝石红、深色水果、干型口感及典型杏仁收尾。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

intro.en: Western Ligurian dry red based on Rossese.
intro.zh: Liguria 西部 Rossese 主导干红。

body.en: Western Ligurian dry red based on Rossese.
body.zh: Liguria 西部 Rossese 主导干红。

body.en: Recognised in 1972.
Inland western Liguria near the French border.

body.en: Western Ligurian dry red based on Rossese.
body.zh: Liguria 西部 Rossese 主导干红。

body.en: Recognised in 1972.

body.zh: 至少 95% Rossese。

body.en: At most 5% other permitted red grapes.
body.zh: 其他获准红葡萄最多 5%。

body.en: Minimum 13% for Superiore.
body.zh: Superiore 最低 13%。

body.en: Not before 1 November of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 不得早于采收翌年 11 月 1 日。

body.en: Dry still red; Superiore combines higher alcohol and later release requirements.
body.zh: 干型静止红，Superiore 有较高酒精及延后上市要求。

body.en: Rossese red links to Tibouren; Rossese Bianco is not automatically a colour form of the same grape.
body.zh: Rossese 红葡萄关联 Tibouren，Rossese Bianco 不能自动视为同一葡萄颜色类型。

role.en: Regional grape; see its specific PDO and cultivation record.
role.zh: 地区葡萄，具体 PDO 及栽培情况见关联档案。

intro.en: Northern region spanning Emilian plains and foothills, Romagna hills and the Adriatic coast.
intro.zh: 北部大区，跨 Emilia 平原山麓、Romagna 丘陵及亚得里亚海岸。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Emilian Lambrusco districts differ from Romagna’s Albana and Sangiovese traditions.
body.zh: Emilia Lambrusco 区域不同于 Romagna Albana、Sangiovese 传统。

body.en: Multiple varieties and DOCs, not one grape or sweetness level.
body.zh: 涉及多个品种及 DOC，非一种葡萄或固定甜度。

body.en: The regional register documents rare Maligia, Sgavetta and Uva Tosca.
body.zh: 大区名录记录稀有 Maligia、Sgavetta、Uva Tosca。

body.en: Centesimino and Famoso exemplify recovered Romagna varieties.
body.zh: Centesimino、Famoso 展示 Romagna 品种复兴。

body.en: Modena and Reggio Emilia include plains and Apennine foothills.
body.zh: Modena、Reggio Emilia 包含平原及亚平宁山麓。

body.en: Romagna Albana covers parts of Bologna, Ravenna and Forlì-Cesena.
body.zh: Romagna Albana 覆盖 Bologna、Ravenna、Forlì-Cesena 部分地区。

body.en: Hot summers and foggy winters characterize the consortium’s plain-land account.
body.zh: 协会平原描述为炎夏及多雾冬季。

body.en: Uva Tosca needs favourable exposure to ripen in Emilia’s mountain vineyards.
body.zh: Uva Tosca 在 Emilia 山地园需良好朝向成熟。

body.en: River sedimentation left sands, clays and calcareous deposits.
body.zh: 河流沉积留下砂、黏土及钙质沉积物。

body.en: Clay-rich foothills contrast with better-drained higher calcareous sand/gravel sites.
body.zh: 富黏土山麓与高处排水较佳钙质砂砾地对比。

body.en: Sorbara, Grasparossa, Salamino, Maestri, Marani and Viadanese are distinct.
body.zh: Sorbara、Grasparossa、Salamino、Maestri、Marani、Viadanese 各自独立。

body.en: Ancellotta provides anthocyanin colour and is not itself Lambrusco.
body.zh: Ancellotta 提供花色苷颜色，本身非 Lambrusco。

body.en: Fortana has a specific coastal sandy-soil association.
body.zh: Fortana 与海岸沙土有特别联系。

body.en: Romagna Albana DOCG requires at least 95% Albana.
body.zh: Romagna Albana DOCG 至少 95% Albana。

body.en: Sorbara, Grasparossa di Castelvetro, Salamino di Santa Croce, Modena and Reggiano have separate rules.
body.zh: 上述五种 DOC 各有独立规范。

body.en: Colli di Scandiano e di Canossa includes local white as well as Lambrusco types.
body.zh: Colli di Scandiano e di Canossa 也含本地白酒，并非仅 Lambrusco。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante span dry to sweet; pressure and sugar are separate variables.
body.zh: 微起泡及起泡可干至甜，压力与糖为不同变量。

body.en: Dry, sweeter and passito styles are possible; Albana is not only a dessert wine.
body.zh: 可酿干型、带甜及风干酒，并非仅甜酒。

body.en: Regional institutions and growers preserve minor varieties; registration does not prove broad acreage.
body.zh: 地方机构、种植者保育小众品种，登记不代表广泛面积。

body.en: Pietro Pianori’s recovery work is central to the Oriolo/Faenza story.
body.zh: Pietro Pianori 恢复工作是 Oriolo／Faenza 历史关键。

body.en: Sorbara is usually paler/lighter; Grasparossa has more body and tannin.
body.zh: Sorbara 通常更浅更轻，Grasparossa 酒体单宁更多。

body.en: Dry Sorbara is a traditional companion to salumi; verify sweetness first.
body.zh: 干型 Sorbara 传统搭配腌肉，须先确认甜度。

intro.en: A delimited volcanic-slope DOC with Carricante whites, Nerello-led reds/rosato and traditional-method sparkling wines.
intro.zh: 火山坡地划定 DOC，涵盖 Carricante 白酒、Nerello 主体红／桃红及传统法起泡酒。

body.en: Etna DOC
body.zh: Etna DOC

body.en: Catania; delimited parts of municipalities around the volcano.
body.zh: Catania 省，环火山市镇的划定部分。

body.en: Grapes must originate in the delimited zone of Milo.
body.zh: 葡萄须来自 Milo 的指定区域。

body.en: The DOC boundary follows commune, altitude and physical landscape lines; not every Etna vineyard is eligible.
body.zh: DOC 边界由市镇、等高线及实际地貌划定，并非 Etna 每块园均获准。

body.en: Volcanic deposits of different ages.
body.zh: 不同年代的火山沉积。

body.en: Lava flows and ash create marked local soil differences.
body.zh: 熔岩流及火山灰造成地块差异。

body.en: Altitude and slope aspect change ripening conditions around the volcano.
body.zh: 海拔与坡向改变火山周围的成熟条件。

body.en: Carricante ≥60%; Catarratto 0–40%; other suitable non-aromatic whites at most 15% of the total.
body.zh: Carricante 至少 60%，Catarratto 0–40%，其他获准非芳香白葡萄不超过总量 15%。

body.en: Carricante ≥80%; other suitable non-aromatic whites up to 20%.
body.zh: Carricante 至少 80%，其他获准非芳香白葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Nerello Mascalese ≥80%; Nerello Cappuccio 0–20%; permitted white grapes at most 10% overall.
body.zh: Nerello Mascalese 至少 80%，Nerello Cappuccio 0–20%，获准白葡萄最多占总量 10%。

body.en: Nerello Mascalese at least 80%.
body.zh: Nerello Mascalese 至少 80%。

body.en: Bottle fermentation; at least 18 months on lees.
body.zh: 瓶内二次发酵，酒泥陈年至少 18 个月。

body.en: At least four years ageing, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 至少四年陈年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: Carricante supplies pronounced acidity and ageing potential.
body.zh: Carricante 提供鲜明酸度及陈年潜力。

body.en: Nerello Mascalese supplies acidity and tannin; extraction and maturity shape balance.
body.zh: Nerello Mascalese 提供酸度与单宁，萃取及成熟度决定平衡。

body.en: Additional geographical names must correspond to the delimited units in the specification.
body.zh: 附加地理名称须对应规范所划定单位。

role.zh: 白酒至少 60%；Superiore 至少 80%。
红／桃红及起泡至少 80%。
红／桃红补充 0–20%。

role.zh: Etna 老混种园传统白品种，补充比例须依 DOC 规则。

body.zh: Campania

body.zh: 2011 年 9 月 30 日成为独立 DOC。

body.en: The production zone lies in Benevento province.
body.zh: 产区位于 Benevento 省。

body.en: Guardia Sanframondi or Guardiolo, Sant’Agata dei Goti, Solopaca and Taburno.
body.zh: Guardia Sanframondi 或 Guardiolo、Sant’Agata dei Goti、Solopaca、Taburno。

body.en: Falanghina at least 85%; other eligible non-aromatic Benevento white grapes up to 15%.
body.zh: Falanghina 至少 85%；Benevento 其他合资格非芳香白葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Falanghina Beneventana is the key inland reference. A legal mention of Falanghina alone should not be used to collapse it with Falanghina Flegrea.
body.zh: 内陆主要参照为 Falanghina Beneventana；法规单写 Falanghina 不应成为合并 Falanghina Flegrea 的依据。

body.en: Still white, Vendemmia Tardiva and Passito are separate authorized types.
body.zh: 静止白、Vendemmia Tardiva、Passito 是分别获准的类型。

body.en: Spumante, Spumante di Qualità and Spumante di Qualità Metodo Classico.
body.zh: Spumante、Spumante di Qualità、Spumante di Qualità Metodo Classico。

body.en: Tank fermentation is allowed for the ordinary and quality sparkling categories; Metodo Classico uses bottle fermentation.
body.zh: 普通及优质起泡类别允许罐式二发；Metodo Classico 使用瓶中二发。

body.en: Late harvest and dried-grape production create distinct concentration paths and must retain their specific category rules.
body.zh: 晚收及干化葡萄是不同浓缩路径，须保留各类型独立规范。

body.en: Assess still wine, sparkling wine and concentrated styles in separate flights, with sweetness and acidity considered together.
body.zh: 静止、起泡、浓缩风格分别品鉴，甜度与酸度结合判断。

role.zh: Sannio 主要身份；法规 Falanghina 至少 85%。

intro.en: Fiano-centred Irpinia DOCG, with still wines and traditional-method sparkling categories approved in 2025.
intro.zh: 以 Fiano 为核心的 Irpinia DOCG，含静止酒及 2025 年批准的传统法起泡类型。

body.en: DOCG / PDO
body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC in 1978 and DOCG in 2003.
body.zh: 1978 年 DOC，2003 年 DOCG。

body.en: Regulation 2025/1086 approved the Union amendment in June 2025; the earlier proposal date is not the approval date.
body.zh: 欧盟 2025/1086 号法规于 2025 年 6 月批准修订；较早提案日期不是批准日期。

body.en: Twenty-six communes in Avellino province, with contrasting altitude and exposure across inland Irpinia.
body.zh: Avellino 省二十六个市镇，Irpinia 内陆不同海拔、坡向形成差异。

body.en: Cold winters, spring frost risk, pronounced summer day–night variation and predominantly autumn/winter rainfall distinguish the inland hills.
body.zh: 寒冷冬季、春霜风险、明显夏季昼夜温差及秋冬为主降雨，构成内陆丘陵特征。

body.en: Ash and pumice deposits overlie clays or marls in parts of the area; sandstone, limestone, alluvial and detrital formations also occur.
body.zh: 部分地带灰、浮石覆盖黏土或泥灰岩；另有砂岩、石灰岩、冲积及碎屑层。

body.en: Fiano at least 85%.
body.zh: Fiano 至少 85%。

body.en: Greco, Coda di Volpe Bianca and Trebbiano Toscano may make up the permitted balance, collectively up to 15%.
body.zh: Greco、Coda di Volpe Bianca、Trebbiano Toscano 可合计占其余最多 15%。

body.en: New and replanted vineyards require vertical training and at least 2,500 vines/ha; maximum grape yield is 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 新植、重植园须垂直架式、至少 2,500 株/ha；葡萄最高 10 t/ha。

body.en: Well-exposed hills are eligible; humid or poorly sunny valley floors are excluded. Emergency irrigation is allowed.
body.zh: 允许朝向良好丘陵，排除潮湿或日照不足谷底；允许应急灌溉。

body.en: Still Fiano di Avellino and Riserva, plus Spumante Metodo Classico and Spumante Metodo Classico Riserva under the approved amendment.
body.zh: 静止 Fiano di Avellino、Riserva，以及批准修订后的 Spumante Metodo Classico、Spumante Metodo Classico Riserva。

body.en: Still wine requires total acidity at least 5 g/L and alcohol 11.5%, or 12% for Riserva. Sparkling requires acidity 6 g/L and alcohol 12%.
body.zh: 静止总酸至少 5 g/L、总酒精度 11.5%，Riserva 12%；起泡总酸 6 g/L、总酒精度 12%。

body.en: The traditional mention Apianum is permitted; it does not replace the protected denomination.
body.zh: 允许传统标示 Apianum，但不可取代受保护产区名。

body.en: The new categories use bottle fermentation by the traditional method, creating a different maturation framework from the still wine.
body.zh: 新增类型采用传统瓶中二次发酵，与静止酒有不同熟成框架。

body.en: Still Fiano can develop texture and bottle complexity; producer decisions on lees and vessels should be recorded bottle by bottle.
body.zh: 静止 Fiano 可发展质地与瓶陈复杂度；酒泥及容器选择须逐款记录酒庄资料。

body.en: At least twelve months from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少十二个月。

body.en: Bottle fermentation only; Spumante requires at least eighteen months from tirage, Spumante Riserva thirty-six months.
body.zh: 仅瓶中二发；Spumante 自装瓶二发起至少十八个月，Spumante Riserva 三十六个月。

body.en: Assess acidity, texture and development separately from oak influence; richer mature examples suit fuller dishes than youthful light styles.
body.zh: 酸度、质地、发展与橡木影响分开判断；饱满成熟酒款适合比清新年轻款更浓郁的菜肴。

role.zh: 允许辅助。

body.en: Clay-limestone and clay-sand hillside soils.
body.zh: 丘陵黏土石灰质及黏土砂质土。

body.zh: Freisa ≥90%；获准非芳香红葡萄 ≤10%。

body.zh: 干旱敏感性使过干向阳地块成为挑战。

body.en: Hillside vineyards with suitable orientation; avoid unsuitable valley sites.
body.zh: 合适坡向丘陵葡萄园；避开不适宜谷地。

body.en: At least six months in wood under the 2021 rules.

body.en: The older consortium PDF’s 100% requirement is superseded by the 2021 amendment.

body.en: The Tagliamento and other Alpine rivers shaped the alluvial landscape.
body.zh: Tagliamento 等阿尔卑斯河流塑造冲积地貌。

body.en: Gravel-rich river deposits give the denomination its name.
body.zh: 富砾石河流沉积形成产区名称。

body.en: Gravel depth and finer sediment vary across the broad plain.
body.zh: 广阔平原的砾石深度、细沉积物比例不同。

body.en: Friulano and Verduzzo Friulano occur alongside international whites.

body.en: Pinot Gris, Chardonnay and Sauvignon are important references.

body.en: Collio and Friuli Colli Orientali are separate DOCs within the region.
body.zh: Collio、Friuli Colli Orientali 是大区内不同 DOC。

body.en: Dry whites, local reds, sweet whites and skin-contact wines coexist.
body.zh: 干白、本地红、甜白及浸皮酒并存。

body.en: DOC recognition in 1968.
body.zh: 1968 年获得 DOC。

body.en: DOCG recognition in 2001, not 2011.

body.en: Collio is around Gorizia; Colli Orientali lies in Udine province.
body.zh: Collio 在 Gorizia 周边，Colli Orientali 位于 Udine 省。

body.en: The Trieste Karst has Vitovska, Malvasia Istriana and Terrano traditions.
body.zh: Trieste 喀斯特有 Vitovska、Malvasia Istriana、Terrano 传统。

body.en: Monte Bernadia shelters south-facing, rainy hill sites around Nimis and Tarcento.
body.zh: Monte Bernadia 保护 Nimis、Tarcento 周边向南且多雨丘陵。

body.en: Hill exposure and drainage matter; regional plains and steep terraces are not equivalent sites.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向及排水重要，平原与陡坡梯田并非等同。

body.en: Eocene marl and sandstone flysch underpins the Collio reference.
body.zh: Collio 参照地质为始新世泥灰岩、砂岩 flysch。

body.en: Limestone and red residual soils occur in the Karst plateau.
body.zh: Karst 高原有石灰岩及红色残积土。

body.en: Friulano, Ribolla Gialla, Picolit and Verduzzo Friulano are distinct.
body.zh: Friulano、Ribolla Gialla、Picolit、Verduzzo Friulano 各自独立。

body.en: Pignolo, Schioppettino, Tazzelenghe and Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso are separate.
body.zh: Pignolo、Schioppettino、Tazzelenghe、Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso 须分开。

body.zh: ERSA 记录 Cividin、Cjanorie、Cordenossa、Sagrestana 材料。

body.en: Rosazzo DOCG is a dry white blend, separate from Ribolla Gialla di Rosazzo DOC type.
body.zh: Rosazzo DOCG 是干白混酿，不同于 Ribolla Gialla di Rosazzo DOC 类型。

body.en: Gorizia, Pordenone, Trieste and Udine fall within Prosecco DOC.
body.zh: Gorizia、Pordenone、Trieste、Udine 纳入 Prosecco DOC。

body.en: Colli Orientali del Friuli Picolit is a separate DOCG established in 2006.
body.zh: Colli Orientali del Friuli Picolit 为 2006 年成立的独立 DOCG。

body.en: Sweet 100% Verduzzo Friulano; optional grape drying and wood vessels are regulated.
body.zh: 100% Verduzzo Friulano 甜酒，风干及木容器按规范可用。

body.zh: Zidarich Vitovska 展示带皮发酵及橡木，不代表全部本地白酒。

body.zh: Livio Felluga 管理修道院园，酿 Friulano 为主白酒。

body.en: Emilio Bulfon is a reference for recovered varieties including Cividin and Cjanorie.
body.zh: Emilio Bulfon 为 Cividin、Cjanorie 等恢复品种参照。

body.en: The consortium suggests 10–12°C.
body.zh: 协会建议 10–12°C。

body.en: Verduzzo Trevigiano cannot be substituted for Ramandolo’s Verduzzo Friulano.
body.zh: Verduzzo Trevigiano 不能替代 Ramandolo 的 Verduzzo Friulano。

body.zh: 官方描述为干型、和谐、有单宁。

body.en: Fresh, dry and fruity when young.
body.zh: 年轻时清新、干型、果味明显。

body.en: Dry white with delicate fruit.
body.zh: 果香细致的干白。

body.en: May be slightly amabile, but sugar must not exceed 10 g/L.
body.zh: 可略呈 amabile，但糖不得超过 10 g/L。

body.en: Primitivo may develop a softer, more velvety texture with age.
body.zh: Primitivo 陈年后可更柔润。

body.en: The 100% rule applies to the Primitivo category, not every red wine from this DOC.
body.zh: 100% 规则适用于 Primitivo 酒型，而非本 DOC 每一款红酒。

role.zh: 标 Primitivo 酒为 100%，普通红／桃红为 50–60%。
Aleatico 酒型至少 85%。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: A small Ionian passito DOC around Bianco, based on an aromatic Malvasia identity.
intro.zh: Bianco 周围的小型爱奥尼亚海岸风干甜酒 DOC，以芳香型 Malvasia 身份葡萄为基础。

body.en: Greco di Bianco DOC
body.zh: Greco di Bianco DOC

body.en: Bianco in Reggio Calabria.
body.zh: Reggio Calabria 的 Bianco。

body.en: Bianco and the specified part of Casignana.
body.zh: Bianco 及 Casignana 的指定部分。

body.en: Ionian coast of the Locride.
body.zh: Locride 的爱奥尼亚海岸。

body.en: Greco Bianco at least 95% in the specification.
body.zh: 规范中的 Greco Bianco 至少 95%。

body.en: The local aromatic grape corresponds to Malvasia di Lipari/Malvasia di Sardegna.
body.zh: 当地芳香葡萄对应 Malvasia di Lipari／Malvasia di Sardegna。

body.en: Up to 5% suitable grapes of analogous colour.
body.zh: 最多 5% 获准同色葡萄。

body.en: Local aromatic Greco di Bianco matures in the second/third ten-day period of August.
body.zh: 地方芳香型 Greco di Bianco 于八月中下旬成熟。

body.en: Large, elongated and loose, with relatively small berries.
body.zh: 果穗长大疏松、果粒相对小。

body.en: Sensitive to cold and drought; powdery mildew and moths require attention.
body.zh: 对寒冷及干旱敏感，注意白粉病与葡萄蛾。

body.en: Grapes dry on racks in the sun or in forced-air drying rooms.
body.zh: 葡萄在日晒架上或强制通风室中干燥。

body.en: Dried grapes are crushed and pressed.
body.zh: 风干后破碎、压榨。

body.en: Passito; drying alone does not imply fortification.
body.zh: 风干甜酒，干燥本身不等于加烈。

body.en: Not before 1 November following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 11 月 1 日。

body.en: Straw yellow with amber reflections.
body.zh: 稻草黄带琥珀色泽。

body.en: Orange blossom, dried figs, candied citrus and honeyed warmth.
body.zh: 橙花、无花果干、糖渍柑橘及蜂蜜般暖润感。

role.en: Local Greco di Bianco identity; legal minimum 95%.
role.zh: 当地 Greco di Bianco 身份，法定最低 95%。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: Greco-led still and traditional-method sparkling DOCG in the Sabato valley of Irpinia.
intro.zh: Irpinia Sabato 河谷，以 Greco 为主的静止及传统法起泡 DOCG。

body.en: DOCG / PDO
body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC recognized in 1970; DOCG in 2003.
body.zh: 1970 年认可 DOC，2003 年升级 DOCG。

body.en: Tufo, Altavilla Irpina, Chianche, Montefusco, Prata di Principato Ultra, Petruro Irpino, Santa Paolina and Torrioni, all in Avellino province.
body.zh: Tufo、Altavilla Irpina、Chianche、Montefusco、Prata di Principato Ultra、Petruro Irpino、Santa Paolina、Torrioni，均位于 Avellino 省。

body.en: The Sabato river and surrounding hills organize the production area.
body.zh: Sabato 河及周边丘陵构成产区地理骨架。

body.en: Clay-calcareous materials and volcanic contributions vary across the hills; the place-name alone does not establish identical tuff soils everywhere.
body.zh: 丘陵中黏土石灰质母质与火山物质影响各异；地名本身不能证明所有地块都是相同凝灰岩土。

body.en: Greco at least 85%; Coda di Volpe Bianca may supply up to 15%.
body.zh: Greco 至少 85%；Coda di Volpe Bianca 可占最多 15%。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 葡萄最高产量 10 t/ha。

body.en: Still Greco di Tufo, still Riserva, Spumante and Spumante Riserva.
body.zh: 静止 Greco di Tufo、静止 Riserva、Spumante、Spumante Riserva。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 11.5% for standard wine and 12% for Riserva; minimum total acidity 5 g/L.
body.zh: 标准酒最低总酒精度 11.5%，Riserva 12%；总酸最低 5 g/L。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12% and total acidity 6 g/L for the sparkling categories.
body.zh: 起泡类型最低总酒精度 12%，总酸 6 g/L。

body.en: At least twelve months of ageing from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少十二个月熟成。

body.en: Bottle fermentation by the traditional method is compulsory; tank fermentation is not the approved alternative.
body.zh: 必须传统瓶中二次发酵，罐式法不是获准替代方法。

body.en: At least eighteen months from tirage for Spumante, thirty-six months for Spumante Riserva.
body.zh: Spumante 自装瓶二发起至少十八个月；Spumante Riserva 三十六个月。

body.en: Compare still and sparkling wines separately: acidity is shared, while pressure, lees development and texture distinguish the styles.
body.zh: 静止与起泡应分别比较：均重视酸度，但气压、酒泥发展与质地不同。

role.zh: 允许辅助最多 15%。

sources.title: MASAF · approved Greco di Tufo specification, 2020

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.
coverage.zh: 依据一手资料的区域概览与精选关联产区，非所有获准葡萄或葡萄酒名称的穷尽清单。

intro.en: Dry red DOC from the Asti hills, distinct from Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese.
intro.zh: Asti 丘陵干红 DOC，独立于 Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese。

body.en: Dry red DOC from the Asti hills, distinct from Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese.
body.zh: Asti 丘陵干红 DOC，独立于 Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese。

body.en: DOC recognition on 29 May 1973.
body.zh: 1973 年 5 月 29 日获 DOC。

body.en: Grignòle, the dialect word for seeds, is a proposed rather than certain etymology.
body.zh: 方言种子词 grignòle 为提出的词源，并非定论。

body.en: Dry red DOC from the Asti hills, distinct from Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese.
body.zh: Asti 丘陵干红 DOC，独立于 Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese。

body.en: DOC recognition on 29 May 1973.
body.zh: 1973 年 5 月 29 日获 DOC。

body.en: Grignòle, the dialect word for seeds, is a proposed rather than certain etymology.
body.zh: 方言种子词 grignòle 为提出的词源，并非定论。

body.en: Delimited Asti communes including Asti, Moncalvo, Portacomaro and Castagnole Monferrato.
body.zh: 划定 Asti 市镇，含 Asti、Moncalvo、Portacomaro、Castagnole Monferrato。

body.en: The grape’s historical heartland lies between Asti and Casale.
body.zh: 品种历史核心地介于 Asti 与 Casale。

body.en: Grignolino ≥90%; Freisa ≤10%.
body.zh: Grignolino ≥90%；Freisa ≤10%。

body.en: Hillsides only, with suitable orientation.
body.zh: 仅限合适坡向丘陵。

body.en: Maximum 8 t/ha.
body.zh: 最高 8 吨/公顷。

body.en: Minimum natural alcohol potential 10.5%.
body.zh: 最低天然潜在酒精度 10.5%。

body.en: Grape-to-wine yield ≤65%, equivalent to 52 hl/ha.
body.zh: 葡萄成酒率 ≤65%，相当于 52 百升/公顷。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 11%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 11%。

body.en: Vintage mandatory; Superiore is not an authorised category.
body.zh: 必须标年份；Superiore 非获准类别。

body.en: Vinification in Asti province; traditional neighbouring-province authorisations may apply.
body.zh: Asti 省内酿造；可有传统邻省授权例外。

body.en: Pale ruby, pepper and fruit; dry, tannic, persistent bitter-edged finish.
body.zh: 浅宝石红、胡椒及水果；干型、有单宁，持久微苦收尾。

body.en: Low colour intensity should not be mistaken for absence of tannin.
body.zh: 颜色浅不代表缺乏单宁。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

intro.en: Island DOC off Naples, with distinctive Biancolella–Forastera white blends and local red varieties.
intro.zh: Napoli 外海岛屿 DOC，以 Biancolella—Forastera 白葡萄配比与地方红葡萄为特色。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC recognized on 3 March 1966.
body.zh: 1966 年 3 月 3 日认可 DOC。

body.en: The production area is the island of Ischia in Naples province.
body.zh: 产区为 Napoli 省 Ischia 岛。

body.en: Volcanic island slopes are central. Casa D’Ambra documents vineyards from 100–500 m for its Ischia Bianco.
body.zh: 火山岛坡地为核心；Casa D’Ambra 记录其 Ischia Bianco 葡萄园海拔 100–500 米。

body.en: Forastera 45–70%, Biancolella 30–55%, with other eligible white grapes up to 15%.
body.zh: Forastera 45–70%，Biancolella 30–55%，其他合资格白葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Guarnaccia 40–50%, Piedirosso 40–50%, with eligible red complements up to 15%. Guarnaccia identity remains a separate register task.
body.zh: Guarnaccia 40–50%，Piedirosso 40–50%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 15%；Guarnaccia 身份另待登记册核对。

body.en: Named Biancolella, Forastera and Piedirosso wines require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: 标示 Biancolella、Forastera、Piedirosso 的酒须至少含相应葡萄 85%。

body.en: Casa D’Ambra describes low trellis with Guyot pruning for its Ischia Bianco vineyards; this is a producer example.
body.zh: Casa D’Ambra 的 Ischia Bianco 葡萄园注明低架 Guyot 修剪；属酒庄实例。

body.en: Bianco, including Superiore and Spumante, Rosso and named varietal wines; Piedirosso also has a Passito type.
body.zh: Bianco 含 Superiore、Spumante，另有 Rosso 与品种酒；Piedirosso 另设 Passito。

body.en: Casa D’Ambra Ischia Bianco uses equal parts Biancolella and Forastera, a specific compliant blend rather than the general DOC formula.
body.zh: Casa D’Ambra Ischia Bianco 为 Biancolella、Forastera 各半，属符合法规的具体配比，而非全部 DOC 的固定配方。

body.en: Compare the two-grape Ischia Bianco with the producer’s Biancolella to study blend effect and varietal expression.
body.zh: 对比同庄双品种 Ischia Bianco 与 Biancolella，可研究混酿作用及品种表达。

role.zh: 基础白 30–55%；品种酒至少 85%。
基础白 45–70%；品种酒至少 85%。
基础红 40–50%；品种酒至少 85%。

note.en: Equal Biancolella and Forastera.
note.zh: Biancolella、Forastera 各半。

note.en: Estate Biancolella reference.
note.zh: 酒庄 Biancolella 参照。

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.
coverage.zh: 依据一手资料的区域概览与精选关联产区，非所有获准葡萄或葡萄酒名称的穷尽清单。

intro.en: Aromatic red denomination near Ancona, based on Lacrima with rose and violet perfume.
intro.zh: Ancona 附近芳香红酒产区，以 Lacrima 为基础，具玫瑰紫罗兰香。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Marche
body.zh: Marche

body.en: DOC recognised in 1985.
body.zh: 1985年获 DOC。

body.en: Standard, Superiore and Passito.
body.zh: 基础、Superiore、Passito。

body.en: Between the Cesano and Esino rivers, within about 20 km of the Adriatic.
body.zh: 位于 Cesano 与 Esino 河之间，距亚得里亚海约20公里内。

body.en: Morro d’Alba, Monte San Vito, San Marcello, Belvedere Ostrense, Ostra and Senigallia.
body.zh: Morro d’Alba、Monte San Vito、San Marcello、Belvedere Ostrense、Ostra、Senigallia。

body.en: Sea proximity moderates temperature variation.
body.zh: 近海位置调节温差。

body.en: Clay-rich mixed soils and sandy zones create site variation.
body.zh: 富黏土混合土及砂质带形成地块差异。

body.en: Minimum 85%.
Up to 15% other authorised non-aromatic black grapes.
body.zh: 其他许可非芳香黑葡萄最多15%。

body.en: Rose, violet and red/dark berries; youth can show firm tannin and fresh acidity.
body.zh: 玫瑰、紫罗兰及红黑浆果；年轻时可有较强单宁及清新酸度。

body.en: Riper fruit and concentration shift the balance toward richer fruit and spice.
body.zh: 较熟果实与浓缩使风格偏向更浓果味及香料。

sources.title: IMT — Lacrima di Morro d’Alba DOC

intro.en: Modena plain DOC producing especially pale, fragrant and acid-driven red and rosé Lambrusco.
intro.zh: Modena 平原 DOC，尤以色浅、芳香、酸度鲜明的红及桃红 Lambrusco 著称。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC for red and rosé Lambrusco styles.
body.zh: 红、桃红 Lambrusco DOC。

body.en: Twelve municipalities on the Modena plain, including Bomporto and Bastiglia.
body.zh: Modena 平原十二市镇，包括 Bomporto、Bastiglia。

body.en: North of Modena, around Sorbara.
body.zh: Modena 北侧 Sorbara 周围。

body.en: River-deposited plain soils with varying sand, silt and clay.
body.zh: 河流冲积平原土，沙、粉砂、黏土比例不同。

body.en: Lambrusco di Sorbara at least 60%.
body.zh: Lambrusco di Sorbara 至少 60%。

body.en: Lambrusco Salamino may contribute up to 40%.
body.zh: Lambrusco Salamino 可占最多 40%。

body.en: Other permitted Lambrusco varieties up to 15%, within the total blend.
body.zh: 其他获准 Lambrusco 最多 15%，计入总混酿。

body.en: Dry through sweeter categories are possible under the code.
body.zh: 规章下可有干至较甜类型。

body.en: The individual maxima cannot be added beyond a total of 100%.
body.zh: 各项上限不能相加超过 100%。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante expressions are recognised.
body.zh: 认可微起泡及起泡表达。

body.en: Red and rosé are both established styles.
body.zh: 红及桃红均为传统风格。

body.en: Especially light ruby or pink compared with many Lambruschi.
body.zh: 相比不少 Lambrusco，特别浅宝石红或粉红。

body.en: Violet, red berries and fresh fruit.
body.zh: 紫罗兰、红浆果、清新果味。

body.en: Marked acidity and generally lighter body than Grasparossa.
body.zh: 酸度明显，酒体通常轻于 Grasparossa。

body.en: Sorbara is a grape as well as part of the geographical wine name.
body.zh: Sorbara 是品种，也出现在地理酒名中。

role.en: Documented local grape or specified appellation component.
role.zh: 有记录的本地品种或法定产区组分。

role.en: Documented local grape or specified appellation component.
role.zh: 有记录的本地品种或法定产区组分。

intro.en: Southern Modena foothill DOC known for deeply coloured, tannic Lambrusco.
intro.zh: Modena 南部山麓 DOC，以深色、有单宁 Lambrusco 著称。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC for red and rosé sparkling or semi-sparkling styles.
body.zh: 红、桃红起泡或微起泡 DOC。

body.en: Castelvetro and the southern Modena hills.
body.zh: Castelvetro 及 Modena 南部丘陵。

body.en: More hillside-oriented than Sorbara and Salamino’s northern plain origins.
body.zh: 相比 Sorbara、Salamino 北部平原，更具丘陵特点。

body.en: Clay-rich foothill soils are common.
body.zh: 山麓常见富黏土土壤。

body.en: Higher sites include limestone, sand and gravel materials.
body.zh: 较高地块含石灰岩、沙及砾石材料。

body.en: Lambrusco Grasparossa at least 85%.
body.zh: Lambrusco Grasparossa 至少 85%。

body.en: Other permitted Lambrusco and Malbo Gentile together up to 15%.
body.zh: 其他获准 Lambrusco、Malbo Gentile 合计最多 15%。

body.en: Dry and sweeter expressions are recognised.
body.zh: 认可干型及较甜表达。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante types.
body.zh: 微起泡及起泡类型。

body.en: Both red and rosé are defined.
body.zh: 定义红及桃红。

body.en: Deep ruby-purple with coloured foam in red examples.
body.zh: 红酒常深宝石紫红，泡沫带色。

body.en: Dark berries, cherry and vinous fruit.
body.zh: 深色浆果、樱桃、葡萄酒果香。

body.en: Generally firmer tannin and fuller body than Sorbara.
body.zh: 通常单宁比 Sorbara 更强、酒体更厚。

body.en: Grasparossa is a grape; Castelvetro locates the denomination.
body.zh: Grasparossa 为品种，Castelvetro 标示产区。

role.en: Documented local grape or specified appellation component.
role.zh: 有记录的本地品种或法定产区组分。

name: Lambrusco Salamino di Santa Croce DOC

intro.en: Carpi-area plain DOC led by Lambrusco Salamino.
intro.zh: Carpi 周边平原、以 Lambrusco Salamino 为主的 DOC。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC for red and rosé Lambrusco.
body.zh: 红、桃红 Lambrusco DOC。

body.en: Northern Modena plain around Carpi and Santa Croce.
body.zh: Carpi、Santa Croce 周围 Modena 北部平原。

body.en: Low, level river-sediment country.
body.zh: 低平河流沉积地区。

body.en: Sand, silt and clay occur in varying proportions.
body.zh: 沙、粉砂、黏土比例各异。

body.en: Lambrusco Salamino at least 85%.
body.zh: Lambrusco Salamino 至少 85%。

body.en: Other authorised Lambruschi may contribute to the balance.
body.zh: 其他获准 Lambrusco 可参与余下混酿。

body.en: Ancellotta and Fortana may be included within the 15% complement.
body.zh: Ancellotta、Fortana 可计入 15% 辅助份额。

body.en: Dry, semi-dry and sweeter categories are available.
body.zh: 可有干、半干及较甜类别。

body.en: Not a synonym for Reggiano or Modena DOC.
body.zh: 不是 Reggiano 或 Modena DOC 同义名。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante, red or rosé.
body.zh: 微起泡、起泡，红或桃红。

body.en: Red fruit, flowers and a vinous note.
body.zh: 红果、花香及葡萄酒果香。

body.en: Often intermediate in structure between very light Sorbara and tannic Grasparossa.
body.zh: 结构常介于轻盈 Sorbara、有单宁 Grasparossa 之间。

body.en: Ruby red with violet tones in red examples.
body.zh: 红酒常宝石红、带紫色调。

intro.en: Volcanic Castelli Romani whites, Cesanese from the eastern hills, Cori’s Bellone and Nero Buono, and Terracina’s aromatic wines form distinct regional traditions.
intro.zh: 火山 Castelli Romani 白酒、东部丘陵 Cesanese、Cori 的 Bellone 与 Nero Buono、Terracina 芳香酒构成不同地方传统。

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Administrative region; individual DOC/DOCG boundaries are separate.
body.zh: 行政大区；各 DOC／DOCG 边界另行划定。

body.en: DOC established in 1966.
body.zh: 1966年获 DOC。

body.en: Frascati DOC, Frascati Superiore DOCG and Cannellino di Frascati DOCG are distinct legal entries.
body.zh: Frascati DOC、Frascati Superiore DOCG、Cannellino di Frascati DOCG 为不同法律条目。

label.zh: Cesanese del Piglio — 地方记载

body.en: Piglio’s 1479 statutes provide historical evidence of the wine-growing economy.
body.zh: Piglio 1479年法规提供当地葡萄酒经济的历史证据。

body.en: DOCG; the protected alternative name is Piglio.
body.zh: DOCG，受保护替代名称为 Piglio。

body.en: Frascati, Grottaferrata and Monte Porzio Catone, with parts of Rome and Montecompatri.
body.zh: Frascati、Grottaferrata、Monte Porzio Catone 全境，以及 Rome、Montecompatri 部分地区。

body.en: Alban Hills southeast of Rome.
body.zh: Rome 东南的 Alban Hills。

label.zh: Cesanese del Piglio — 核心市镇

body.en: Entire Piglio and Serrone.
body.zh: Piglio 与 Serrone 全境。

label.zh: Cesanese del Piglio — 其他市镇

body.en: Delimited parts of Acuto, Anagni and Paliano, Frosinone province.
body.zh: Frosinone 省 Acuto、Anagni、Paliano 划定部分。

body.en: Monte San Biagio, Terracina and Sonnino.
body.zh: Monte San Biagio、Terracina、Sonnino。

body.en: Ausoni foothills near the southern Lazio coast.
body.zh: Lazio 南部近海的 Ausoni 山麓。

body.en: Mediterranean coastal influence.
body.zh: 地中海沿海影响。

body.en: Carbonate terrain of the Ausoni system.
body.zh: Ausoni 山系碳酸盐地层。

body.en: Permeable volcanic soils: well drained, dry but not arid.
body.zh: 通透火山土，排水良好、干爽但不干旱。

body.en: The zone rises from lower slopes toward roughly 500 m.
body.zh: 产区由较低坡地上升至约500米。

body.en: Marine carbonate materials associated with the Lepini foothills.
body.zh: 与 Lepini 山麓相关的海相碳酸盐材料。

body.en: Hill sites are important to the local Bellone and Nero Buono tradition.
body.zh: 丘陵地块是 Bellone、Nero Buono 地方传统的重要基础。

body.en: Malvasia Bianca di Candia and/or Malvasia del Lazio together at least 70%.
body.zh: Malvasia Bianca di Candia 和／或 Malvasia del Lazio 合计至少70%。

body.en: Bellone, Bombino Bianco, Greco, Trebbiano Toscano and Trebbiano Giallo: up to 30%.
body.zh: Bellone、Bombino Bianco、Greco、Trebbiano Toscano、Trebbiano Giallo 合计最多30%。

body.en: Minimum 50% Bellone, 20% Malvasia del Lazio and 15% Greco.
body.zh: Bellone 至少50%、Malvasia del Lazio 至少20%、Greco 至少15%。

body.en: Minimum 50% Nero Buono, 20% Montepulciano and 15% Cesanese.
body.zh: Nero Buono 至少50%、Montepulciano 至少20%、Cesanese 至少15%。

body.en: Well-exposed hills help Cesanese ripen; poorly exposed high sites are problematic for Comune.
body.zh: 向阳丘陵有助于成熟，高海拔且朝向差的地块对 Comune 尤其不利。

body.en: Both Cesanese varieties require attention to fungal disease; Comune also experiences coulure.
body.zh: 两者均需关注真菌病，Comune 也会落花落果。

body.en: Alberello survives locally; compact bunches require rot management.
body.zh: 当地仍有 alberello 杯状整形，紧密果串需防腐烂。

body.en: Drying intensifies Muscat aroma and moves colour toward gold and amber.
body.zh: 风干强化麝香葡萄香，颜色趋金黄琥珀。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12%; Riserva 13%.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少12%；Riserva 13%。

body.en: At least 12 months from 1 November of harvest year, including three months in bottle.
body.zh: 采收当年11月1日起至少12个月，内含3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 13%.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少13%。

body.en: Reserved to Superiore with at least 20 months ageing, including six in bottle, and minimum total alcohol 14%.
body.zh: 限 Superiore，至少20个月熟成，其中6个月瓶陈，总酒精度至少14%。

body.en: Minimum residual sugar 35 g/L.
body.zh: 残糖至少35克／升。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%; total includes potential alcohol from residual sugar.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少12.5%，总量包含残糖潜在酒精。

body.en: Late harvest is required; partial drying is permitted.
body.zh: 要求晚收，允许部分风干。

body.en: Enrichment is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止增糖。

title.zh: Liri 与 Comino 地方品种

body.en: Maturano, Capolongo and Pampanaro survive in the southern Lazio heritage; Pampanaro corresponds to Bello, not Bellone.
body.zh: Maturano、Capolongo、Pampanaro 属 Lazio 南部传统；Pampanaro 对应 Bello，并非 Bellone。

body.en: Reale Bianca is distinct from Reale Gialla/Capolongo; Raspato Nero is locally Olivella di Esperia.
body.zh: Reale Bianca 不同于 Reale Gialla／Capolongo；Raspato Nero 当地称 Olivella di Esperia。

body.en: Rosciola is a pink-skinned local grape with high acidity and sparkling potential.
body.zh: Rosciola 为粉红果皮地方葡萄，酸度高且适合起泡。

role.zh: 主要 Malvasia 组。
Malvasia Puntinata，主要组。
辅助葡萄。
辅助葡萄，亦称 Rossetto。
辅助葡萄。

红混酿组分。
主体葡萄，Spumante 唯一品种。

role.en: Rare southern Lazio white for still and sparkling wines.
role.zh: Lazio 南部稀有白葡萄，可酿静态及起泡酒。

role.en: A local Lazio red with plum-shaped berries and floral-fruit expression.
role.zh: Lazio 地方红葡萄，果粒似李子，具花果香。

role.en: Southern Lazio white giving fruit-driven wines with useful acidity.
role.zh: Lazio 南部白葡萄，酒款以果味和良好酸度见长。

role.en: Late-ripening southern Lazio red generally used with other local varieties.
role.zh: Lazio 南部晚熟红葡萄，通常与当地其他品种混酿。

role.en: A productive local white with floral fruit and substantial acidity.
role.zh: 高产地方白葡萄，具花果香及扎实酸度。

role.en: Local Lazio red commonly vinified alone, combining floral aromas and balanced acidity.
role.zh: 常单酿的 Lazio 地方红葡萄，兼具花香及平衡酸度。

role.en: Vigorous local white giving full, relatively low-acid wines.
role.zh: 生长势强的地方白葡萄，酒体较足、酸度较低。

role.en: Pink-skinned dual-purpose grape with strong potential for sparkling rosé.
role.zh: 粉红果皮、鲜食酿酒兼用，适合起泡桃红。

role.en: Historic Lazio red capable of structured wines and ageing.
role.zh: Lazio 历史红葡萄，可酿结构型及可陈年酒款。

intro.en: Coastal region linking western Rossese/Pigato wines to eastern Bosco–Albarola blends and cross-border Colli di Luni.
intro.zh: 沿海大区，连接西部 Rossese／Pigato 酒、东部 Bosco–Albarola 混酿及跨界 Colli di Luni。

body.en: Liguria is an administrative coastal region with multiple DOCs and IGTs.
body.zh: Liguria 是沿海行政大区，含多个 DOC 与 IGT。

body.en: Ponente denotes western Liguria.
body.zh: Ponente 指 Liguria 西部。

body.en: Levante denotes eastern Liguria.
body.zh: Levante 指 Liguria 东部。

body.en: Liguria is an administrative coastal region with multiple DOCs and IGTs.
body.zh: Liguria 是沿海行政大区，含多个 DOC 与 IGT。

body.en: DOC recognition dates to 1972.
body.zh: 1972 年获 DOC。

body.en: DOC recognition dates to 1973.
body.zh: 1973 年获 DOC。

body.en: DOC recognition dates to 1989.
body.zh: 1989 年获 DOC。

body.en: Ponente denotes western Liguria.
body.zh: Ponente 指 Liguria 西部。

body.en: Levante denotes eastern Liguria.
body.zh: Levante 指 Liguria 东部。

body.en: Colli di Luni crosses Liguria and Toscana.
body.zh: Colli di Luni 跨 Liguria 与 Toscana。

body.en: Savona and Finale are key local references.
body.zh: Savona 与 Finale 为重要地方参考。

body.en: Costa de Sera, Costa de Campu and Costa de Posa.
body.zh: Costa de Sera、Costa de Campu、Costa de Posa。

body.en: Riviera dei Fiori, Finalese and Albenganese are relevant subzone references.
body.zh: Riviera dei Fiori、Finalese、Albenganese 为相关分区参考。

body.en: The eastern Colli di Luni context includes the Val di Magra cultural landscape, distinct from western Ponente.
body.zh: 东部 Colli di Luni 背景包含 Val di Magra 文化景观，不同于西部 Ponente。

body.en: Bosco is the required leading grape.
body.zh: Bosco 为必需主要葡萄。

body.en: Rossese, linked to Tibouren, defines Dolceacqua.
body.zh: 关联 Tibouren 的 Rossese 定义 Dolceacqua。

body.en: Mataossu is a local name for Lumassina.
body.zh: Mataossu 为 Lumassina 地方名。

body.en: Modern VitisDB identity work links Bianchetta Genovese with Albarola.
body.zh: 现代 VitisDB 身份研究关联 Bianchetta Genovese 与 Albarola。

body.en: Pigato is linked to the Vermentino identity; preserve the local wine name without adding a duplicate grape.
body.zh: Pigato 关联 Vermentino，保留地方酒名而不重复计品种。

body.en: Bianchetta Genovese is not Bianchetta Trevigiana.
body.zh: Bianchetta Genovese 不是 Bianchetta Trevigiana。

body.en: Steep terraces above the Mediterranean, especially Cinque Terre, create labour-intensive vineyard access.
body.zh: 尤其 Cinque Terre 的地中海上方陡梯田使入园及管理劳动密集。

body.en: At least 40% Bosco in Cinque Terre.
body.zh: Cinque Terre 至少 40% Bosco。

body.en: Cinque Terre allows Vermentino and/or Albarola together up to 40%.
body.zh: Cinque Terre 的 Vermentino 及／或 Albarola 合计最多 40%。

label.zh: 其他 Cinque Terre 白葡萄

body.en: Other permitted whites may contribute up to 20%.
body.zh: 其他获准白葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Dolceacqua requires at least 95% Rossese.
body.zh: Dolceacqua 至少 95% Rossese。

body.en: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Pigato requires at least 95%.
body.zh: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Pigato 至少 95%。

body.en: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Vermentino requires at least 95%.
body.zh: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Vermentino 至少 95%。

body.en: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Rossese requires at least 90%.
body.zh: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Rossese 至少 90%。

body.en: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Granaccia requires at least 90%.
body.zh: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Granaccia 至少 90%。

body.en: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Moscato requires 100%.
body.zh: Riviera Ligure di Ponente Moscato 要求 100%。

body.en: Colli di Luni Vermentino requires at least 90%.
body.zh: Colli di Luni Vermentino 至少 90%。

body.en: Colli di Luni Albarola requires at least 85%.
body.zh: Colli di Luni Albarola 至少 85%。

body.en: Sangiovese must comprise at least 50%.
body.zh: Sangiovese 至少 50%。

body.en: Sciacchetrà is Cinque Terre’s sweet dried-grape wine.
body.zh: Sciacchetrà 为 Cinque Terre 风干甜酒。

body.en: Brief traditional skin contact can add a slight phenolic grip to otherwise fresh light whites.
body.zh: 传统短浸皮可为清新轻白酒添加轻微酚类抓口感。

body.en: Western coastal winegrowing is strongly linked to Mediterranean conditions; inland slope and altitude remain local modifiers.
body.zh: 西部沿海栽培紧密关联地中海条件，内陆坡地及海拔仍有地方调节。

intro.en: Northern region spanning Alpine Nebbiolo, Garda whites and rosés, Franciacorta and Oltrepò sparkling traditions.
intro.zh: 北部大区，涵盖阿尔卑斯 Nebbiolo、Garda 白酒桃红及 Franciacorta、Oltrepò 起泡传统。

body.en: Chiavennasca is Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Chiavennasca 即 Nebbiolo。

body.en: Lake Iseo lies north of Franciacorta.
body.zh: Iseo 湖位于 Franciacorta 北侧。

body.en: Lugana lies at southern Lake Garda.
body.zh: Lugana 位于 Garda 湖南部。

body.en: Lugana received DOC status in 1967.
body.zh: Lugana 于 1967 年获 DOC。

body.en: Moscato di Scanzo obtained DOCG recognition in 2009, a distinct development from Lugana’s 1967 DOC.
body.zh: Moscato di Scanzo 于 2009 年获 DOCG，与 Lugana 1967 DOC 为不同发展。

body.en: Lake Iseo lies north of Franciacorta.
body.zh: Iseo 湖位于 Franciacorta 北侧。

body.en: Lugana lies at southern Lake Garda.
body.zh: Lugana 位于 Garda 湖南部。

body.en: Lugana is shared by Lombardia and Veneto.
body.zh: Lugana 跨 Lombardia 与 Veneto。

body.en: Oltrepò lies south of the Po.
body.zh: Oltrepò 位于 Po 河以南。

body.en: Sirmione, Desenzano, Lonato, Pozzolengo and Peschiera del Garda.
body.zh: Sirmione、Desenzano、Lonato、Pozzolengo、Peschiera del Garda。

body.en: Sirmione is wholly included; specified parts of the other four communes are included.
body.zh: Sirmione 全境纳入，其他四市镇为指定部分。

body.en: Versa, Scuropasso, Coppa and Staffora.
body.zh: Versa、Scuropasso、Coppa、Staffora。

body.en: Monte Orfano has a substrate distinct from Franciacorta’s principal morainic landscape.
body.zh: Monte Orfano 基底不同于 Franciacorta 主要冰碛景观。

body.en: Franciacorta’s principal moraines contrast with southern Garda’s clay-rich Lugana ground.
body.zh: Franciacorta 主要冰碛与 Garda 南部 Lugana 富黏土地形形成对比。

body.en: Chiavennasca is Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Chiavennasca 即 Nebbiolo。

body.en: Moscato di Scanzo is a red aromatic grape.
body.zh: Moscato di Scanzo 为红色芳香葡萄。

body.en: Turbiana is the principal local grape name in Lugana.
body.zh: Turbiana 为 Lugana 主要葡萄地方名。

body.en: Groppello is the emblematic local grape group.
body.zh: Groppello 为标志性地方葡萄群。

body.en: Gentile and Mocasina are separate cultivars, not merely two clones.
body.zh: Gentile 与 Mocasina 为不同品种，并非仅两个克隆。

body.en: Nebbiolo Rosé is genetically distinct, not a proven colour mutation.
body.zh: Nebbiolo Rosé 遗传上独立，并非已证实颜色突变。

body.en: The 2020 study supports full-sibling relationships with Nebbiolo, Nebbiolo Rosé and Pignola.
body.zh: 2020 研究支持其与 Nebbiolo、Nebbiolo Rosé、Pignola 为全同胞关系。

body.en: Late ripening with retained high acidity is Erbamat’s principal sparkling-base interest.
body.zh: 晚熟保留高酸为 Erbamat 的主要起泡基酒价值。

body.en: Maroggia, Sassella, Grumello, Inferno and Valgella.
body.zh: Maroggia、Sassella、Grumello、Inferno、Valgella。

body.en: Valtellina Superiore requires at least 90% Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Valtellina Superiore 至少 90% Nebbiolo。

body.en: Lugana requires at least 90% Turbiana.
body.zh: Lugana 至少 90% Turbiana。

body.en: Minimum 12 months maturation.
body.zh: 最低熟成 12 个月。

body.en: Minimum 24 months, including at least 6 in bottle.
body.zh: 最低 24 个月，含至少 6 个月瓶陈。

body.en: Basic, Superiore, Riserva, Vendemmia Tardiva and Spumante.
body.zh: 基础款、Superiore、Riserva、Vendemmia Tardiva、Spumante。

body.en: Erbamat is excluded from Satèn.
body.zh: Satèn 排除 Erbamat。

body.en: Eligible Franciacorta categories allow at most 10% Erbamat.
body.zh: 适用 Franciacorta 类别最多 10% Erbamat。

body.en: Sforzato is a dry red made from dried grapes.
body.zh: Sforzato 为风干葡萄酿成的干红。

body.en: Traditional method with secondary fermentation in bottle.
body.zh: 传统法，瓶中二次发酵。

body.en: Red aromatic fruit is dried before fermentation into a concentrated sweet red.
body.zh: 红色芳香果实先风干，再酿浓缩甜红。

body.en: The Oltrepò consortium represents seven denomination identities, including Bonarda, Buttafuoco and Sangue di Giuda.
body.zh: Oltrepò 协会代表七个名称身份，包括 Bonarda、Buttafuoco、Sangue di Giuda。

body.en: Rainoldi supplies an identified Sforzato reference, with fruit drying and large-cask maturation.
body.zh: Rainoldi 提供明确 Sforzato 参考，包含风干及大木桶熟成。

body.en: Dry Sforzato and sweet Moscato di Scanzo need different service contexts despite both using dried fruit.
body.zh: 干型 Sforzato 与甜型 Moscato di Scanzo 虽都用风干果实，侍酒场景不同。

body.en: The Po plain is a temperate transition between Mediterranean and central/western European continental–oceanic climates; Alpine, hill and lake districts require separate interpretation.
body.zh: Po 平原属地中海与欧洲中西部大陆海洋气候间温带过渡，阿尔卑斯、丘陵及湖区须分别理解。

body.zh: 谷地南北走向，与亚得里亚海岸平行。

body.zh: Marche 南部 Offida、Ripatransone 周边 Piceno 丘陵。

body.en: Between the Adriatic coast and inland hill country.
body.zh: 位于亚得里亚海岸与内陆丘陵之间。

body.en: Apennines to the west, Monte San Vicino to the east.
body.zh: 西为亚平宁山，东为 Monte San Vicino。

body.en: Cold winters, hot summers and substantial day–night differences; ripening is slowed.
body.zh: 冬冷夏热、昼夜温差大，成熟进程较慢。

label.en: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — Maritime influence
label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 海洋影响

body.en: Sea proximity moderates temperature variation.
body.zh: 近海位置调节温差。

label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 土壤

body.en: Clay-rich mixed soils and sandy zones create site variation.
body.zh: 富黏土混合土及砂质带形成地块差异。

label.zh: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — 内陆

body.en: Marl-clay and limestone nearer the Apennines.
body.zh: 近亚平宁山地为泥灰岩黏土与石灰岩。

label.en: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — Toward coast
label.zh: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — 近海

body.zh: 更接近混合、砂质及含砂岩土，海风调节开放丘陵。

body.en: More silt and mixed texture toward Cerreto.
body.zh: Cerreto 方向较多粉砂与混合质地。

body.en: Marl-limestone around Matelica and whiter calcareous soils toward Castelraimondo.
body.zh: Matelica 周边泥灰岩石灰岩，往 Castelraimondo 更偏白色钙质土。

body.zh: 覆盖整个 Matera 省，从内陆丘陵至爱奥尼亚海岸平原。

body.en: Metapontine coastal plain, marine terraces and Bradanic hills create several growing environments.
body.zh: Metapontine 海岸平原、海成阶地、Bradanic 丘陵构成多个栽培环境。

body.en: The Metapontine and Bradano sectors are among the warmest; summer drought is a defining constraint.
body.zh: Metapontine、Bradano 地带较暖，夏季干旱为重要约束。

body.en: Calcareous sands, conglomerates, marls and clays differ across the province; these are not all Vulture volcanic soils.
body.zh: 钙质砂、砾岩、泥灰岩及黏土在省内各异，并非全为 Vulture 火山土。

body.en: Sangiovese at least 60%, Primitivo at least 30%, eligible red complements up to 10%.
body.zh: Sangiovese 至少 60%，Primitivo 至少 30%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 10%。

body.en: Cabernet Sauvignon at least 60%, Primitivo at least 20%, Merlot at least 10%; other eligible red grapes up to 10%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 至少 60%，Primitivo 至少 20%，Merlot 至少 10%；其他合资格红葡萄最多 10%。

body.en: Primitivo and Primitivo Passito require at least 90% Primitivo; Rosato also requires at least 90%.
body.zh: Primitivo、Primitivo Passito 至少含 Primitivo 90%；Rosato 同样至少 90%。

body.en: Named Greco requires at least 85% Greco.
body.zh: 标示 Greco 至少含 Greco 85%。
