body.zh: 除指定红酒外，亦设白酒、白 Passito、白及桃红起泡类型。

body.en: Still, sparkling and dried-grape styles require separate cellar practices and analysis; Moro is a blend category, not a grape name.
body.zh: 静止、起泡、干化葡萄风格须分别处理工艺及指标；Moro 为混酿类别，非葡萄名称。

body.en: Compare Rosso with Moro to assess the change from Sangiovese-led to Cabernet-led structure, keeping Primitivo’s role visible.
body.zh: 比较 Rosso 与 Moro，可研究 Sangiovese 主导至 Cabernet 主导的结构变化，并保留 Primitivo 作用。

body.zh: 丘陵地块石灰质材料重要。

body.en: At least 85% combined permitted Lambrusco varieties.
body.zh: 获准 Lambrusco 合计至少 85%。

body.en: Grasparossa, Salamino, Sorbara, Marani, Maestri, Montericco, Oliva and Lambrusco a Foglia Frastagliata are listed.
body.zh: 列 Grasparossa、Salamino、Sorbara、Marani、Maestri、Montericco、Oliva、Lambrusco a Foglia Frastagliata。

body.en: Ancellotta, Malbo Gentile and Fortana up to 15% combined for the Lambrusco type.
body.zh: Lambrusco 类型的 Ancellotta、Malbo Gentile、Fortana 合计最多 15%。

body.en: The 85% Lambrusco rule does not describe every Modena DOC wine.
body.zh: 85% Lambrusco 规则不适用于所有 Modena DOC 酒。

body.en: Lambrusco styles extend from dry to sweet categories.
body.zh: Lambrusco 可从干至甜类别。

body.en: Red and rosé frizzante or spumante expressions.
body.zh: 红及桃红微起泡或起泡。

body.en: The broader DOC also regulates non-Lambrusco types.
body.zh: 广域 DOC 另规范非 Lambrusco 类型。

body.en: Different Lambrusco combinations change colour, tannin and perfume.
body.zh: 不同 Lambrusco 组合改变颜色、单宁、香气。

body.en: Modena is a denomination, not one Lambrusco cultivar.
body.zh: Modena 是产区，不是单一 Lambrusco 品种。

intro.en: Small Adriatic and inland region connecting Montepulciano and Aglianico blends with the recovered local Tintilia grape.
intro.zh: 兼有亚得里亚海岸与内陆的小型大区，连接 Montepulciano、Aglianico 混酿及保育地方 Tintilia。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Molise DOC coexists with Biferno, Pentro di Isernia and Tintilia del Molise.
body.zh: Molise DOC 与 Biferno、Pentro di Isernia、Tintilia del Molise 并存。

body.en: Osco/Terre degli Osci and Rotae are the regional IGT references.
body.zh: Osco／Terre degli Osci、Rotae 为地区 IGT 参照。

body.en: Biferno and Pentro were recognized in 1983.
body.zh: Biferno、Pentro 均于 1983 年认可。

body.en: DOC recognized in 2011; the specification cites Raffaele Pepe’s 1810 manuscript.
body.zh: DOC 于 2011 年认可；规范援引 Raffaele Pepe 1810 手稿。

body.en: Biferno is in Campobasso; Pentro in Isernia.
body.zh: Biferno 位于 Campobasso，Pentro 位于 Isernia。

body.en: Listed municipalities in both provinces; eligible vineyards must be on hills at least 200 m high.
body.zh: 包含两省指定市镇，合资格园须丘陵且海拔至少 200 米。

body.en: Lower coastal settings have more maritime influence; Isernia hills provide a cooler inland context.
body.zh: 较低海岸地海洋影响更强，Isernia 丘陵为较凉内陆环境。

body.en: Drained calcareous hill soils occur in the Tintilia geographic account.
body.zh: Tintilia 地理说明含排水良好石灰质丘陵土。

body.en: Sandy-clayey coastal hills and piedmont alluvium add variation in texture and depth.
body.zh: 砂黏质海岸丘陵、山麓冲积物增加质地深度差异。

body.en: Tintilia is local; Montepulciano and Aglianico connect Molise to neighbouring regions.
body.zh: Tintilia 属地方特色，Montepulciano、Aglianico 连接邻区。

body.en: Pentro’s legal Falanghina wording alone does not determine Beneventana or Flegrea genotype.
body.zh: Pentro 法规 Falanghina 名称本身不能确定 Beneventana／Flegrea 基因型。

body.en: Loose bunches and thick skins coexist with unreliable fruit set and modest crops.
body.zh: 疏松穗、厚皮与坐果不稳定、低产并存。

body.en: Mildew risks remain despite rusticity; Tintilia DOC maximum yield is 8 t/ha.
body.zh: 适应力不等于无霉病风险；Tintilia DOC 最高 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Red/rosé: Montepulciano 70–80%, Aglianico 10–20%.
body.zh: 红／桃红 Montepulciano 70–80%、Aglianico 10–20%。

body.en: Current red/rosé: Montepulciano 75–80%, Tintilia 20–25%; obsolete Sangiovese summaries must not substitute for the law.
body.zh: 现红／桃红 Montepulciano 75–80%、Tintilia 20–25%，不用过时 Sangiovese 摘要取代法规。

body.en: Dedicated DOC requires at least 95% Tintilia.
body.zh: 专属 DOC 要求至少 95% Tintilia。

body.en: Rosso, Rosso Riserva and Rosato; Riserva needs two years from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: Rosso、Rosso Riserva、Rosato；Riserva 自采收年 11 月 1 日起两年。

body.en: Tintilia red/rosé maximum grape-to-wine yield 70%; Riserva 55%.
body.zh: Tintilia 红／桃红最高出酒率 70%，Riserva 55%。

body.en: Di Majo Norante documents 100% Tintilia; Claudio Cipressi is associated with recovery at San Felice del Molise.
body.zh: Di Majo Norante 记录 100% Tintilia；Claudio Cipressi 关联 San Felice del Molise 保育。

body.en: Assess acidity, phenolic grip and pepper/clove spice together; do not treat bottle alcohol as the DOC minimum.
body.zh: 同时看酸度、酚类收敛、胡椒丁香；不把瓶款酒精当 DOC 最低值。

role.zh: 已记录地方种植或保育。

note.zh: 酒庄表为 100% Tintilia。

intro.zh: 包含多个独立 DOC、DOCG 的历史葡萄酒地区。

body.zh: 包含多个独立 DOC、DOCG 的历史葡萄酒地区。

body.en: Parts of its wine landscape joined the UNESCO listing in June 2014.
body.zh: 部分葡萄酒景观于 2014 年 6 月列入 UNESCO。

body.en: Mainly Alessandria and parts of Asti.
body.zh: 主要位于 Alessandria 及部分 Asti。

body.en: Mainly Alessandria and parts of Asti.
body.zh: 主要位于 Alessandria 及部分 Asti。

body.en: Po to the north; Tanaro, Belbo and Bormida frame southern sectors.
body.zh: 北侧 Po；Tanaro、Belbo、Bormida 环绕南部地带。

body.en: Older calcareous terre bianche occur around Canelli, southern Asti, Alessandria and Casalese.
body.zh: 较老石灰质 terre bianche 见于 Canelli、Asti 南部、Alessandria、Casalese。

body.en: Asti sands contrast with these calcareous terrains.
body.zh: Asti 砂层与石灰质地形形成对比。

body.en: Barbera, Grignolino, Freisa, Ruchè and Brachetto define different PDO expressions.
body.zh: Barbera、Grignolino、Freisa、Ruchè、Brachetto 定义不同 PDO 表现。

body.en: Moscato Bianco connects its hills to the broader Asti denomination.
body.zh: Moscato Bianco 将本区丘陵与更广 Asti 产区连接。

body.en: Sandy sites store less water than clay-rich ground; the vineyard location matters.
body.zh: 砂地保水少于富黏土地，具体园地重要。

body.en: Nizza, Barbera d’Asti, Ruchè and Acqui have separate production rules.
body.zh: Nizza、Barbera d’Asti、Ruchè、Acqui 有独立生产规范。

body.en: The DOC bearing the district name is a separate legal entity.
body.zh: 以地区命名的 DOC 是独立法律实体。

body.en: Dry reds, aromatic sparkling wines and dried-grape wines coexist.
body.zh: 干红、芳香起泡及风干葡萄酒并存。

body.en: Interpret the specific PDO and category; the district name alone does not fix a style.
body.zh: 须查看具体 PDO 及类别，地区名本身不固定风格。

body.en: Continental conditions in the Asti denomination favour sunny hillside sites.
body.zh: Asti 产区大陆性条件使向阳坡地重要。

body.en: Cascina Castlet’s Uceline provides a documented Monferrato Rosso example.
body.zh: Cascina Castlet 的 Uceline 提供有技术资料的 Monferrato Rosso 范例。

intro.zh: 翁布里亚小片丘陵内仅用 Sagrantino 酿造的干型及风干甜型酒。

body.zh: 1979年 DOC，1992年 DOCG。

body.en: Dry Sagrantino is documented at the 1925 Umbrian wine exhibition, alongside sweeter versions.
body.zh: 1925年翁布里亚酒展已有干型 Sagrantino，与较甜版本并列。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Bevagna, Gualdo Cattaneo, Castel Ritaldi and Giano dell’Umbria.
body.zh: Montefalco 全境及 Bevagna、Gualdo Cattaneo、Castel Ritaldi、Giano dell’Umbria 部分地区。

body.en: All are in Perugia, central Umbria.
body.zh: 均在翁布里亚中部 Perugia 省。

body.en: 100% Sagrantino.
body.zh: 100% Sagrantino。

body.en: Secco and Passito; passito preserves the local drying tradition.
body.zh: Secco 与 Passito，后者延续当地风干传统。

body.en: 33 months from 1 December of the harvest year.
body.zh: 采收当年12月1日起33个月。

body.en: At least four further months in bottle: minimum total 37 months, not 33 including bottle.
body.zh: 其后至少另加4个月瓶陈，总计至少37个月，并非33个月内含瓶陈。

body.en: Secco requires at least 12 months in oak, with no specified barrel size.
body.zh: Secco 至少12个月橡木熟成，未限定桶容量。

body.en: No identical mandatory oak period is imposed on Passito.
body.zh: Passito 不适用相同强制橡木期限。

body.en: The 2023 consolidated specification gives 80–180 g/L residual sugar and minimum 18% total alcohol.
body.zh: 2023汇编规范规定残糖80–180克／升、总酒精度至少18%。

body.en: Evaluate tannin maturity and sediment before aeration; substantial protein-rich dishes suit its structure.
body.zh: 通气前判断单宁成熟度及沉淀；厚重蛋白质菜肴适合其结构。

body.en: Balance sweetness with tannin; aged cheese or cocoa-rich desserts offer useful comparisons.
body.zh: 平衡甜度与单宁；熟成奶酪或浓可可甜点可作比较。

role.zh: 唯一品种。

body.en: Cerasuolo became independent in 2010; the September 2026 amendment followed separate Casauria registration.
body.zh: Cerasuolo 2010 独立，2026 九月修订发生于 Casauria 独立登记后。

body.en: Delimited hill sites in all four Abruzzo provinces, with additional subzone annexes.
body.zh: Abruzzo 四省划定丘陵，另有子区附录。

body.en: Coastal and inland hills differ in maritime exposure, elevation and mountain influence.
body.zh: 海岸、内陆丘陵海洋影响、海拔、山地作用不同。

body.en: Clay-rich marine deposits, sands and alluvium occur across the broad area.
body.zh: 广域有富黏土海相沉积、砂及冲积物。

body.en: Minimum 85% Montepulciano; eligible non-aromatic red varieties may complete the blend.
body.zh: 至少 85% Montepulciano，其余可用合资格非芳香红葡萄。

body.en: Colline Teramane and Casauria are independent denominations, not interchangeable labels for the basic DOC.
body.zh: Colline Teramane、Casauria 独立，不与基础 DOC 标签互换。

body.en: Still red; maceration, extraction and oak differ by producer and designation.
body.zh: 静止红酒，浸渍萃取木桶随酒庄标示不同。

body.en: The estate documents separate red Montepulciano, white Trebbiano and Cerasuolo bottles.
body.zh: 酒庄分别记录红 Montepulciano、白 Trebbiano、Cerasuolo。

body.en: Evaluate fruit, tannin and oak separately; the DOC does not mandate one extraction level.
body.zh: 分别评价果味单宁木桶，DOC 不规定统一萃取程度。

body.en: The grape and DOCG share a name but are different entity types.

body.en: Consorzio Moscato di Scanzo represents the local production identity.

body.en: Sweetness and concentration distinguish this from fresh Moscato sparkling wine.

body.en: Broad shallow valleys and hills around 150–350 m.
body.zh: 宽浅谷地及约 150–350 米丘陵。

body.en: Sandy parcels retain less moisture and face greater drought stress than clay-rich sites.
body.zh: 砂地保水较少，比富黏土地块面临更大干旱压力。

body.en: Sands, silts and clays vary locally; compact marl can limit rooting depth.
body.zh: 砂、粉砂、黏土随地点变化；紧实泥灰岩可限制根深。

body.en: 100% Barbera.
body.zh: 100% Barbera。

body.en: Hillsides facing south, southeast or southwest.
body.zh: 南、东南或西南向坡地。

body.en: Vertical training; Guyot or low spur-pruned cordon; ≥4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 直立架式；Guyot 或低位短梢单臂；≥4,000 株/公顷。

body.en: 7 t/ha; Vigna 6.3 t/ha.
body.zh: 7 吨/公顷；Vigna 6.3 吨/公顷。

body.en: 18 months including 6 in wood, counted from 1 January after harvest.
body.zh: 采收翌年 1 月 1 日起 18 个月，含木质容器 6 个月。

body.en: 30 months including 12 in wood, from the same January date.
body.zh: 同一起算日 30 个月，含木质容器 12 个月。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 13%; Vigna 13.5%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 13%；Vigna 13.5%。

body.en: Alcohol enrichment is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止提高天然酒精度的增浓处理。

body.en: Compare its 100% Barbera and longer ageing with Barbera d’Asti.
body.zh: 与 Barbera d’Asti 比较其 100% Barbera 及较长熟成要求。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

intro.en: Southern Marche denomination with separate Pecorino, Passerina and Montepulciano-based Rosso types.
intro.zh: Marche 南部产区，分 Pecorino、Passerina 及 Montepulciano 主导 Rosso。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Marche
body.zh: Marche

body.en: Pecorino, Passerina and Rosso.
body.zh: Pecorino、Passerina、Rosso。

body.en: Terre di Offida DOC is separate and covers other traditional styles.
body.zh: Terre di Offida DOC 独立，涵盖其他传统酒型。

body.en: Piceno hills of southern Marche around Offida and Ripatransone.
body.zh: Marche 南部 Offida、Ripatransone 周边 Piceno 丘陵。

body.en: Between the Adriatic coast and inland hill country.
body.zh: 位于亚得里亚海岸与内陆丘陵之间。

body.en: At least 85% Pecorino.
body.zh: 至少85% Pecorino。

body.en: At least 85% Passerina.
body.zh: 至少85% Passerina。

body.en: At least 85% Montepulciano.
body.zh: 至少85% Montepulciano。

body.en: Here Montepulciano is a grape, unlike the Tuscan place-name in Vino Nobile.
body.zh: 此处 Montepulciano 是葡萄，不同于 Vino Nobile 中的托斯卡纳地名。

body.en: Earlier maturity and moderate, sometimes irregular yields.
body.zh: 成熟较早、产量中等且有时不稳定。

body.en: Later maturity, greater vigour and more regular abundant yields.
body.zh: 成熟较晚、生长势更强、丰产较稳定。

body.en: Pecorino and Passerina: 9 t/ha; Rosso: 8.5 t/ha.
body.zh: Pecorino 和 Passerina 每公顷9吨；Rosso 每公顷8.5吨。

body.en: New plantings require at least 3,000 vines/ha. Excessively wet, poorly exposed and alluvial plain sites are excluded.
body.zh: 新植每公顷至少3,000株；排除过湿、日照不足及冲积平原地块。

body.en: At least 24 months, including 12 in wood, plus three additional months in bottle; the clock starts no earlier than 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 至少24个月，内含12个月木桶，另加3个月瓶陈；最早从采收当年11月1日起算。

body.en: Pecorino and Passerina may be released after 1 March following harvest.
body.zh: Pecorino 与 Passerina 可在采收次年3月1日后上市。

body.en: Offida DOC was approved in 2001; the three current DOCG types were recognised in June 2011.
body.zh: Offida DOC 于2001年获批；目前三个 DOCG 酒型于2011年6月获认定。

body.en: The remaining 15% must be authorised non-aromatic grapes of the relevant berry colour; aromatic grapes cannot fill this allowance.
body.zh: 剩余15%须为适色、许可的非芳香品种；芳香品种不可充当该辅助比例。

role.zh: 品种型白酒至少85%。
品种型白酒至少85%。
Rosso 至少85%。

body.en: Twenty-two Alessandria communes including Ovada, Cremolino, Carpeneto and Rocca Grimalda.
body.zh: Alessandria 二十二市镇，含 Ovada、Cremolino、Carpeneto、Rocca Grimalda。

body.en: Hillsides up to 600 m; wet valley floors excluded.
body.zh: 最高 600 米坡地；排除湿润谷底。

body.en: Temperate and continental; the nearby Ligurian Sea brings moist Marin winds and autumn rain.
body.zh: 温带大陆性；邻近 Ligurian 海带来湿润 Marin 风及秋雨。

body.en: Clay and calcareous soils occur in differing combinations.
body.zh: 黏土及石灰质土具有不同组合。

body.en: 100% Dolcetto.
body.zh: 100% Dolcetto。

body.en: Vertical training and traditional Guyot; new vineyards ≥4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 直立架式及传统 Guyot；新园 ≥4,000 株/公顷。

body.en: 7 t/ha; Vigna 6 t/ha.
body.zh: 7 吨/公顷；Vigna 6 吨/公顷。

body.en: 12 months from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起 12 个月。

body.en: 20 months from the same November date.
body.zh: 自同一 11 月日期起 20 个月。

body.en: At least 24 months of ageing.
body.zh: 至少 24 个月陈年。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%; Vigna 13%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 12.5%；Vigna 13%。

body.en: The maturation clause does not prescribe compulsory wood ageing.
body.zh: 熟成条款未强制木质容器陈年。

body.en: Dry ruby-to-garnet red, with fruit and almond notes.
body.zh: 干型、宝石红至石榴红，具水果及杏仁风味。

intro.en: An island DOC centred on Zibibbo, covering dry, sweet, sparkling and separately fortified categories.
intro.zh: 以 Zibibbo 为核心的海岛 DOC，涵盖干、甜、起泡及独立加强酒型。

body.en: Pantelleria DOC
body.zh: Pantelleria DOC

body.en: The entire island of Pantelleria, province of Trapani.
body.zh: Trapani 省的整个 Pantelleria 岛。

body.en: Volcanic island, exposed to strong winds.
body.zh: 火山海岛，强风明显。

body.en: Low bush vines in sheltered hollows are adapted to wind exposure.
body.zh: 低矮灌木藤及避风凹地适应强风。

body.en: Zibibbo is Muscat of Alexandria.
body.zh: Zibibbo 即 Muscat of Alexandria。

body.en: Named Moscato/Passito categories require 100% Zibibbo.
body.zh: Moscato／Passito 酒型要求 100% Zibibbo。

body.en: Bianco, including Frizzante, allows up to 15% other suitable Sicilian white grapes.
body.zh: Bianco（含 Frizzante）可用最多 15% 其他 Sicilia 获准白葡萄。

body.en: New specialised plantings at least 2,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 新设专用园至少 2,000 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 10 tonnes/ha for the listed categories.
body.zh: 所列酒型最高葡萄产量 10 吨／公顷。

body.en: Emergency irrigation permitted; forcing prohibited.
body.zh: 允许应急灌溉，禁止催产。

body.en: All or part of the grapes are sun-dried on or off the vine.
body.zh: 全部或部分葡萄藤上或采后日晒风干。

body.en: Passito grape-to-wine maximum 40%.
body.zh: Passito 最高出酒率 40%。

body.en: Moscato Liquoroso and Passito Liquoroso require added grape-derived alcohol; ordinary Passito is a separate category.
body.zh: Moscato Liquoroso 与 Passito Liquoroso 要求添加葡萄来源酒精；普通 Passito 是另一酒型。

body.en: Not before 1 July following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 7 月 1 日。

body.en: Minimum total 20%, of which actual alcohol at least 14%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 20%，实际至少 14%。

body.en: Vinification, drying and fortification occur on Pantelleria; sparkling operations may occur within Sicily.
body.zh: 酿造、风干、加烈在岛上进行；起泡工序可在 Sicilia 范围内。

role.en: Zibibbo: 100% except Bianco/Frizzante may include ≤15% other suitable whites.
role.zh: Zibibbo：通常 100%，但 Bianco／Frizzante 可含最多 15% 其他获准白葡萄。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Molise
body.zh: Molise

body.en: DOC recognized in 1983.
body.zh: 1983 认可 DOC。

body.en: The 2014 specification allowed old vineyards ten years from 1 August 2014 to adapt.
body.zh: 2014 规范给予旧园自 2014 年 8 月 1 日起十年调整。

body.en: Listed hill communes in Isernia province.
body.zh: Isernia 省指定丘陵市镇。

body.en: Montepulciano 75–80%, Tintilia 20–25%, eligible red complement up to 5%.
body.zh: Montepulciano 75–80%、Tintilia 20–25%，合资格红辅助最多 5%。

body.en: Falanghina 80%, Trebbiano Toscano 15–20%, other eligible whites up to 5%.
body.zh: Falanghina 80%、Trebbiano Toscano 15–20%，其他最多 5%。

body.en: Pentro is an authorized shortened name; old Sangiovese-based summaries are obsolete.
body.zh: Pentro 为获准简称，旧 Sangiovese 核心摘要过时。

body.en: One year from 1 November of harvest year, including six months oak.
body.zh: 采收年 11 月 1 日起一年，其中六月橡木。

body.en: The text requires four years including two years oak followed by six months bottle; its separate earliest-release clause conflicts and needs control-body clarification.
body.zh: 文本要求四年含两年橡木再六月瓶陈，另条最早上市日期有冲突，须控制机构澄清。

body.en: Dry, fresh white with minimum legal total acidity 6 g/L.
body.zh: 干型清新白酒，法定总酸最低 6 g/L。

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.
coverage.zh: 依据一手资料的区域概览与精选关联产区，非所有获准葡萄或葡萄酒名称的穷尽清单。

intro.en: Northwestern region spanning Langhe, Roero, Monferrato, Alto Piemonte and Alpine foothill grape traditions.
intro.zh: 西北大区，涵盖 Langhe、Roero、Monferrato、Alto Piemonte 及阿尔卑斯山前葡萄传统。

body.en: Piemonte is an administrative region containing multiple independent PDOs.
body.zh: Piemonte 是包含多个独立 PDO 的行政大区。

body.en: Barolo is made from Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Barolo 使用 Nebbiolo。

body.en: Gavi is made from Cortese.
body.zh: Gavi 使用 Cortese。

body.en: Piemonte is an administrative region containing multiple independent PDOs.
body.zh: Piemonte 是包含多个独立 PDO 的行政大区。

body.en: Albarossa is Barbera × Chatus, bred at Conegliano in 1938.
body.zh: Albarossa 为 Barbera × Chatus，1938 年在 Conegliano 育成。

body.en: In Albarossa’s old pedigree this name referred to Chatus, not Nebbiolo.
body.zh: 在 Albarossa 旧亲本中，此名指 Chatus，非 Nebbiolo。

body.en: The Roero consortium traces local wine culture to pre-Roman Ligurian settlement; this is a regional historical account rather than a dated origin for individual grapes.
body.zh: Roero 协会将地方葡萄酒文化追溯至罗马前 Ligurian 聚落；这是地区历史说明，不是单个品种起源日期。

body.en: Langhe-Roero and Monferrato wine landscapes entered the UNESCO World Heritage list in June 2014.
body.zh: Langhe-Roero 与 Monferrato 葡萄酒景观于 2014 年 6 月列入 UNESCO 世界遗产。

body.en: Barolo moved from DOC recognition in 1966 to DOCG in 1980; this modern legal history is separate from much older viticulture.
body.zh: Barolo 于 1966 年获 DOC、1980 年获 DOCG，现代法律历史须与更古老栽培史分开。

body.en: Nascetta is particularly associated with Novello in the Langhe.
body.zh: Nascetta 尤其关联 Langhe 的 Novello。

body.en: Colline Saluzzesi provides the principal Quagliano PDO reference.
body.zh: Colline Saluzzesi 提供主要 Quagliano PDO 参考。

body.en: Gattinara belongs to Alto Piemonte, not the southern Langhe.
body.zh: Gattinara 属 Alto Piemonte，而非南部 Langhe。

body.en: The Tanaro is central to the Roero/Langhe geographical distinction.
body.zh: Tanaro 河对 Roero／Langhe 地理区分重要。

body.en: The Langhe lie in southern Piemonte at the foot of the Maritime Alps and Ligurian Apennines.
body.zh: Langhe 位于 Piemonte 南部、Maritime Alps 与 Ligurian Apennines 山麓。

body.en: Lower Langhe hills extend south from Alba on the Tanaro’s right bank towards the Ligurian mountains.
body.zh: Lower Langhe 丘陵由 Alba 沿 Tanaro 右岸向南延至 Ligurian 山地。

body.en: The historical Monferrato landscape lies largely in Alessandria and partly Asti, framed by the Po to the north and Tanaro, Belbo and Bormida to the south.
body.zh: 历史 Monferrato 景观主要在 Alessandria、部分在 Asti，北侧 Po，南侧 Tanaro、Belbo、Bormida。

body.en: Alto Piemonte’s Gattinara is tied to the Sesia area; Carema lies farther west at the Aosta Valley boundary.
body.zh: Alto Piemonte 的 Gattinara 关联 Sesia 一带；Carema 更靠西，位于 Aosta Valley 边界。

body.en: Volcanic porphyry distinguishes Gattinara’s geological reference.
body.zh: 火山斑岩为 Gattinara 重要地质特征。

body.en: Marine sedimentary sands are a characteristic Roero reference.
body.zh: 海相沉积砂为 Roero 典型参考。

body.en: Langhe and Roero contain marine sedimentary formations, but their sandstone, marl and clay proportions differ by site.
body.zh: Langhe 与 Roero 含海相沉积地层，砂岩、泥灰岩及黏土比例随地块变化。

body.en: Barolo is made from Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Barolo 使用 Nebbiolo。

body.en: Gavi is made from Cortese.
body.zh: Gavi 使用 Cortese。

body.en: Arneis defines Roero’s principal white category.
body.zh: Arneis 定义 Roero 主要白酒类别。

body.en: Pelaverga Piccolo is the principal grape, not Pelaverga Grosso.
body.zh: 主要葡萄为 Pelaverga Piccolo，非 Pelaverga Grosso。

body.en: Timorasso is central to the modern revival of Colli Tortonesi white wine.
body.zh: Timorasso 为 Colli Tortonesi 白酒当代复兴核心。

body.en: Pelaverga Piccolo and Pelaverga Grosso are distinct cultivars.
body.zh: Pelaverga Piccolo 与 Grosso 为不同品种。

body.en: Becuét is the Val di Susa name linked to Persan.
body.zh: Becuét 为关联 Persan 的 Val di Susa 地方名。

body.en: Bian Ver belongs with Verdesse.
body.zh: Bian Ver 应归于 Verdesse。

body.en: The shared name does not establish a white mutation of Barbera.
body.zh: 同名不能证明为 Barbera 白色突变。

body.en: This ambiguous name has applied to Barbera Bianca and Barbassese.
body.zh: 有歧义的名称曾用于 Barbera Bianca 及 Barbassese。

body.en: Lambrusca di Alessandria is Vitis vinifera, not Vitis labrusca.
body.zh: Lambrusca di Alessandria 属 Vitis vinifera，非 Vitis labrusca。

body.en: A surviving Bianchetto di Saluzzo accession confirms preserved material, not necessarily commercial production.
body.zh: Bianchetto di Saluzzo 种质存续证明材料保存，不一定证明商业生产。

body.en: Functionally female flowers require suitable pollination; poor set can cause variable yields.
body.zh: 功能性雌花需合适授粉，坐果不良使产量波动。

body.en: Low basal-bud fertility favours long pruning for Neretto di Bairo.
body.zh: Neretto di Bairo 基部芽结实性低，适合长梢修剪。

body.en: Roero’s thermal contrasts and storm/hail risk make slope exposure important; a single regional temperature label cannot describe every vineyard.
body.zh: Roero 温差及风暴冰雹风险使坡向重要，单一地区气温标签不能描述所有葡萄园。

body.en: Carema’s dry-stone terraces and stone-supported pergolas are a distinct mountain viticulture system, unlike mechanisable lowland rows.
body.zh: Carema 干砌梯田及石柱棚架构成独特山地栽培体系，不同于可机械化平地行植。

body.en: At least 95% Arneis.
body.zh: 至少 95% Arneis。

body.en: At least 95% Nebbiolo.
body.zh: 至少 95% Nebbiolo。

body.en: Minimum 38 months, including 18 in wood.
body.zh: 最低 38 个月，其中 18 个月木质容器。

body.en: Minimum 26 months, including 9 in wood.
body.zh: 最低 26 个月，其中 9 个月木质容器。

body.en: Dry aromatic wine is possible; the grape name does not require sweetness.
body.zh: 可以酿芳香型干白，品种名不要求甜度。

body.en: Cascina Castlet uses selected dried Uvalino grapes for Uceline.
body.zh: Cascina Castlet 使用精选风干 Uvalino 酿 Uceline。

body.en: Antoniolo, Nervi and Travaglini are consortium-listed Gattinara producers.
body.zh: Antoniolo、Nervi、Travaglini 为协会列明的 Gattinara 生产者。

body.en: Marenco provides an Albarossa reference; Cascina Castlet’s Uceline documents Uvalino recovery and fruit drying.
body.zh: Marenco 提供 Albarossa 参考；Cascina Castlet 的 Uceline 记录 Uvalino 恢复及风干。

body.en: Verduno Pelaverga’s peppery expression is associated with rotundone research reported in 2021.
body.zh: Verduno Pelaverga 胡椒表现关联 2021 年报告的 rotundone 研究。

body.en: Cold-temperate subcontinental conditions are modified by Alpine shelter and mild humid air from the Ligurian Sea.
body.zh: 偏凉温带亚大陆性条件受阿尔卑斯屏障及 Ligurian 海温和湿润气流调节。

body.en: The Barolo zone is relatively sheltered from wind while receiving Alpine currents and warm humid air rising from the Tanaro valley.
body.zh: Barolo 相对避风，同时受阿尔卑斯气流及 Tanaro 谷地上升暖湿气流影响。

body.en: Roero is relatively dry; its permeable sandy ground and limited temporary reserves make winter water recharge important.
body.zh: Roero 相对干燥，砂地高渗透性及有限短期储水使冬季补水重要。

role.zh: 2020 遗传研究记录的西北历史栽培。

role.en: Northwestern historical cultivation documented by the 2020 genetic study.
role.zh: 2020 遗传研究记录的西北历史栽培。

note.en: Producer reference for Barbera × Chatus.
note.zh: Barbera × Chatus 生产者参考。

note.en: Uvalino with a fruit-drying step.
note.zh: 包含果实风干的 Uvalino。

intro.en: A Primitivo-led red DOC in Taranto and Brindisi, distinct from the sweet DOCG.
intro.zh: Taranto 与 Brindisi 的 Primitivo 主体红酒 DOC，与甜型 DOCG 分开。

body.en: Primitivo di Manduria DOC
body.zh: Primitivo di Manduria DOC

body.en: Taranto and Brindisi.
body.zh: Taranto 与 Brindisi。

body.en: Manduria and the surrounding Ionian-facing countryside.
body.zh: Manduria 及其周边面向爱奥尼亚海的乡村。

body.en: The dry/abboccato DOC is separate from Dolce Naturale DOCG.
body.zh: 干型／微甜 DOC 与 Dolce Naturale DOCG 分开。

body.en: Primitivo at least 85%.
body.zh: Primitivo 至少 85%。

body.en: Up to 15% suitable non-aromatic black varieties.
body.zh: 最多 15% 获准非芳香黑葡萄。

body.en: Primitivo is the Italian name of the Zinfandel/Tribidrag genotype.
body.zh: Primitivo 为 Zinfandel／Tribidrag 同型葡萄的意大利名称。

body.en: Emergency irrigation is permitted; forcing is prohibited.
body.zh: 允许应急灌溉，禁止催产。

body.en: Grapes must come from the delimited suitable land, not all of both provinces.
body.zh: 葡萄须来自划定适宜地块，并非两省所有土地。

body.en: High sugar potential requires matching phenolic ripeness to the intended style.
body.zh: 高糖潜力需与目标风格及酚类成熟协调。

body.en: Primitivo di Manduria and Riserva.
body.zh: 普通及 Riserva。

body.en: At least 24 months ageing, including 9 months in wood.
body.zh: 至少 24 个月熟化，其中 9 个月木桶。

body.en: Riserva ageing is calculated from 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: Riserva 熟化从采收年 11 月 1 日起算。

body.en: Dry to abboccato; reducing sugar no more than 18 g/L.
body.zh: 干至微甜，糖不高于 18 g/L。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 13.5%; Riserva 14%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 13.5%，Riserva 14%。

body.en: Full red wine; permitted sweetness is not the same as the Dolce Naturale category.
body.zh: 饱满红酒，允许的残糖并不等于 Dolce Naturale 类别。

role.zh: Primitivo 至少 85%。

sources.title: Consorzio · Primitivo di Manduria DOC rules

coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

name: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale DOCG

intro.en: A naturally sweet Primitivo DOCG with its own composition, sugar and release rules.
intro.zh: 自然甜型 Primitivo DOCG，具有独立比例、糖分与上市规则。

body.en: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale DOCG
body.zh: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale DOCG

body.en: Taranto and Brindisi.
body.zh: Taranto 与 Brindisi。

body.en: Full protected name includes Dolce Naturale.
body.zh: 完整受保护名称包含 Dolce Naturale。

body.en: A separate DOCG, not a Riserva tier of the dry DOC.
body.zh: 独立 DOCG，不是干型 DOC 的 Riserva 等级。

body.en: Primitivo 100%.
body.zh: 100% Primitivo。

body.en: Grapes must provide at least 16% potential natural alcohol.
body.zh: 葡萄须具至少 16% 天然潜在酒精度。

body.en: The same Primitivo genotype as in the neighbouring DOC.
body.zh: 与邻近 DOC 为同一 Primitivo 品种。

body.en: Natural concentration may include drying on the vine or after harvest.
body.zh: 可通过藤上或采后自然干燥浓缩。

body.en: Forcing is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止催产。

body.en: Emergency irrigation is allowed.
body.zh: 允许应急灌溉。

body.en: Enrichment is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止增浓。

body.en: Residual reducing sugars at least 50 g/L.
body.zh: 残余还原糖至少 50 g/L。

body.en: Natural sweet wine; not automatically fortified.
body.zh: 自然甜酒，并非自动归为加强酒。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 16%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 16%。

body.en: Minimum actual alcohol 13%.
body.zh: 最低实际酒精度 13%。

body.en: Not before 1 June following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 6 月 1 日。

role.zh: 100% Primitivo。

sources.title: Consorzio · Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale DOCG rules

intro.en: Cross-regional Glera-led denomination spanning Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia, with separately specified white and rosé styles.
intro.zh: 跨 Veneto、Friuli-Venezia Giulia 的 Glera 主导产区，白酒与桃红各有规范。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC, distinct from Conegliano Valdobbiadene and Asolo DOCGs.
body.zh: DOC，与 Conegliano Valdobbiadene、Asolo 两个 DOCG 独立。

body.en: Established in 2009.
body.zh: 建立于 2009 年。

body.en: Belluno, Padova, Treviso, Venezia and Vicenza provinces.
body.zh: Belluno、Padova、Treviso、Venezia、Vicenza 五省。

body.en: Gorizia, Pordenone, Trieste and Udine provinces.
body.zh: Gorizia、Pordenone、Trieste、Udine 四省。

body.en: Verona is not one of the nine DOC provinces.
body.zh: Verona 不在九个 DOC 省份中。

body.en: Glera at least 85%.
body.zh: Glera 至少 85%。

body.en: Up to 15% Verdiso, Bianchetta Trevigiana, Perera, Glera Lunga, Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc, Pinot Gris or white-vinified Pinot Noir.
body.zh: 最多 15% Verdiso、Bianchetta Trevigiana、Perera、Glera Lunga、Chardonnay、Pinot Blanc、Pinot Gris、白酿 Pinot Noir。

body.en: Glera 85–90%; red-vinified Pinot Noir 10–15%.
body.zh: Glera 85–90%；红酿 Pinot Noir 10–15%。

body.en: Millesimato is compulsory; at least 85% from the stated vintage.
body.zh: 必须标 Millesimato，至少 85% 来自所标年份。

body.en: Provincial mentions require grape production, vinification and bottling within the stated province.
body.zh: 省名标示要求种植、酿造、装瓶均在该省。

body.en: Still, frizzante and spumante.
body.zh: 静止、微起泡、起泡。

body.en: Rosé is exclusively spumante.
body.zh: 桃红仅为 spumante 起泡。

body.en: Tank fermentation is central to the fresh fruit-led sparkling style.
body.zh: 罐式二次发酵是清新果味起泡风格的核心。

body.en: Prosecco DOC rosé rules cannot be transferred to either DOCG.
body.zh: Prosecco DOC 桃红规则不可移植到两个 DOCG。

body.en: Glera is the grape name; Prosecco is the protected wine designation.
body.zh: Glera 为品种名；Prosecco 为受保护酒名。

intro.en: Puglia combines Primitivo and Negroamaro country with Uva di Troia in the north and a diverse central white-grape tradition. Its principal names cover distinct legal styles rather than a single warm-climate red-wine model.
intro.zh: Puglia 除 Primitivo、Negroamaro 外，北部以 Uva di Troia 为重点，中部白葡萄传统多样；各主要名称代表不同法定酒型。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Castel del Monte occupies the Murgia landscape north of Bari.
body.zh: Castel del Monte 位于 Bari 以北的 Murgia 地景。

body.en: Manduria lies in the Taranto–Brindisi denomination; Gioia del Colle is a separate inland denomination.
body.zh: Manduria 酒区涉及 Taranto、Brindisi；Gioia del Colle 为独立内陆酒区。

body.en: Valle d’Itria around Locorotondo and Martina Franca supports local white traditions.
body.zh: Locorotondo、Martina Franca 周边 Valle d’Itria 保留地方白葡萄传统。

body.en: Limestone and calcarenite dominate the documented Castel del Monte landscape.
body.zh: 所引 Castel del Monte 资料以石灰岩及钙质砂岩为主。

body.en: Karst landforms and fissured rock affect drainage and usable rooting space.
body.zh: 岩溶地貌与岩石裂隙影响排水及根域。

body.en: Castel del Monte geology should not be applied as a uniform soil description to all Puglia.
body.zh: 不可把 Castel del Monte 地质套用为全 Puglia 的单一土壤。

body.en: The Castel del Monte account describes hot dry summers and cooler inland winters.
body.zh: Castel del Monte 资料描述夏季炎热干燥、内陆冬季较冷。

body.en: Manduria rules permit emergency irrigation while prohibiting forcing.
body.zh: Manduria 规范允许应急灌溉、禁止催产。

body.en: Inland position, elevation and exposure are relevant when comparing northern Murgia and southern Primitivo sites.
body.zh: 比较北部 Murgia 与南部 Primitivo 地点时，应考虑内陆位置、海拔及朝向。

body.en: Bombino Bianco × Uva Rosa Antica/Quagliano produced Bombino Nero, Impigno and Uva di Troia.
body.zh: Bombino Bianco × Uva Rosa Antica／Quagliano 产生 Bombino Nero、Impigno、Uva di Troia。

body.en: Authenticated Pampanuto and Verdeca share the same genotype.
body.zh: 经鉴定 Pampanuto 与 Verdeca 同型。

body.en: Historically called Fiano locally, but distinct from Fiano di Avellino; the berries have a muscat-like flavour.
body.zh: 当地历史上称 Fiano，但不同于 Fiano di Avellino；果粒有 Muscat 类香味。

body.en: One broad DOC and three separate DOCGs: Bombino Nero, Rosso Riserva and Nero di Troia Riserva.
body.zh: 一个综合 DOC 及三个独立 DOCG：Bombino Nero、Rosso Riserva、Nero di Troia Riserva。

body.en: Castel del Monte Bombino Nero requires at least 90% Bombino Nero.
body.zh: Castel del Monte Bombino Nero 须至少 90% Bombino Nero。

body.en: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale is a distinct 100% Primitivo DOCG with at least 50 g/L sugar.
body.zh: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale 为独立 DOCG，100% Primitivo，糖至少 50 g/L。

body.en: The Primitivo type is 100% Primitivo; the generic Rosso uses a separate blend.
body.zh: Primitivo 酒型为 100% Primitivo；普通 Rosso 使用另一配比。

body.en: The denomination covers red, rosato and white categories; current standard red/rosato requires Negroamaro ≥85%.
body.zh: 涵盖红、桃红及白酒；现行普通红／桃红须 Negroamaro 至少 85%。

body.en: The DOC permits dry to abboccato wine up to 18 g/L sugar; that does not make it Dolce Naturale DOCG.
body.zh: DOC 允许干至微甜、糖最高 18 g/L，不能因此标作 Dolce Naturale DOCG。

body.en: The two red Riserva DOCGs require two years, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 两个红酒 Riserva DOCG 均须两年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: At least 24 months, including nine in wood, from 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少 24 个月，其中木桶九个月。

body.en: At least 12 months from 1 November of the harvest year; ≥90% Negroamaro and vines at least ten years old.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少 12 个月；Negroamaro 至少 90%，葡萄藤至少十年。

body.en: Early flowering; harvest normally in the second to third ten-day period of September.
body.zh: 早开花，通常九月中至下旬成熟采收。

body.en: Salice Salentino Superiore has a 9 t/ha limit and excludes pergola/tendone training.
body.zh: Salice Salentino Superiore 最高 9 吨／公顷，不用 pergola／tendone。

body.en: Manduria Dolce Naturale prohibits enrichment; minimum total alcohol 16%, actual 13%.
body.zh: Manduria Dolce Naturale 禁止增浓，最低总酒精 16%、实际 13%。

role.en: Primitivo: Manduria and Gioia del Colle.
role.zh: Primitivo：Manduria 与 Gioia del Colle。
Salice Salentino 红／桃红主体。

intro.en: Sweet Verduzzo Friulano DOCG on the southern slopes of Monte Bernadia around Nimis and Tarcento.
intro.zh: Nimis、Tarcento 周边 Monte Bernadia 南坡的甜型 Verduzzo Friulano DOCG。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG devoted to sweet white wine, with a regulated Riserva.
body.zh: 甜白 DOCG，含受规范 Riserva。

body.en: DOCG recognised in 2001.
body.zh: 2001 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Delimited parts of Nimis and Tarcento, Udine province.
body.zh: Udine 省 Nimis、Tarcento 划定部分。

body.en: Terraced south-facing Monte Bernadia slopes, approximately 250–413 metres.
body.zh: Monte Bernadia 朝南梯田坡，约 250–413 米。

body.en: A relatively wet hillside environment; exposure and ventilation matter.
body.zh: 相对多雨的丘陵环境，朝向、通风重要。

body.en: Eocene marls dominate the local hillside setting.
body.zh: 始新世泥灰岩主导当地丘陵。

body.en: 100% Verduzzo Friulano, locally called Verduzzo Giallo.
body.zh: 100% Verduzzo Friulano，本地称 Verduzzo Giallo。

body.en: Not Verduzzo Trevigiano, and not a Picolit blend.
body.zh: 不是 Verduzzo Trevigiano，也非 Picolit 混酿。

body.en: New plantings: at least 3,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 新植至少 3,000 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 8 t/ha and wine conversion 65%.
body.zh: 葡萄产量最高 8 吨／公顷，出酒率 65%。

body.en: Ordinary wine: November of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 普通酒：采收次年十一月。

body.en: From 1 December of the third year from harvest, as specified in the code.
body.zh: 按规章，自采收起第三年十二月一日起。

body.en: Grapes may dry on the vine or in suitable drying rooms.
body.zh: 葡萄可在藤上或适当风干室失水。

body.en: Wooden vessels are permitted.
body.zh: 允许使用木容器。

body.en: Sweet, full and sometimes tannic, with ripe fruit and honeyed notes.
body.zh: 甜、饱满，有时有单宁，呈熟果、蜂蜜气息。

role.zh: 唯一品种，100%。

intro.en: Sweet red DOCG made from dried grapes; a separate denomination from Amarone.
intro.zh: 以风干葡萄酿制的甜红 DOCG，与 Amarone 独立。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG recognised in 2010, following the earlier DOC tradition.
body.zh: 2010 年获 DOCG，承接此前 DOC 传统。

body.en: Sweet dried-grape wine precedes modern dry-style Amarone.
body.zh: 甜型风干酒传统早于现代干型风格 Amarone。

body.en: Verona province, north of the city and east towards the Lessini valleys.
body.zh: Verona 省，城市北侧并向东延入 Lessini 谷地。

body.en: Negrar, Marano, Fumane, Sant’Ambrogio and San Pietro in Cariano form the historical core.
body.zh: Negrar、Marano、Fumane、Sant’Ambrogio、San Pietro in Cariano 构成历史核心。

body.en: A separate geographical mention referring to the Valpantena valley.
body.zh: 指 Valpantena 谷地的独立地理标示。

body.en: Lessini relief and proximity to Lake Garda create varied exposures and airflow.
body.zh: Lessini 地形与 Garda 湖邻近性形成多样朝向及气流。

body.en: Calcareous and dolomitic rocks, basalt, morainic and river deposits occur.
body.zh: 石灰质及白云岩、玄武岩、冰碛及河流沉积并存。

body.en: Corvina/Corvinone and Rondinella underpin the wine.
body.zh: Corvina／Corvinone 与 Rondinella 构成基础。

body.en: Corvina and/or Corvinone 45–95%; Rondinella 5–30%.
body.zh: Corvina 和／或 Corvinone 45–95%；Rondinella 5–30%。

body.en: Peaty and excessively damp valley-floor sites are excluded.
body.zh: 排除泥炭及过湿谷底地块。

body.en: Still Recioto and Recioto spumante are both recognised.
body.zh: 同时认可静止 Recioto 与 Recioto spumante。

body.en: Still wines may be Classico or Valpantena; spumante may be Valpantena.
body.zh: 静止可标 Classico、Valpantena；起泡可标 Valpantena。

body.en: Veneto decree 20024/2026 authorises vinification from 2 November 2026 for the 2026 harvest only.
body.zh: Veneto 20024/2026 号令允许 2026 年采收葡萄自 2026 年 11 月 2 日起酿造，仅限该年份。

body.en: Healthy bunch selection and ventilated drying concentrate the grapes.
body.zh: 健康果穗选择及通风风干浓缩果实。

body.en: Fermentation is managed to preserve substantial grape sugar.
body.zh: 控制发酵，保留大量葡萄糖分。

body.en: Sweet, concentrated red fruit contrasts with Amarone’s dry-style finish.
body.zh: 甜、浓缩红果与 Amarone 干型风格收尾对比。

body.en: DOCG

body.en: Romagna Albana Spumante DOC is a separate denomination.

body.zh: Secco、amabile、dolce、passito 为本 DOCG 内风格区分。

body.en: Dried grapes yield a concentrated sweet style.
body.zh: 风干葡萄形成浓缩甜酒。

body.en: Dry Albana can have substantial body and a phenolic grip.
body.zh: 干型 Albana 可有厚酒体及酚类抓力。

body.en: Passito combines concentration and sweetness with acidity.
body.zh: Passito 将浓缩、甜度与酸度结合。

body.en: Albana DOCG does not imply that every wine is sweet.

body.zh: 新植至少 4,000 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 8 t/ha and 2 kg per vine.
body.zh: 最高 8 吨／公顷、每株 2 千克。

body.en: Wooden vessels are permitted in vinification and maturation.
body.zh: 酿造、熟成可用木容器。

body.en: Livio Felluga’s Abbazia di Rosazzo is an estate reference.
body.zh: Livio Felluga 的 Abbazia di Rosazzo 为庄园参照。

body.en: Rosazzo DOCG is neither a Picolit sweet wine nor the DOC’s Pignolo di Rosazzo.
body.zh: Rosazzo DOCG 既非 Picolit 甜酒，也非 DOC 的 Pignolo di Rosazzo。

role.en: Documented local grape or specified appellation component.
role.zh: 有记录的本地品种或法定产区组分。

note.en: Abbey vineyard white blend; individual producer reference.
note.zh: 修道院葡萄园白混酿，具体酒庄参照。

intro.en: Earlier-release Sangiovese from Montalcino, with its own DOC rules.
intro.zh: Montalcino 较早上市的 Sangiovese，具有独立 DOC 规则。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: 100% Sangiovese, locally Brunello.
body.zh: 100% Sangiovese，当地称 Brunello。

body.en: DOC recognised in 1983.
body.zh: 1983年获 DOC。

body.en: The delimited Montalcino area in Siena province, southern inland Tuscany.
body.zh: Siena 省 Montalcino 划定范围，位于托斯卡纳内陆南部。

body.en: A hill landscape with varied exposures; Monte Amiata influences protection from weather to the southeast.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向多样，东南方向 Monte Amiata 影响气候屏障。

body.en: Sangiovese alone; neither Cabernet nor Merlot is permitted in the blend.
body.zh: 只用 Sangiovese，配方不允许 Cabernet 或 Merlot。

body.en: The base DOC specification permits up to 9 t/ha.
body.zh: 基础 DOC 规范最高每公顷9吨。

body.en: 1 September of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 采收次年9月1日。

body.en: A 2025 Rosso can be released from 1 September 2026.
body.zh: 2025 Rosso 最早2026年9月1日上市。

body.en: No mandatory oak-ageing period in the DOC specification.
body.zh: DOC 规范未强制橡木熟成期。

body.en: Styles vary by producer; the earlier release supports fresher fruit expression.
body.zh: 风格随酒庄变化，较早上市有利于鲜果表达。

body.en: Compare its fresher fruit and shorter maturation with Brunello from the same estate.
body.zh: 可与同庄 Brunello 比较鲜果感及较短熟成的影响。

body.en: Roast meat, game and mushroom dishes are useful comparative pairings.
body.zh: 烤肉、野味与蘑菇菜可作为配餐比较。

role.en: Exclusive grape; Brunello is the local name.
role.zh: 唯一品种，Brunello 是地方名称。

intro.en: Dry aromatic red DOCG in Astigiano Monferrato.
intro.zh: Astigiano Monferrato 芳香干红 DOCG。

body.en: Dry aromatic red DOCG in Astigiano Monferrato.
body.zh: Astigiano Monferrato 芳香干红 DOCG。

body.en: DOC 1987; DOCG 2010; Riserva incorporated in the 2020 amendment.
body.zh: 1987 DOC；2010 DOCG；2020 修订加入 Riserva。

body.en: Seven communes on the Tanaro’s left side, centred on Castagnole Monferrato.
body.zh: Tanaro 左侧七市镇，以 Castagnole Monferrato 为中心。

body.en: Dry aromatic red DOCG in Astigiano Monferrato.
body.zh: Astigiano Monferrato 芳香干红 DOCG。

body.en: DOC 1987; DOCG 2010; Riserva incorporated in the 2020 amendment.
body.zh: 1987 DOC；2010 DOCG；2020 修订加入 Riserva。

body.en: Seven communes on the Tanaro’s left side, centred on Castagnole Monferrato.
body.zh: Tanaro 左侧七市镇，以 Castagnole Monferrato 为中心。

body.en: Grana, Montemagno, Portacomaro, Refrancore, Scurzolengo and Viarigi.
body.zh: Grana、Montemagno、Portacomaro、Refrancore、Scurzolengo、Viarigi。

body.en: Dry, sunny hillsides; new north-facing vineyards excluded.
body.zh: 干燥向阳丘陵；排除新植北向园。

body.en: Monferrato marls meet Pliocene Asti sands; relatively loose calcareous soils.
body.zh: Monferrato 泥灰岩过渡至上新世 Asti 砂层；石灰质土相对疏松。

body.en: Ruchè ≥90%; Barbera and/or Brachetto ≤10%.
body.zh: Ruchè ≥90%；Barbera 及／或 Brachetto ≤10%。

body.en: Vertical shoots, Guyot or low cordon; new vineyards ≥4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 直立枝条、Guyot 或低单臂；新园 ≥4,000 株/公顷。

body.en: 9 t/ha; mature Vigna vineyards 8 t/ha.
body.zh: 9 吨/公顷；成熟 Vigna 葡萄园 8 吨/公顷。

body.en: 24 months from 1 November of harvest year, including ≥12 months in wood.
body.zh: 采收年 11 月 1 日起 24 个月，含木质容器 ≥12 个月。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%, including Riserva.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 12.5%，包括 Riserva。

body.en: Vintage mandatory; Vigna requires separate traceability.
body.zh: 必须标年份；Vigna 须独立追溯。

body.en: Vinification within Asti province.
body.zh: 在 Asti 省内酿造。

body.en: Dry, medium-bodied, aromatic fruit and spice; gently tannic.
body.zh: 干型、中酒体、芳香水果及香料；单宁较柔和。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

role.en: Authorised variety; composition and category are specified above.
role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

role.zh: 获准品种；具体比例及类别见上文。

intro.en: A Salento DOC led by Negroamaro, with revised composition and Superiore rules in May 2026.
intro.zh: 以 Negroamaro 为主的 Salento DOC，2026 年 5 月更新比例与 Superiore 规则。

body.en: Salice Salentino DOC
body.zh: Salice Salentino DOC

body.en: Salento, across delimited land in Lecce and Brindisi.
body.zh: Salento，Lecce 与 Brindisi 的划定区域。

body.en: Salice Salentino and surrounding communes.
body.zh: Salice Salentino 及周边市镇。

body.en: Decree 19 May 2026, published 27 May 2026.
body.zh: 2026 年 5 月 19 日法令，5 月 27 日公布。

body.en: Negroamaro at least 85%, replacing the older lower threshold.
body.zh: Negroamaro 至少 85%，不可继续采用旧的较低门槛。

body.en: At least 90% Negroamaro.
body.zh: 至少 90% Negroamaro。

body.en: Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Fiano and Verdeca jointly or separately at least 70%.
body.zh: Chardonnay、Pinot Bianco、Fiano、Verdeca 单独或合计至少 70%。

body.en: Vines at least 10 years old.
body.zh: 葡萄藤至少 10 年。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.en: Pergola and tendone systems are prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止 pergola 及 tendone 架式。

body.en: Each named white category requires at least 85% of its named grape.
body.zh: 单列白品种酒须至少 85% 所标品种。

body.en: Negroamaro at least 90%.
body.zh: Negroamaro 至少 90%。

body.en: Aleatico Dolce/Dolce Liquoroso requires at least 85% Aleatico.
body.zh: Aleatico Dolce／Dolce Liquoroso 须至少 85% Aleatico。

body.en: At least 12 months.
body.zh: 至少 12 个月。

body.en: From 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: 从采收年 11 月 1 日起。

body.en: Superiore and varietal naming carry additional rules; generic Rosso composition is insufficient to claim either.
body.zh: Superiore 与品种标示各有附加规则，仅满足普通 Rosso 比例并不够。

role.en: Generic red/rosato ≥85%; named Negroamaro and Superiore ≥90%.
role.zh: 普通红／桃红至少 85%；标 Negroamaro 及 Superiore 至少 90%。

role.en: Bianco blend and named varietal category.
role.zh: 白混酿与单列品种酒型。

role.en: Bianco blend and named varietal category.
role.zh: 白混酿与单列品种酒型。

coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: Sardegna combines the Vermentino of Gallura, Cannonau across the island, Carignano in Sulcis and long-aged Vernaccia around Oristano. Local synonyms require particular care: Bovale Sardo, Cagnulari and Bovale Grande are not interchangeable labels.
intro.zh: Sardegna 包括 Gallura 的 Vermentino、全岛 Cannonau、Sulcis 的 Carignano 及 Oristano 长期熟化 Vernaccia；Bovale Sardo、Cagnulari、Bovale Grande 不可随意互换。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Gallura is northeastern Sardegna; Sulcis is southwestern.
body.zh: Gallura 在东北，Sulcis 在西南。

body.en: Oristano’s reference vineyards include the lower Tirso and Sinis.
body.zh: Oristano 代表葡萄园位于 Tirso 下游及 Sinis。

body.en: Mandrolisai includes Atzara, Desulo, Meana Sardo, Ortueri, Samugheo, Sorgono and Tonara.
body.zh: Mandrolisai 包括 Atzara、Desulo、Meana Sardo、Ortueri、Samugheo、Sorgono、Tonara。

body.en: Vernaccia di Oristano 1971, Cannonau di Sardegna 1972, Carignano del Sulcis 1977.
body.zh: Vernaccia di Oristano 1971、Cannonau di Sardegna 1972、Carignano del Sulcis 1977。

body.en: Mandrolisai DOC was recognised in 1981.
body.zh: Mandrolisai DOC 于 1981 年认可。

body.en: Vermentino di Gallura obtained DOCG in 1996.
body.zh: Vermentino di Gallura 于 1996 年获 DOCG。

body.en: The DOCG requires soils from decomposed granite, generally coarse sand with finer components.
body.zh: DOCG 要求源自花岗岩分解的土壤，通常为粗砂夹细粒。

body.en: Eligible DOCG sites do not exceed 500 m.
body.zh: DOCG 合资格园地不超过 500 米。

body.en: Contini describes low-lying alluvial, sandy and slightly clayey soils in its source area.
body.zh: Contini 描述原料地区为低海拔冲积、砂质、略带黏土土壤。

body.en: Authenticated Muristellu/Bovale Sardo is Carcajolo Noir/Parraleta, not Cagnulari.
body.zh: 经鉴定 Muristellu／Bovale Sardo 即 Carcajolo Noir／Parraleta，不是 Cagnulari。

body.en: Cagnulari corresponds to Graciano; Barbera Sarda is a local synonym, not Piemonte Barbera.
body.zh: Cagnulari 对应 Graciano；Barbera Sarda 为地方同义名，并非 Piemonte Barbera。

body.en: Granatza matches Guarnaccia Bianca. Vernaccia di Oristano matches authenticated nationally registered Spergola, not every historical accession with that name.
body.zh: Granatza 对应 Guarnaccia Bianca；Vernaccia di Oristano 对应经鉴定国家注册 Spergola，并非所有历史同名材料。

body.en: Gallura DOCG requires Vermentino at least 95%; it is separate from Vermentino di Sardegna DOC.
body.zh: Gallura DOCG 须 Vermentino 至少 95%，与 Vermentino di Sardegna DOC 分开。

body.en: Standard Cannonau DOC ≥85%; Classico ≥90%, within delimited Nuoro/Ogliastra.
body.zh: 普通 Cannonau DOC 至少 85%；Classico 至少 90%，限划定 Nuoro／Ogliastra。

body.en: Bovale Sardo ≥35%, Cannonau 20–35%, Monica 20–35%.
body.zh: Bovale Sardo 至少 35%，Cannonau 20–35%，Monica 20–35%。

body.en: At least 3,250 vines/ha for new/replanted vineyards; regular yield 10 t/ha, Superiore 9.
body.zh: 新植／重植至少 3,250 株／公顷，普通 10 吨／公顷、Superiore 9 吨。

body.en: Alberello or supported alberello; maximum 7.5 t/ha.
body.zh: 灌木式或有支撑灌木式，最高 7.5 吨／公顷。

body.en: Standard maximum 11 t/ha; Classico 9 t/ha.
body.zh: 普通最高 11 吨／公顷，Classico 9 吨。

body.en: Standard two years in oak/chestnut; Superiore three; Riserva four. Contini Flor illustrates maturation under a yeast veil in partly filled casks.
body.zh: 普通橡木／栗木桶两年，Superiore 三年，Riserva 四年；Contini Flor 为不装满桶内酒花膜熟化实例。

body.en: Riserva two years including six months wood; Classico two years including one year wood.
body.zh: Riserva 两年含六个月木桶；Classico 两年含一年木桶。

body.en: Riserva and Superiore require two years, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: Riserva、Superiore 须两年，其中瓶陈六个月。

body.en: Vernaccia Flor spends about four years under flor; its recommended temperatures vary with aperitif or dessert service.
body.zh: Vernaccia Flor 在酒花膜下约四年，建议温度随开胃或甜点搭配而变。

body.en: Authenticated Sardinian accession research distinguishes local synonyms and preserves rare germplasm.
body.zh: 经鉴定 Sardegna 材料研究用于厘清地方同义名及保留稀有种质。

body.en: Malvasia di Sardegna matches Malvasia di Lipari; island origin does not imply a separate genotype.
body.zh: Malvasia di Sardegna 与 Malvasia di Lipari 同型，来自不同岛屿不表示不同基因型。

role.zh: Gallura DOCG 白酒主体。

role.en: Cannonau; island-wide DOC and Mandrolisai component.
role.zh: Cannonau，全岛 DOC 及 Mandrolisai 组分。
Carignano del Sulcis。

role.en: Oristano DOC; authenticated registered Spergola synonym.
role.zh: Oristano DOC；与经鉴定注册 Spergola 同型。
Mandrolisai 的 Muristellu／Bovale Sardo。
Cagnulari／Barbera Sarda 身份。
当地 Granatza。

role.en: Documented regional cultivation or conservation; see the grape dossier for exact locality and identity.
role.zh: 有文献的区域种植或保育；具体地点及身份见品种档案。

role.en: Documented regional cultivation or conservation; see the grape dossier for exact locality and identity.
role.zh: 有文献的区域种植或保育；具体地点及身份见品种档案。

role.en: Documented regional cultivation or conservation; see the grape dossier for exact locality and identity.
role.zh: 有文献的区域种植或保育；具体地点及身份见品种档案。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: Dry red made from dried Nebbiolo grapes.
intro.zh: 风干 Nebbiolo 酿成的干红。

body.en: Dry red made from dried Nebbiolo grapes.
body.zh: 风干 Nebbiolo 酿成的干红。

body.en: Sfursat is the local form of Sforzato.
body.zh: Sfursat 为 Sforzato 地方形式。

body.en: Valtellina in Sondrio province.
body.zh: Sondrio 省 Valtellina。

body.en: Dry red made from dried Nebbiolo grapes.
body.zh: 风干 Nebbiolo 酿成的干红。

body.en: Sfursat is the local form of Sforzato.
body.zh: Sfursat 为 Sforzato 地方形式。

body.en: Valtellina in Sondrio province.
body.zh: Sondrio 省 Valtellina。

body.en: Minimum 90%; other permitted non-aromatic red grapes at most 10%.
body.zh: 最低 90%，其他获准非芳香红葡萄最多 10%。

body.en: Healthy grapes are selected for drying.
body.zh: 精选健康葡萄用于风干。

body.en: Maximum fresh-grape yield 8 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 鲜果最高每公顷 8 吨。

body.en: Ordinarily not before 1 December; an officially authorised earlier start can apply under specified conditions.
body.zh: 通常不得早于 12 月 1 日，特定条件下可官方批准提前。

body.en: Minimum 20 months, including 12 in wood.
body.zh: 最低 20 个月，含 12 个月木质容器。

body.en: Finished-wine yield is capped at 40 hl/ha.
body.zh: 成酒最高每公顷 40 百升。

body.en: Drying concentrates the fruit before fermentation.
body.zh: 发酵前风干浓缩果实。

body.en: Rainoldi’s producer reference matures in 25- and 56-hl oak casks for 20 months.
body.zh: Rainoldi 参考酒以 25 及 56 百升橡木桶熟成 20 个月。

body.en: Dried fruit does not mean a sweet finished wine; the consortium identifies this as dry red.
body.zh: 风干果实不等于甜型成酒，协会明确为干红。

role.en: Regional grape; see its specific PDO and cultivation record.
role.zh: 地区葡萄，具体 PDO 及栽培情况见关联档案。

note.en: Dried fruit and large-oak maturation.
note.zh: 风干果实及大橡木桶熟成。

intro.en: Sicilia ranges from Etna’s volcanic vineyards and Vittoria’s red blends to western fortified wines and island passiti. Its indigenous grape collection includes both established varieties and recently recovered material.
intro.zh: Sicilia 从 Etna 火山葡萄园、Vittoria 红酒混酿，延伸至西部加强酒及离岛风干酒；本地葡萄既有成熟主流品种，也有近年恢复材料。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Delimitations cover eligible vineyards in 20 Catania communes around the volcano.
body.zh: 火山周围 Catania 省 20 个市镇的合资格园地。

body.en: Cerasuolo di Vittoria spans delimited southeastern areas in Ragusa, Caltanissetta and Catania provinces.
body.zh: Cerasuolo di Vittoria 涉及东南部 Ragusa、Caltanissetta、Catania 三省划定区域。

body.en: The Trapani production area excludes Pantelleria, Favignana and Alcamo.
body.zh: Trapani 生产范围不含 Pantelleria、Favignana、Alcamo。

body.en: DOC in 1973; DOCG in 2005.
body.zh: 1973 年 DOC，2005 年 DOCG。

body.en: Malvasia delle Lipari DOC dates to 1973.
body.zh: Malvasia delle Lipari DOC 始于 1973 年。

body.en: The 2014 regional monograph documents recovered accessions, morphology, genetic relationships and experimental wine assessment.
body.zh: 2014 大区专著记录恢复材料、形态、遗传关系及试验酿酒。

body.en: Volcanic substrates and distinct lava-flow histories contribute to site variation.
body.zh: 火山母质及不同熔岩流历史带来地点差异。

body.en: Castellaro’s Corinto vineyard is on sandy volcanic soils at 350 m.
body.zh: Castellaro 的 Corinto 园为海拔 350 米砂质火山土。

body.en: Volcanic descriptions apply to those sites, not to every Sicilian vineyard.
body.zh: 火山土描述适用于具体地点，并非 Sicilia 每一处园地。

body.en: Carricante leads whites; Nerello Mascalese leads reds, with Nerello Cappuccio an allowed complement.
body.zh: 白酒以 Carricante 为主；红酒以 Nerello Mascalese 为主，可辅 Nerello Cappuccio。

body.en: Nero d’Avola supplies 50–70% and Frappato 30–50% of Cerasuolo di Vittoria.
body.zh: Cerasuolo di Vittoria：Nero d’Avola 50–70%，Frappato 30–50%。

body.en: Zibibbo is Muscat of Alexandria; most categories require 100%, with specific Bianco/Frizzante exceptions.
body.zh: Zibibbo 即 Muscat of Alexandria；多数酒型须 100%，Bianco／Frizzante 有具体例外。

body.en: Bianco requires Carricante ≥60%; Bianco Superiore ≥80% and the Milo area.
body.zh: Bianco 须 Carricante 至少 60%；Bianco Superiore 至少 80% 且限 Milo。

body.en: Bianco and Frizzante can include up to 15% other suitable whites under the 2024 specification.
body.zh: 依 2024 规范，Bianco、Frizzante 可含最多 15% 其他获准白葡萄。

body.en: Published specification: Malvasia up to 95%, Corinto Nero 5–8%.
body.zh: 所引已发布规范：Malvasia 最高 95%，Corinto Nero 5–8%。

body.en: Fine 1 year; Superiore 2; Superiore Riserva 4; Vergine 5; Vergine Riserva 10.
body.zh: Fine 一年、Superiore 两年、Superiore Riserva 四年、Vergine 五年、Vergine Riserva 十年。

body.en: At least four years including one in wood, from 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少四年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: Maximum wine conversion 40%; minimum total alcohol 20%, actual 14%; release from 1 July after harvest.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 40%，最低总酒精 20%、实际 14%，采收后次年 7 月 1 日起上市。

body.en: Oro and Ambra use the specified whites; Rubino uses Perricone, Nero d’Avola and Nerello Mascalese, with up to 30% eligible whites.
body.zh: Oro、Ambra 用规定白葡萄；Rubino 用 Perricone、Nero d’Avola、Nerello Mascalese，可含最多 30% 合资格白葡萄。

body.en: No cooked must, concentrated must or sifone; distinguish its production from other Marsala categories.
body.zh: 不加煮汁、浓缩汁或 sifone，须与其他 Marsala 类别区分。

body.en: Tenuta di Castellaro makes a dry 100% Corinto Nero wine, separate from the sweet Malvasia delle Lipari blend.
body.zh: Tenuta di Castellaro 酿造干型 100% Corinto Nero，与 Malvasia delle Lipari 甜型混酿分开。

body.en: The University of Milan project studies and valorises Sicilian grape biodiversity.

body.zh: Trebbiano Spoletino，不同于 Trebbiano Toscano。

body.en: Bianco; Trebbiano Spoletino, Superiore, Spumante and Passito.
body.zh: Bianco；Trebbiano Spoletino、Superiore、Spumante、Passito。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Campello sul Clitunno, Castel Ritaldi, Foligno, Spoleto and Trevi.
body.zh: Montefalco 全境及 Campello sul Clitunno、Castel Ritaldi、Foligno、Spoleto、Trevi 部分地区。

body.en: Plains alternate with low hills, entirely in Perugia province.
body.zh: 平原与低丘交替，全部位于 Perugia 省。

body.zh: 至少50% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: At least 85% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少85% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: Tree-trained old vines survive in the valley.
body.zh: 谷地仍有攀树老藤。

body.en: Cooler humid plains can ripen later than exposed slopes.
body.zh: 凉湿平原成熟可能晚于向阳坡地。

body.en: High natural acidity supports sparkling base wines.
body.zh: 高天然酸度支持起泡基酒。

body.en: Slow ripening with acid retention permits concentration without losing all freshness.
body.zh: 缓慢成熟并保酸，使浓缩后仍可保持清新感。

body.en: At least three months in bottle are required.
body.zh: 要求至少3个月瓶陈。

role.zh: 主体及标示品种。

intro.en: Inland Irpinia red-wine DOCG centred on late-ripening Aglianico, with substantial compulsory maturation.
intro.zh: Irpinia 内陆红酒 DOCG，以晚熟 Aglianico 为核心，要求较长法定熟成。

body.en: DOCG / PDO
body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC on 26 March 1970; DOCG on 11 March 1993.
body.zh: 1970 年 3 月 26 日认可 DOC，1993 年 3 月 11 日升级 DOCG。

body.en: The approved October 2020 text consolidates Taurasi and Taurasi Riserva rules.
body.zh: 2020 年 10 月批准文本汇总 Taurasi 与 Taurasi Riserva 规范。

body.en: Seventeen whole communes in Avellino province, including Taurasi, Montemarano, Castelfranci, Paternopoli and Mirabella Eclano.
body.zh: 涵盖 Avellino 省 17 个完整市镇，包括 Taurasi、Montemarano、Castelfranci、Paternopoli、Mirabella Eclano。

body.en: Bonito, Castelvetere sul Calore, Fontanarosa, Lapio, Luogosano, Montefalcione, Montemiletto, Pietradefusi, Sant’Angelo all’Esca, San Mango sul Calore, Torre le Nocelle and Venticano complete the zone.
body.zh: 其余为 Bonito、Castelvetere sul Calore、Fontanarosa、Lapio、Luogosano、Montefalcione、Montemiletto、Pietradefusi、Sant’Angelo all’Esca、San Mango sul Calore、Torre le Nocelle、Venticano。

body.en: Clay-rich sites and lighter sandy-loam sites coexist. Radici distinguishes clay at Montemarano from sandy loam at Mirabella Eclano; the denomination is not one uniform soil type.
body.zh: 富黏土与较轻砂质壤土并存。Radici 区分 Montemarano 黏土与 Mirabella Eclano 砂质壤土，整个法定区并非单一土质。

body.en: Aglianico at least 85%; other authorized non-aromatic red varieties from Avellino province up to 15%.
body.zh: Aglianico 至少 85%；Avellino 省其他获准非芳香红葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Insufficiently sunny or humid valley-floor sites are excluded. Emergency irrigation is permitted.
body.zh: 排除日照不足或潮湿谷底地块，允许应急灌溉。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 葡萄最高产量 10 t/ha。

body.en: Minimum natural potential alcohol: 11.5% for Taurasi and 12% for Riserva grapes.
body.zh: 葡萄最低自然潜在酒精度：Taurasi 11.5%，Riserva 12%。

body.en: Taurasi and Taurasi Riserva are dry red DOCG wines within the same protected denomination.
body.zh: Taurasi 与 Taurasi Riserva 均为同一保护名称下的干红 DOCG。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12% for Taurasi, 12.5% for Riserva; minimum total acidity 5 g/L for both.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 Taurasi 12%、Riserva 12.5%；两者总酸最低 5 g/L。

body.en: The vineyard name must be registered, with separate vinification and storage and matching records.
body.zh: 葡萄园名称须登记；酿造、储存及相关记录须分开。

body.en: At least three years, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 至少三年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: At least four years, including eighteen months in wood.
body.zh: 至少四年，其中十八个月木桶。

body.en: Mandatory ageing begins on 1 December of the harvest year.
body.zh: 法定熟成自采收年 12 月 1 日起算。

body.en: Maximum grape-to-wine conversion 70% at first racking and 65% after compulsory ageing.
body.zh: 首次倒罐最高出酒率 70%，法定熟成后 65%。

body.en: Mastroberardino uses 100% Aglianico from Montemarano and Mirabella Eclano; the producer reports 24 months wood and 24 months bottle ageing.
body.zh: Mastroberardino 采用 Montemarano、Mirabella Eclano 的 100% Aglianico；酒庄注明 24 个月木桶及 24 个月瓶陈。

body.en: Radici vineyards average about 450 m, spur-pruned cordon, around 4,000 vines/ha and 5 t/ha; harvest is late October to early November. These are producer choices.
body.zh: Radici 葡萄园平均约 450 米，短梢修剪单臂蔓，约 4,000 株/ha、5 t/ha，10 月下旬至 11 月初采收；均为酒庄实践。

body.en: A 16–18°C starting point suits mature reds; assess sediment and tannin before decanting. Roasted red meat, game and aged hard cheese are reference pairings.
body.zh: 成熟红酒可从 16–18°C 起侍，依据沉淀与单宁决定醒酒；烤红肉、野味、熟成硬奶酪可作配餐参照。

role.en: At least 85%; structure and late ripening define the appellation.
role.zh: 至少 85%，结构与晚熟为产区核心。

note.en: 100% Aglianico; producer-specific vineyard and ageing details.
note.zh: 100% Aglianico；葡萄园及熟成资料为酒庄特定实践。

intro.en: Teroldego denomination of the Campo Rotaliano north of Trento.
intro.zh: Trento 北侧 Campo Rotaliano 的 Teroldego 法定产区。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC; the grape is Teroldego and the origin is Rotaliano.
body.zh: DOC；Teroldego 为品种，Rotaliano 为产地。

body.en: Campo Rotaliano, north of Trento, near Mezzolombardo and Mezzocorona.
body.zh: Trento 北侧 Campo Rotaliano，近 Mezzolombardo、Mezzocorona。

body.en: Gravelly alluvial soils associated with the Noce river.
body.zh: 与 Noce 河相连的砾石冲积土。

body.en: The cited Nativi vineyard example is on the Rotaliana plain.
body.zh: 所引 Nativi 葡萄园参照位于 Rotaliana 平原。

body.en: Teroldego is distinct from Lagrein and Marzemino.
body.zh: Teroldego 不同于 Lagrein、Marzemino。

body.en: Cantina Sociale Trento’s Nativi is 100% Teroldego.
body.zh: Cantina Sociale Trento 的 Nativi 为 100% Teroldego。

body.en: Trentino pergola and Guyot are documented local systems.
body.zh: 本地有 Trentino pergola、Guyot 系统。

body.en: A geographical Teroldego designation, distinct from broader Trentino DOC.
body.zh: 有地理限定的 Teroldego 名称，区别于广域 Trentino DOC。

body.en: Skin fermentation gives a deeply coloured red.
body.zh: 带皮发酵形成深色红酒。

body.en: For Nativi: prolonged skin fermentation, malolactic fermentation, then several months in oak barrels of different sizes.
body.zh: Nativi：较长带皮发酵、苹果酸乳酸发酵，之后在不同容量橡木桶中熟成数月。

body.en: Nativi Teroldego Rotaliano DOC, Cantina Sociale Trento.
body.zh: Cantina Sociale Trento 的 Nativi Teroldego Rotaliano DOC。

body.en: Nativi: deep ruby, violet, roasted almond and liquorice; full-bodied and long.
body.zh: Nativi：深宝石红，紫罗兰、烤杏仁、甘草，酒体饱满、余味长。

body.en: The regional consortium suggests 16–18°C; producer advice may differ for an individual bottling.
body.zh: 大区协会建议 16–18°C，具体酒款酒庄建议可不同。

body.en: Trentino’s first varietal DOC, recognised in 1971.
body.zh: Trentino 首个单品种 DOC，1971 年获认可。

body.en: The consortium records Teroldego in Piana Rotaliana from the fourteenth century.
body.zh: 协会记录 Teroldego 在 Piana Rotaliana 可追溯至十四世纪。

role.en: Documented local grape or specified appellation component.
role.zh: 有记录的本地品种或法定产区组分。

note.en: 100% Teroldego; producer-specific site and cellar information.
note.zh: 100% Teroldego，酒庄特定地块及工艺资料。

intro.en: Interior Potenza valley DOC structured around Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, with a distinctive Malvasia contribution to rosé.
intro.zh: Potenza 内陆河谷 DOC，以 Merlot、Cabernet Sauvignon 为骨架，桃红特别要求 Malvasia 组成。

body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: DOC established in September 2003.
body.zh: 2003 年 9 月设 DOC。

body.en: Viggiano, Grumento Nova and Moliterno in Potenza province.
body.zh: Potenza 省 Viggiano、Grumento Nova、Moliterno。

body.en: Vineyards may be planted up to 800 m; the geographic link describes typical vineyards between 600 and 800 m.
body.zh: 葡萄园允许至 800 米；地理关联章节描述典型葡萄园在 600–800 米。

body.en: Interior valley conditions combine autumn/spring rain, dry summers and marked day–night temperature variation.
body.zh: 内陆河谷兼有秋春降雨、干燥夏季及明显昼夜温差。

body.en: The intermontane valley has Pleistocene lake deposits overlain by recent alluvium; silty-sandy and silty-clay textures with stony material recur.
body.zh: 山间谷地含更新世湖相沉积及较新冲积覆盖，常见含石的粉砂—砂质、粉砂—黏质土。

body.en: Merlot at least 50%, Cabernet Sauvignon at least 30%, eligible other red grapes up to 20%.
body.zh: Merlot 至少 50%，Cabernet Sauvignon 至少 30%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Merlot at least 50%, Cabernet Sauvignon at least 20%, Malvasia di Basilicata at least 10%; permitted complements up to 20%.
body.zh: Merlot 至少 50%，Cabernet Sauvignon 至少 20%，Malvasia di Basilicata 至少 10%；允许辅助最多 20%。

body.en: New/replanted vineyards require at least 3,000 vines/ha. Simple trellising is the reference; pergola and tendone are excluded from alternative approvals.
body.zh: 新植、重植至少 3,000 株/ha，以简单篱架为参照；其他架式审批排除 pergola、tendone。

body.en: Maximum 12 t/ha for all three types.
body.zh: 三个类型均最高 12 t/ha。

body.en: Rosso, Rosso Riserva and Rosato; this DOC is distinct from Aglianico del Vulture.
body.zh: Rosso、Rosso Riserva、Rosato；该 DOC 与 Aglianico del Vulture 不同。

body.en: Maximum wine conversion 70%, equivalent to 84 hl/ha at the yield limit.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 70%，产量上限下相当于 84 hl/ha。

body.en: At least twelve months from 1 November following the harvest.
body.zh: 自采收后 11 月 1 日起至少十二个月。

body.en: At least twenty-four months, including six months in wood, from 1 November following the harvest.
body.zh: 自采收后 11 月 1 日起至少二十四个月，其中六个月木桶。

body.en: Rosato is released after 1 March of the year following harvest.
body.zh: Rosato 于采收翌年 3 月 1 日之后上市。

body.en: The rosé contains a compulsory white-grape contribution; its recipe must not be copied from the red blend.
body.zh: 桃红含强制白葡萄组成，不可照搬红酒配比。

role.zh: 红桃红至少 50%。
红至少 30%，桃红至少 20%。

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.

intro.en: Tintilia-focused DOC across specified hills in both Molise provinces.
intro.zh: 以 Tintilia 为核心，跨 Molise 两省指定丘陵的 DOC。

body.en: Listed Campobasso and Isernia municipalities; minimum vineyard elevation 200 m.
body.zh: 指定 Campobasso、Isernia 市镇，园最低 200 米。

body.en: Calcareous hills, sandy-clayey coastal hills and piedmont alluvium.
body.zh: 石灰质丘陵、砂黏质海岸丘陵、山麓冲积物。

body.en: At least 95% Tintilia; eligible non-aromatic complements at most 5%.
body.zh: 至少 95% Tintilia，合资格非芳香辅助最多 5%。

body.en: Maximum 8 t/ha across the three types.
body.zh: 三类型均最高 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Rosso, Rosso Riserva and Rosato.
body.zh: Rosso、Rosso Riserva、Rosato。

body.en: Rosso/Rosato maximum 70%; Rosso Riserva 55%.
body.zh: Rosso／Rosato 最高 70%，Rosso Riserva 55%。

body.en: Minimum two years from 1 November of harvest year; the clause does not impose a wood minimum.
body.zh: 采收年 11 月 1 日起至少两年，该条不设木桶最低期。

body.en: Di Majo Norante’s bottle is 100% Tintilia, above the DOC minimum.
body.zh: Di Majo Norante 为 100% Tintilia，超过 DOC 最低值。

body.en: Acidity, phenolic grip and pepper/clove spice are useful references.
body.zh: 酸度、酚类收敛、胡椒丁香为参照。

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.

intro.en: Sangiovese-led inland hills and Cabernet-led coastal zones coexist with distinctive white grapes and a diverse local red patrimony.
intro.zh: 内陆 Sangiovese 丘陵与沿海 Cabernet 产区并存，另有独特白葡萄及丰富地方红葡萄。

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Administrative region; individual DOC/DOCG boundaries are separate.
body.zh: 行政大区；各 DOC／DOCG 边界另行划定。

body.en: Red, Riserva, Superiore and, under the 2026 amendment, Rosé.
body.zh: 红酒、Riserva、Superiore，以及2026修订下的 Rosé。

body.en: Chianti Classico is a separate DOCG, not a Chianti subzone.
body.zh: Chianti Classico 是独立 DOCG，并非 Chianti 子区。

body.en: DOC in 1983; red wines joined the rules in 1994.
body.zh: 1983年 DOC，1994年将红酒纳入。

body.en: Bolgheri Sassicaia has its own specification and boundary.
body.zh: Bolgheri Sassicaia 有独立规范及边界。

body.en: Recognised in March 1966.
body.zh: 1966年3月获得 DOC。

body.en: Recognised in 1993; consolidated rules amended in October 2024.
body.zh: 1993年获 DOCG，现行汇编含2024年10月修订。

body.en: Carmignano was among the territories delimited by Cosimo III’s wine decree.
body.zh: Carmignano 是 Cosimo III 葡萄酒法令划界地区之一。

body.en: The local Cabernet tradition predates the modern Super Tuscan movement.
body.zh: 当地 Cabernet 传统早于现代 Super Tuscan 潮流。

label.zh: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano — 范围

body.en: Montepulciano municipality, excluding the Valdichiana floor.
body.zh: Montepulciano 市镇，排除 Valdichiana 谷底。

label.zh: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano — 海拔

body.en: Eligible vineyards are between 250 and 600 m.
body.zh: 合资格葡萄园海拔250至600米。

body.en: Greve, Radda, Gaiole and Castellina are central municipalities.
body.zh: Greve、Radda、Gaiole、Castellina 是核心市镇。

body.en: Eleven: San Casciano, Greve, Montefioralle, Lamole, Panzano, Radda, Gaiole, Castellina, San Donato in Poggio, Vagliagli and Castelnuovo Berardenga.
body.zh: 11个：San Casciano、Greve、Montefioralle、Lamole、Panzano、Radda、Gaiole、Castellina、San Donato in Poggio、Vagliagli、Castelnuovo Berardenga。

body.en: Castagneto Carducci, Livorno province; between the Tyrrhenian Sea and inland hills.
body.zh: Livorno 省 Castagneto Carducci，位于第勒尼安海与内陆丘陵之间。

body.en: Mediterranean conditions moderated by sea influence and hill shelter.
body.zh: 地中海气候受海洋调节及丘陵屏障影响。

body.en: The delimited Montalcino area in Siena province, southern inland Tuscany.
body.zh: Siena 省 Montalcino 划定范围，位于托斯卡纳内陆南部。

body.en: A hill landscape with varied exposures; Monte Amiata influences protection from weather to the southeast.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向多样，东南方向 Monte Amiata 影响气候屏障。

label.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — 边界

body.en: Hill vineyards in San Gimignano municipality, Siena.
body.zh: Siena 省 San Gimignano 市镇丘陵葡萄园。

label.en: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — Soil and height
label.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — 土壤与高度

body.en: Pliocene yellow sands, sandy clays and mixed soils; eligible vineyards no higher than 500 m.
body.zh: 上新世黄砂、砂质黏土及混合土，合资格葡萄园不高于500米。

label.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — 产量

body.en: Maximum 9 t/ha; new plantings at least 4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 每公顷最多9吨；新种植每公顷至少4,000株。

label.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — 整形

body.en: Tendone training prohibited; emergency irrigation allowed.
body.zh: 禁止 tendone 棚架，允许救急灌溉。

body.en: At least 50%.
Cabernet Sauvignon and/or Cabernet Franc: 10–20%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 和／或 Cabernet Franc 为10–20%。

body.en: Canaiolo Nero at most 20%.
body.zh: Canaiolo Nero 最多20%。

body.en: Vermentino, Sauvignon and Viognier may each range from 0 to 100%; other authorised whites at most 40%.
body.zh: Vermentino、Sauvignon、Viognier 各可为0至100%；其他许可白葡萄最多40%。

body.en: Named Vermentino and Sauvignon require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: 标示 Vermentino 或 Sauvignon 的酒至少85%为所标葡萄。

body.en: The decree applies from the 2026/27 harvest campaign. The former 70% red minimum remains relevant to earlier bottles.
body.zh: 法令自2026/27收获季适用；旧有红酒70%最低比例仍与更早年份酒有关。

body.en: A specific provision allows qualifying 2025 wine to be reclassified as Rosé; it is not a general retroactive red-wine change.
body.zh: 专门条文允许合资格2025酒改列 Rosé，不代表红酒配方普遍追溯变更。

body.en: At least 80% Sangiovese; only red complementary grapes.
body.zh: 至少80% Sangiovese，仅允许红色辅助葡萄。

body.en: From vintage 2027, at least 90% Sangiovese, with the remaining maximum 10% from specified indigenous reds.
body.zh: 2027年份起，至少90% Sangiovese，其余最多10%来自规定本土红葡萄。

body.en: At least two years in oak.
body.zh: 至少2年橡木熟成。

body.en: At least four months in bottle; six for Riserva.
body.zh: 至少4个月瓶陈；Riserva 为6个月。

label.zh: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano — 基础

body.en: Two years from 1 January following harvest, using one of the specification’s wood/bottle combinations.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起2年，采用规范规定的木桶／瓶陈组合之一。

body.en: Three years, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: 3年，包括6个月瓶陈。

body.en: 36 months; first qualifying vintage 2021, first release 2025.
body.zh: 36个月；首个合资格年份2021，2025首次上市。

body.en: Massaretta in Massa-Carrara; high colour and phenolics, with particular powdery mildew sensitivity.
body.zh: Massa-Carrara 称 Massaretta，颜色及酚类高，尤其对白粉病敏感。

body.en: Barsaglina can complement Colli di Luni reds; its documented history reaches 1874.
body.zh: Barsaglina 可辅助 Colli di Luni 红酒，文献历史达1874年。

role.en: A deeply coloured red variety combining alcohol, acidity and fine tannin.
role.zh: 深色红葡萄，可兼具酒精度、酸度及细致单宁。

role.en: A deeply coloured, phenolic Tuscan red useful both alone and in Sangiovese blends.
role.zh: 深色、高酚托斯卡纳红葡萄，可单酿或与 Sangiovese 混酿。

role.en: A local red variety represented by Terenzuola’s Toscana IGT bottling.
role.zh: 地方红葡萄，Terenzuola 的 Toscana IGT 酒为实证。

role.en: Traditional blending grape providing freshness in local reds.
role.zh: 当地传统混酿葡萄，贡献清新度。

note.zh: 95% Vermentino Nero、5% Pollera，混凝土发酵及酒泥熟成。

body.zh: Adige／Etsch 河谷连接多个葡萄园地区。

body.en: Campo Rotaliano is the Teroldego reference north of Trento.
body.zh: Trento 北部 Campo Rotaliano 是 Teroldego 参照区域。

body.en: Elevation, exposure and valley airflow matter alongside latitude.
body.zh: 海拔、朝向及谷风与纬度同样重要。

body.en: Eisacktal and Vinschgau contrast with warmer Bolzano and southern sites.
body.zh: Eisacktal、Vinschgau 与更暖 Bolzano、南部地块对比。

body.en: Alluvial, glacial, limestone and volcanic materials create diverse sites.
body.zh: 冲积、冰川、石灰岩及火山材料形成多样地块。

body.en: Noce gravelly alluvium defines the Rotaliana reference site.
body.zh: Noce 砾石冲积物是 Rotaliana 核心地块特征。

body.en: Teroldego, Lagrein, Marzemino and the Schiava varieties require separate records.
body.zh: Teroldego、Lagrein、Marzemino 及各 Schiava 须分开。

body.en: Nosiola accompanies Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and alpine aromatic varieties.
body.zh: Nosiola 与 Chardonnay、Pinot Blanc 及高山芳香品种并存。

body.en: Pergola, Guyot and spur cordon are documented in Trentino sparkling vineyards.
body.zh: Trentino 起泡园有 pergola、Guyot、短梢水平蔓。

body.en: Rebo is a vinifera crossing of Merlot and Teroldego.
body.zh: Rebo 为 Merlot 与 Teroldego 欧亚种内杂交。

body.en: Trento DOC and Trentino DOC are separate denominations.
body.zh: Trento DOC 与 Trentino DOC 是不同产区。

body.en: Alto Adige’s additional geographical units define origin and grape choices.
body.zh: Alto Adige 附加地理单元限定产地及品种选择。

body.en: Trento minimums: non-vintage 15 months, vintage 24, riserva 36.
body.zh: Trento 最低：无年份 15 个月、年份 24、riserva 36。

body.en: Bottle fermentation and lees ageing define the traditional-method sparkling style.
body.zh: 瓶中二次发酵、酒泥陈年定义传统法起泡。

body.en: Moscato Rosa makes aromatic sweet reds from late-picked or dried grapes.
body.zh: Moscato Rosa 可用晚采或风干葡萄酿芳香甜红。

body.en: Cavit Schiava Gentile and Armani Foja Tonda show different red identities.
body.zh: Cavit Schiava Gentile、Armani Foja Tonda 展示不同红品种。

body.en: Cavit suggests 12–14°C for its light Schiava Gentile.
body.zh: Cavit 为轻盈 Schiava Gentile 建议 12–14°C。

body.en: Armani suggests 16–18°C for its structured Foja Tonda.
body.zh: Armani 为有结构 Foja Tonda 建议 16–18°C。

intro.en: Traditional-method sparkling denomination of Trentino; Trentodoc is its collective promotional identity.
intro.zh: Trentino 传统法起泡产区；Trentodoc 为其集体推广身份。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC for traditional-method sparkling wine.
body.zh: 传统法起泡酒 DOC。

body.en: Vineyards lie in the delimited Trento provincial territory.
body.zh: 葡萄园位于 Trento 省划定区域。

body.en: Mountain vineyards commonly lie around 200–800 metres; not a single fixed altitude.
body.zh: 山地葡萄园常约 200–800 米，并非单一固定海拔。

body.en: Day-night temperature differences help retain fresh aromatic and acid profiles.
body.zh: 昼夜温差帮助保留清新香气与酸度。

body.en: Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc.
body.zh: Chardonnay、Pinot Blanc。

body.en: Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier.
body.zh: Pinot Noir、Pinot Meunier。

body.en: Careful hand picking and small crates protect intact bunches.
body.zh: 细致手采、小筐保护果穗完整。

body.en: Pergola, Guyot and spur cordon are documented.
body.zh: 有 pergola、Guyot、短梢水平蔓。

body.en: Minimum fifteen months on lees.
body.zh: 酒泥时间至少十五个月。

body.en: Minimum twenty-four months on lees.
body.zh: 酒泥时间至少二十四个月。

body.en: Minimum thirty-six months on lees.
body.zh: 酒泥时间至少三十六个月。

body.en: Second fermentation takes place in bottle.
body.zh: 瓶中进行二次发酵。

body.en: Lees maturation is integral to the style.
body.zh: 酒泥熟成为核心工艺。

body.en: White and rosé sparkling expressions.
body.zh: 白色及桃红起泡风格。

body.en: Trento DOC sparkling is distinct from Trentino DOC still-wine identities.
body.zh: Trento DOC 起泡区别于 Trentino DOC 静止酒身份。

intro.en: Landlocked central Italy links Sagrantino’s tannic red wines, Sangiovese blends, late-ripening Trebbiano Spoletino and Orvieto’s white traditions.
intro.zh: 意大利中部内陆地区，连接 Sagrantino 高单宁红酒、Sangiovese 混酿、晚熟 Trebbiano Spoletino 及 Orvieto 白酒传统。

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Administrative region; individual DOC/DOCG boundaries are separate.
body.zh: 行政大区；各 DOC／DOCG 边界另行划定。

body.en: Rosso and Rosso Riserva.
body.zh: Rosso 与 Rosso Riserva。

body.en: Bianco and named Grechetto.
body.zh: Bianco 与品种型 Grechetto。

body.en: Trebbiano Spoletino, distinct from Trebbiano Toscano.
body.zh: Trebbiano Spoletino，不同于 Trebbiano Toscano。

body.en: Bianco; Trebbiano Spoletino, Superiore, Spumante and Passito.
body.zh: Bianco；Trebbiano Spoletino、Superiore、Spumante、Passito。

body.en: DOC in 1979, DOCG in 1992.
body.zh: 1979年 DOC，1992年 DOCG。

body.en: Dry Sagrantino is documented at the 1925 Umbrian wine exhibition, alongside sweeter versions.
body.zh: 1925年翁布里亚酒展已有干型 Sagrantino，与较甜版本并列。

body.en: Orvieto and surrounding municipalities in Terni province.
body.zh: Terni 省 Orvieto 及周边市镇。

body.en: Includes delimited land in Viterbo: Castiglione in Teverina, Civitella d’Agliano, Graffignano, Lubriano and Bagnoregio.
body.zh: 包括 Viterbo 的 Castiglione in Teverina、Civitella d’Agliano、Graffignano、Lubriano、Bagnoregio 划定土地。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Bevagna, Gualdo Cattaneo, Castel Ritaldi and Giano dell’Umbria.
body.zh: Montefalco 全境及 Bevagna、Gualdo Cattaneo、Castel Ritaldi、Giano dell’Umbria 部分地区。

body.en: All are in Perugia, central Umbria.
body.zh: 均在翁布里亚中部 Perugia 省。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Campello sul Clitunno, Castel Ritaldi, Foligno, Spoleto and Trevi.
body.zh: Montefalco 全境及 Campello sul Clitunno、Castel Ritaldi、Foligno、Spoleto、Trevi 部分地区。

body.en: Plains alternate with low hills, entirely in Perugia province.
body.zh: 平原与低丘交替，全部位于 Perugia 省。

body.en: Tree-trained old vines survive in the valley.
body.zh: 谷地仍有攀树老藤。

body.en: Cooler humid plains can ripen later than exposed slopes.
body.zh: 凉湿平原成熟可能晚于向阳坡地。

body.en: Trebbiano Toscano (Procanico) and Grechetto together at least 60%.
body.zh: Trebbiano Toscano（Procanico）与 Grechetto 合计至少60%。

body.en: Other authorised white varieties up to 40%.
body.zh: 其他许可白葡萄最多40%。

body.en: 10–25%; other authorised reds 0–30%.
Minimum 50% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少50% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: Minimum 85% Grechetto.
body.zh: 至少85% Grechetto。

body.en: Minimum 50% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少50% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: At least 85% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少85% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: 33 months from 1 December of the harvest year.
body.zh: 采收当年12月1日起33个月。

body.en: At least four further months in bottle: minimum total 37 months, not 33 including bottle.
body.zh: 其后至少另加4个月瓶陈，总计至少37个月，并非33个月内含瓶陈。

body.en: Secco, Abboccato, Amabile and Dolce are covered.
body.zh: 涵盖 Secco、Abboccato、Amabile、Dolce。

body.en: Vendemmia Tardiva is reserved to Superiore, including Classico Superiore.
body.zh: Vendemmia Tardiva 限 Superiore，包括 Classico Superiore。

body.en: Secco requires at least 12 months in oak, with no specified barrel size.
body.zh: Secco 至少12个月橡木熟成，未限定桶容量。

body.en: No identical mandatory oak period is imposed on Passito.
body.zh: Passito 不适用相同强制橡木期限。

body.en: The 2023 consolidated specification gives 80–180 g/L residual sugar and minimum 18% total alcohol.
body.zh: 2023汇编规范规定残糖80–180克／升、总酒精度至少18%。

body.en: High natural acidity supports sparkling base wines.
body.zh: 高天然酸度支持起泡基酒。

body.en: Slow ripening with acid retention permits concentration without losing all freshness.
body.zh: 缓慢成熟并保酸，使浓缩后仍可保持清新感。

body.en: At least three months in bottle are required.
body.zh: 要求至少3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Rare red recovered near Todi; national registration in 2011 followed identification of surviving old material.
body.zh: Todi 附近恢复的稀有红葡萄，发现存活老株后于2011年国家登记。

body.en: Bettalunga reports loose bunches, thick skins and early supple tannins from its restored plot.
body.zh: Bettalunga 在恢复地块记录疏松果串、厚皮及年轻柔顺单宁。

role.zh: 唯一品种。
Rosso 主体60–80%。
Bianco 至少50%。
品种型白酒至少85%。
Procanico，与 Grechetto 合计最低比例。

role.en: A conservation success now returning to varietal red production.
role.zh: 经保育后重新用于单品种红酒。
