intro.en: Alpine valley with distinct local grapes and a regional DOC containing geographical and varietal identities.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯谷地，拥有独特地方葡萄及包含地理、品种身份的大区 DOC。

body.en: The Dora Baltea forms the principal vineyard corridor.
body.zh: Dora Baltea 构成主要葡萄园轴线。

body.en: Prié Blanc defines the upper-valley white reference.
body.zh: Prié Blanc 定义上谷地白酒参考。

body.en: Prëmetta is Prié Rouge.
body.zh: Prëmetta 即 Prié Rouge。

body.en: The administrative region and the protected wine denomination are separate entity types.
body.zh: 行政大区与受保护葡萄酒名称属于不同实体类型。

body.en: The regional DOC was established in 1985.
body.zh: 大区 DOC 建立于 1985 年。

body.en: The Dora Baltea forms the principal vineyard corridor.
body.zh: Dora Baltea 构成主要葡萄园轴线。

body.en: Upper-valley cultivation near Morgex reaches roughly 1,200 metres.
body.zh: Morgex 附近上谷地栽培约可达 1,200 米。

body.en: The wine area follows the Dora Baltea basin to Pont-Saint-Martin, with France west and Switzerland north.
body.zh: 葡萄酒地区沿 Dora Baltea 流域至 Pont-Saint-Martin，西邻法国、北邻瑞士。

body.en: Warm, exposed sites help late Fumin reach maturity.
body.zh: 温暖向阳地块帮助晚熟 Fumin 成熟。

body.en: High mountains limit incoming moisture, leaving inner valleys drier; high-altitude zones are colder and wetter than the sheltered central valley.
body.zh: 高山限制外来湿气，使内谷较干；高海拔区比受屏障保护的中谷地更冷湿。

body.en: Low rainfall, ventilation and marked day–night temperature differences shape the vineyard environment.
body.zh: 少雨、通风及明显昼夜温差塑造葡萄园环境。

body.en: Prié Blanc defines the upper-valley white reference.
body.zh: Prié Blanc 定义上谷地白酒参考。

body.en: Prëmetta is Prié Rouge.
body.zh: Prëmetta 即 Prié Rouge。

body.en: Petit Rouge is central to Torrette.
body.zh: Petit Rouge 为 Torrette 核心葡萄。

body.en: Vien de Nus is a principal component.
body.zh: Vien de Nus 为主要组成。

body.en: Nus Malvoisie refers to Pinot Gris.
body.zh: Nus Malvoisie 指 Pinot Gris。

body.en: Picotendro is the local Nebbiolo name.
body.zh: Picotendro 为 Nebbiolo 地方名。

body.en: Fumin is a red grape.
body.zh: Fumin 为红葡萄。

body.en: Shared naming alone does not prove a Prié Blanc–Prié Rouge mutation relationship.
body.zh: 共同名称不能证明 Prié Blanc 与 Rouge 的突变关系。

body.en: Cornalin d’Aoste corresponds to Humagne Rouge.
body.zh: Cornalin d’Aoste 对应 Humagne Rouge。

body.en: Swiss Cornalin du Valais is distinct from Cornalin d’Aoste/Humagne Rouge.
body.zh: 瑞士 Cornalin du Valais 不同于 Cornalin d’Aoste／Humagne Rouge。

body.en: Low pergolas use the relatively protected near-ground environment in the upper valley.
body.zh: 低棚架利用上谷地相对受保护的近地环境。

body.en: Many upper-valley vineyards are own-rooted, but status must be checked by vineyard.
body.zh: 许多上谷地园为自根，但须按园核实。

body.en: Thin fragile Prëmetta skins increase the importance of disease and rot management.
body.zh: Prëmetta 薄而脆弱的皮使病害及腐烂管理重要。

body.en: Mayolet is relatively early ripening.
body.zh: Mayolet 相对早熟。

body.en: Fumin is late ripening.
body.zh: Fumin 晚熟。

body.en: Much vineyard area occupies the sunny Adret on the Dora Baltea’s orographic left.
body.zh: 许多葡萄园位于 Dora Baltea 地形左岸向阳 Adret。

body.en: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle, Enfer d’Arvier, Torrette, Nus, Chambave, Arnad-Montjovet and Donnas.
body.zh: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle、Enfer d’Arvier、Torrette、Nus、Chambave、Arnad-Montjovet、Donnas。

body.en: A Torrette tasting note describes a blend, not necessarily pure Petit Rouge.
body.zh: Torrette 品鉴描述混酿，不一定描述纯 Petit Rouge。

body.en: Petit Rouge accompanies Vien de Nus in Nus Rouge.
body.zh: Nus Rouge 中 Petit Rouge 与 Vien de Nus 配合。

body.en: Long wood ageing is a producer choice, not a requirement arising solely from the grape name.
body.zh: 较长木桶熟成是生产者选择，并非品种名本身要求。

body.en: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle includes still and sparkling references.
body.zh: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle 有静止及起泡参考。

body.en: La Vrille provides a 100% Vuillermin reference.
body.zh: La Vrille 提供 100% Vuillermin 参考。

body.en: Grosjean documents Fumin, Petit Rouge and Prëmetta separately.
body.zh: Grosjean 分别记录 Fumin、Petit Rouge、Prëmetta。

body.en: Di Barrò provides a varietal Mayolet reference.
body.zh: Di Barrò 提供单品种 Mayolet 参考。

body.en: Prëmetta can be pale coral yet have appreciable tannin.
body.zh: Prëmetta 可呈浅珊瑚色但有明显单宁。

body.en: The regional reference describes a dry fruity red, paired locally with meat and cheese.
body.zh: 大区参考为干型果味红酒，当地配肉类及奶酪。

body.en: Glaciers shaped the valley system; vineyard elevation, slope and deposits vary within the main corridor.
body.zh: 冰川塑造谷地体系，主要走廊内葡萄园海拔、坡地及沉积物各异。

body.en: Ripasso adds a regulated re-fermentation on dried-grape wine marc.

body.zh: 近亚平宁山地为泥灰岩黏土与石灰岩。

body.en: More mixed, sandy and sandstone-bearing soils; maritime breezes moderate exposed hills.
body.zh: 更接近混合、砂质及含砂岩土，海风调节开放丘陵。

body.en: Minimum 85%.
Other authorised white grapes up to 15%.
body.zh: 其他许可白葡萄最多15%。

body.zh: 年轻版本偏柑橘花香；较熟果实可有杏仁与茴香细节。

sources.title: IMT — Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC

intro.en: Inland Verdicchio from a north–south valley sheltered from Adriatic moderation by Monte San Vicino.
intro.zh: 内陆南北向谷地的 Verdicchio，Monte San Vicino 阻挡亚得里亚海调节。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Marche
body.zh: Marche

body.en: Documents record Verdicchio cultivation at Matelica in 1579.
body.zh: 文献记录1579年 Matelica 已栽培 Verdicchio。

body.en: Verdicchio di Matelica Riserva is a separate DOCG.
body.zh: Verdicchio di Matelica Riserva 为独立 DOCG。

body.en: The valley runs north–south, parallel to the Adriatic coast.
body.zh: 谷地南北走向，与亚得里亚海岸平行。

body.en: Includes parts of Matelica, Esanatoglia, Gagliole, Castelraimondo, Camerino, Pioraco, Cerreto d’Esi and Fabriano.
body.zh: 包括 Matelica、Esanatoglia、Gagliole、Castelraimondo、Camerino、Pioraco、Cerreto d’Esi、Fabriano 部分地区。

body.en: Apennines to the west, Monte San Vicino to the east.
body.zh: 西为亚平宁山，东为 Monte San Vicino。

body.en: Cold winters, hot summers and substantial day–night differences; ripening is slowed.
body.zh: 冬冷夏热、昼夜温差大，成熟进程较慢。

body.en: More silt and mixed texture toward Cerreto.
body.zh: Cerreto 方向较多粉砂与混合质地。

body.en: Marl-limestone around Matelica and whiter calcareous soils toward Castelraimondo.
body.zh: Matelica 周边泥灰岩石灰岩，往 Castelraimondo 更偏白色钙质土。

body.en: Minimum 85% Verdicchio, up to 15% authorised whites.
body.zh: 至少85% Verdicchio，其他许可白葡萄最多15%。

body.en: Firm acidity with citrus, white flowers and almond; strong capacity for bottle development in suitable wines.
body.zh: 酸度坚实、柑橘白花杏仁，合适酒款具瓶陈潜力。

body.zh: 至少 85% Pelaverga Piccolo。

body.zh: Pelaverga Grosso 为不同品种。

body.en: A lighter-coloured dry red with a notable peppery reference.
body.zh: 较浅色干红，胡椒感为重要参考。

role.en: Regional grape; see its specific PDO and cultivation record.
role.zh: 地区葡萄，具体 PDO 及栽培情况见关联档案。

intro.en: A northeastern Sardinian DOCG tied to granitic soils and Vermentino, with still and specialised wine categories.

body.zh: Vermentino di Gallura DOCG

body.en: Northeastern Sardegna.
body.zh: Sardegna 东北部。

body.zh: 与范围更广的 Vermentino di Sardegna DOC 分开。

body.zh: 葡萄园土壤须源于花岗岩分解。

body.zh: 粗砂质，夹不同比例细黏粒。

body.en: Eligible vineyards no higher than 500 m.
body.zh: 获准葡萄园不高于 500 米。

Up to 5% other suitable non-aromatic white varieties.
body.zh: 最多 5% 其他获准非芳香白葡萄。

body.en: Still, Superiore, Frizzante, Spumante, Passito and Vendemmia Tardiva.
body.zh: 静止、Superiore、微泡、起泡、风干及晚摘。

body.en: New/replanted vines at least 3,250/ha.
body.zh: 新植／重植至少 3,250 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 10 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 10 吨／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.zh: 静止 12%，Superiore 13%。

body.en: Dry whites have aromatic persistence and freshness; late harvest and passito are distinct categories.
body.zh: 干白香气持久、清新；晚摘与风干为不同酒型。

body.zh: Vernaccia di Oristano DOC

body.zh: 1971 年建立，为 Sardegna 首个 DOC。

body.en: Oristano and delimited surrounding communes.
body.zh: Oristano 及周边划定市镇。

body.en: Lower Tirso valley and Sinis.
body.zh: Tirso 下游谷地与 Sinis。

body.en: Contini’s source vineyards: alluvial, sandy and slightly clayey.
body.zh: Contini 原料园为冲积、砂质、略带黏土。

body.en: Mild winters, hot ventilated summers and limited rainfall.
body.zh: 冬季温和、夏季炎热通风、降雨有限。

body.en: Contini’s vineyards are only a few metres above sea level.
body.zh: Contini 实例葡萄园仅略高于海平面。

body.en: 100% Vernaccia.
body.zh: 100% Vernaccia。

body.en: Maximum 8 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 65%.
Two years in oak or chestnut.
body.zh: 橡木或栗木桶两年。

body.en: Superiore three years; Riserva four years.
body.zh: Superiore 三年；Riserva 四年。

body.en: Contini Flor spends about four years in partly filled oak/chestnut casks, allowing a yeast veil to develop.
body.zh: Contini Flor 在不装满的橡木／栗木桶中约四年，让酒花膜生长。

body.en: Standard minimum 15%; Superiore/Riserva 15.5%.
body.zh: 普通最低 15%，Superiore／Riserva 15.5%。

body.en: Mature gold/amber wine; almond-flower and complex oxidative/biological aromas in the producer example.
body.zh: 成熟金／琥珀色，生产者实例有杏仁花及复杂氧化／生物熟化香。

body.en: Contini recommends 8–10°C as an aperitif and 15°C with dessert; a producer recommendation, not a DOC rule.
body.zh: Contini 建议开胃酒 8–10°C、搭甜点 15°C；是酒庄建议而非法规。

role.zh: 100% Vernaccia。

note.en: Vernaccia di Oristano DOC, about four years under flor in partly filled oak/chestnut casks.
note.zh: Vernaccia di Oristano DOC，在不装满的橡木／栗木桶及酒花膜下约四年。

intro.en: Dry white from the San Gimignano hills, built on the local Vernaccia grape and Pliocene sediments.
intro.zh: San Gimignano 丘陵干白，以当地 Vernaccia 葡萄及上新世沉积土为基础。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Recognised in March 1966.
body.zh: 1966年3月获得 DOC。

body.en: Recognised in 1993; consolidated rules amended in October 2024.
body.zh: 1993年获 DOCG，现行汇编含2024年10月修订。

body.en: Hill vineyards in San Gimignano municipality, Siena.
body.zh: Siena 省 San Gimignano 市镇丘陵葡萄园。

body.en: Pliocene yellow sands, sandy clays and mixed soils; eligible vineyards no higher than 500 m.
body.zh: 上新世黄砂、砂质黏土及混合土，合资格葡萄园不高于500米。

body.en: At least 85% Vernaccia di San Gimignano.
body.zh: 至少85% Vernaccia di San Gimignano。

body.en: Sauvignon and Riesling together at most 10%; several aromatic varieties, including Incrocio Bruni 54, are excluded.
body.zh: Sauvignon 与 Riesling 合计最多10%；包括 Incrocio Bruni 54 的若干芳香品种禁止使用。

body.en: Maximum 9 t/ha; new plantings at least 4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 每公顷最多9吨；新种植每公顷至少4,000株。

body.en: Tendone training prohibited; emergency irrigation allowed.
body.zh: 禁止 tendone 棚架，允许救急灌溉。

body.en: Riserva: at least 11 months from 1 January after harvest, with at least three months in bottle before release.
body.zh: Riserva 采收后1月1日起至少11个月，上市前至少3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 11.5% for the standard wine, 12.5% for Riserva.
body.zh: 基础酒总酒精度至少11.5%，Riserva 至少12.5%。

role.zh: 有限辅助组分。

intro.zh: Somma–Vesuvius DOC，含 Lacryma Christi 风格及 2025 规范扩展的品种类别。

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.zh: Campania

body.zh: 1983 年 1 月 13 日批准 DOC。

body.en: Regulation EU 2025/1903 was published on 22 September 2025 and incorporated in the regional consolidated specification.
body.zh: 欧盟 2025/1903 法规于 2025 年 9 月 22 日公布，纳入大区汇总规范。

body.en: The entire communes of Boscotrecase, Trecase and San Sebastiano al Vesuvio, and delimited portions of surrounding Naples communes.
body.zh: 完整 Boscotrecase、Trecase、San Sebastiano al Vesuvio 及周边 Napoli 市镇划定部分。

body.en: Vineyards surround the Somma–Vesuvius complex, with altitude and exposure changing around its slopes.
body.zh: 葡萄园环绕 Somma–Vesuvius 山体，坡面海拔、朝向各异。

body.en: The specification identifies well-exposed sloping volcanic soils rich in potassium as suitable.
body.zh: 规范将朝向良好的坡地、富钾火山土列为适宜条件。

body.en: Caprettone and/or Coda di Volpe at least 45%; Falanghina and/or Greco up to 35%; other eligible whites up to 20%.
body.zh: Caprettone 和／或 Coda di Volpe 至少 45%；Falanghina 和／或 Greco 最多 35%；其他合资格白葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Piedirosso at least 50%; the legal text lists Sciascinoso Olivella and/or Aglianico up to 30%; other eligible red grapes up to 20%.
body.zh: Piedirosso 至少 50%；法规列 Sciascinoso Olivella 和／或 Aglianico 最多 30%；其他合资格红葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Caprettone, Falanghina, Piedirosso and Aglianico types each require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: Caprettone、Falanghina、Piedirosso、Aglianico 类型各须所标葡萄至少 85%。

body.en: Caprettone has its own register entry and must remain distinct from Coda di Volpe. Catalanesca cultivation on Monte Somma does not make it a named Vesuvio DOC type.
body.zh: Caprettone 有独立登记，不可与 Coda di Volpe 合并。Monte Somma 种植 Catalanesca 不代表其为 Vesuvio DOC 标示品种类型。

body.en: Basic wines and named varietal wines have a 10 t/ha maximum; Lacryma Christi white/red Superiore and red Riserva have 8.5 t/ha.
body.zh: 基础及标示品种酒最高 10 t/ha；Lacryma Christi 白红 Superiore、红 Riserva 为 8.5 t/ha。

body.en: An authorized designation within Vesuvio DOC, covering white, red, rosé and specified sparkling/concentrated categories; it is not a separate DOC.
body.zh: 为 Vesuvio DOC 内获准名称，涵盖白红桃红及指定起泡、浓缩类型，非独立 DOC。

body.en: Lacryma Christi includes white Superiore, Passito and Liquoroso in addition to its still and sparkling white categories.
body.zh: Lacryma Christi 除静止、起泡白外，还含白 Superiore、Passito、Liquoroso。

body.en: Traditional still wines, sparkling fermentation, grape drying and fortified Liquoroso require separate production and analytical specifications.
body.zh: 传统静止、起泡发酵、葡萄干化、加强 Liquoroso 适用各自生产及分析规范。

body.en: Compare like categories: a Lacryma Christi red Riserva, a dry white and a white Liquoroso have different structural and service needs.
body.zh: 应同类比较：Lacryma Christi 红 Riserva、干白、白 Liquoroso 的结构及侍酒需求不同。

role.zh: 基础红桃红至少 50%，标示类型至少 85%。

intro.en: Sangiovese-based red from the Tuscan town of Montepulciano; the town name is distinct from the Montepulciano grape.
intro.zh: 托斯卡纳 Montepulciano 城镇的 Sangiovese 主导红酒，地名不同于 Montepulciano 葡萄。

body.zh: 1966年获 DOC，1980年份起 DOCG。

body.zh: Prugnolo Gentile 是当地 Sangiovese 名称。

body.en: Montepulciano municipality, excluding the Valdichiana floor.
body.zh: Montepulciano 市镇，排除 Valdichiana 谷底。

body.zh: 合资格葡萄园海拔250至600米。

body.zh: 至少85% Sangiovese，可搭配 Canaiolo、Ciliegiolo、Mammolo、Colorino，Colorino 最多5%。

body.zh: Pieve 每公顷最多7吨，每株最多2.5公斤。

body.zh: 采收后1月1日起2年，采用规范规定的木桶／瓶陈组合之一。

body.zh: Pieve 后接12个附加地理单元之一。

body.zh: 酿造与强制熟成在 Montepulciano 市镇内完成。

note.zh: 南段东南朝向白色石灰质泥灰岩；可呈现清晰香气、紧实矿物口感与良好余味，不可视为 Villaine 同名酒。

note.en: Younger Chardonnay site on calcareous marl; do not claim old vines without evidence.
note.zh: 较年轻的 Chardonnay 葡萄藤，受石灰质泥灰岩及坡向影响；不可因一级园便宣称老藤。

note.en: Walled/near-village clay sector on a sunny east exposure; greater textural breadth depends on vintage.
note.zh: 靠村庄的围墙地块，朝东较温暖、土壤黏土比例高，结构可能较圆润仍须考虑收成年份。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Grésigny Vieilles Vignes

note.en: 1945 old-vine Grésigny selection; distinct producer identity from de Villaine Grésigny.
note.zh: 1945 年栽植的 Grésigny 老藤，官方技术单支持独立 Vieilles Vignes 酒款；注意 Villaine 也有同 climat 白酒，但不同生产者。

note.en: Multi-parcel Pinot Noir with ripe fruit and measured tannin; stem usage differs by vintage.
note.zh: 多园区 Pinot Noir，成熟红果、细致果皮单宁；历史工艺依采收年决定是否去梗。

note.en: Two En Guesnes parcels below Meix Cadot Premier Cru; clay-driven breadth and fine tannins.
note.zh: 两处 En Guesnes 地块在 Le Meix Cadot 下方；黏土较多，柔软果肉与细致单宁。

note.en: Distinct Pinot Noir bottling from the Maizières white; east-facing clay, mature fruit with supple structure.
note.zh: 同名 Maizières 红酒与白酒为独立酒款，同地点不同葡萄品种，需按色与 producer 区分。

note.en: Walled, east-facing clay Chapitre Pinot Noir from 1958 plantings, balanced ripe fruit and structured tannin.
note.zh: 靠近村庄的围墙 Chapitre Pinot Noir 一级园；黏土与日照塑造果味、细致单宁及较宽口感。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge La Fosse

note.en: South-facing, freely draining gravel over clay-limestone below Rabourcé; precise ripeness management is central.
note.zh: 南向、表层砾石的 La Fosse，排水较快，果实成熟度与结构在炎热年份特别值得研究。

note.en: Tiny 0.0871-ha old-vine parcel planted in 1936; 2022-format sheet lists 150cl only, not proof that all vintages/markets lack 75cl. The technical sheet lists a 150 cl format.
note.zh: 极小面积老藤红葡萄一级园，仅 0.0871 ha；官网 2022 技术单仅标 150 cl 格式，不能推断所有年份或所有市场只有镁瓶。 技术表所列规格为 150 cl。

note.en: The estate describes a fresh, crisp 2024 for youthful drinking. General estate service guidance is 12–14°C with fish, white meat or mild goat cheese.
note.zh: 酒庄对 2024 的描述强调清新、晶莹和脆爽果味，建议年轻时饮用。官网通用服务建议约 12–14°C，可配鱼、白肉或温和山羊奶酪。

note.en: Estate notes describe floral, peach, quince and fresh-almond aromas with richness and chalky tension.
note.zh: 酒庄描述白花、桃、榅桲与鲜杏仁，口感兼具丰富度和白垩感。

note.en: The estate describes peach and apricot, a full yet fine palate and potential beyond ten years.
note.zh: 酒庄描述桃、杏与核果感，口感饱满而细致，并指出超过十年的陈年潜力。

note.en: Estate notes combine lychee, kiwi, pear and spice with fresh acidity; youthful drinking and brief aeration are suggested.
note.zh: 酒庄描述荔枝、奇异果、梨与辛香，成熟果实和酸度并存；建议年轻饮用并略作提前开瓶。

note.en: The estate describes richness without opulence, almond notes, saline tension and a refreshing bitter finish.
note.zh: 酒庄描述较丰富但不过分丰腴，带鲜杏仁、咸鲜张力与清爽苦味收尾。

note.en: Estate notes emphasize floral fruit, mineral tension and balance between acidity, ripe fruit and salinity.
note.zh: 花果香明显，酒庄强调酸度、成熟果实与咸鲜感的平衡。

note.en: Estate notes describe aromatic richness, chalk, light toast and a dense finish with ageing potential.
note.zh: 酒庄描述芳香丰厚、白垩感与轻微烘烤气息，余味有密度并具陈年潜力。

note.en: The 2023 estate note emphasizes pure fruit, roundness, freshness and restrained power, developing spice with age.
note.zh: 2023 酒庄描述果味纯净、汁感圆润、兼具清新与力量；陈年可发展辛香。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Champs Cloux

note.en: Estate notes describe fruit-led freshness, an iodine-like nuance and polished tannins, with a suggested window of publication to three years later.
note.zh: 酒庄描述果味主导、带近似碘的气息、清新且单宁抛光；建议在发表报告时至其后三年内饮用。

note.en: The estate describes energy, persistence and slight opening reduction. This differs from the separate Cuvée Ronde combining Les Saint-Jacques and Les Clous Aimé.
note.zh: 酒庄描述鲜明酸度与持续感，开瓶可能略有还原。此款与将 Les Saint-Jacques、Les Clous Aimé 混合的另一款 Cuvée Ronde 不同。

note.en: The current sheet identifies three parcels; the older importer account named only two.
note.zh: 官方新技术单列三地块；此前进口商的两地块描述属于较早资料。

note.en: Preserved as the importer’s generic label. The current estate menu lists named village reds instead; there is insufficient evidence to merge this entry with La Barre or Les Chaponnières.
note.zh: 保留为进口商所列的独立名称。当前酒庄目录单列 La Barre、Les Chaponnières 及一级园红酒，没有单列此通称；尚无证据将它与某一单地块酒合并。

note.en: Village-level single-site Pinot Noir from a west-facing plateau; distinct from similarly named white wines.
note.zh: 西向高台的村庄级单地块 Pinot Noir；不与同名 Chardonnay 或其他生产者的 La Barre 合并。

note.en: The document identifies a village Rully; “1 er cru” in the PDF filename is not the wine classification.
note.zh: 技术单正文标为 Rully 村庄级；PDF文件名中的“1er cru”不作为分级依据。

note.en: Its documented 18-month élevage is longer than the 12 months specified for Margotés, Raclot and Vauvry.
note.zh: 该酒18个月熟成，比同庄 Margotés、Raclot 与 Vauvry 技术单所列12个月更长。

note.en: The estate gives 1999 as the planting year, correcting the older importer estimate of 2000.
note.zh: 栽植年以酒庄技术单1999为准；较早进口商资料曾写2000。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Pucelle

note.en: Importer style comparison: fuller and rounder. The current estate lists this wine; its individual sheet was not readable in this review, so no label-specific élevage duration is asserted.
note.zh: 进口商将其描述为同庄白酒中较圆润丰满的一款。官网确认该酒仍在系列中；本次未能读取其独立技术单，故不补造桶熟月份。

note.en: A spring emerges within the holding; the estate diverted its flow around the plot before returning it to its natural course.
note.zh: 地块中央有地下水泉出露；酒庄将泉水导向地块边缘后接回自然水道。

note.en: The estate menu uses Raclot and its sheet uses Raclots; these are retained as source spelling variants.
note.zh: 官网目录拼 Raclot，酒庄技术单标题拼 Raclots；保留为同一酒款的来源拼写。

note.en: The official three-stage planting history supersedes the older importer’s blanket 1967 estimate.
note.zh: 官方分三批栽植的资料取代此前“全部1967年”的进口商概述。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Cloux

note.en: Importer description: ample and harmonious. The retained 2022 profile’s 25% new oak and 12-month élevage apply only to that dated record.
note.zh: 进口商描述其酒体充实而协调。旧2022年份资料的25%新桶、12个月熟成仅限该年份，不延伸至当前年份。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Clos de la Renarde

note.en: Listed as a monopole by the estate; longer élevage and variable whole-cluster use distinguish its cellar treatment.
note.zh: 官网作为独占园列示。较长桶熟与可变整串处理是其区别于同庄其他红 Rully 的技术特点。

note.en: A small-volume négoce Premier Cru without a named climat; distinct from the five estate single-climat whites.
note.zh: 酒庄小规模 négoce 业务的一级园白酒，不指定单一 climat；与酒庄自有地块的五款一级园白酒分别建档。

note.en: Producer profile: white fruit and flowers, rounded texture with a fresh finish.
note.zh: 酒庄描述：白果、花香，质地圆润而收结清鲜。

note.en: Producer profile: white fruit and oak, with breadth; suggested development over 3–7 years depends on storage.
note.zh: 酒庄描述：白果与木质气息，酒体较丰满。建议3–7年内结合瓶况判断适饮期。

note.en: Producer profile: citrus, butter and vanilla, balancing acidity and body; suggested development 3–7 years, storage-dependent.
note.zh: 酒庄描述：柑橘、奶油和香草，酸度与酒体并存；建议3–7年内视瓶况饮用。

note.en: Producer profile: black fruit and spice, fresh and light; open young bottles about an hour before service.
note.zh: 酒庄描述：黑果与香料，风格轻盈清鲜；年轻时建议提前约1小时开瓶。

note.en: Previously blended or sold to merchants; the estate describes concentrated fruit and fine, silky tannins.
note.zh: 此前该地块用于调配或售予酒商。酒庄描述为果味集中、单宁细而柔滑。

note.en: Producer profile: red fruit, black cherry and crunchy tannins; open young bottles about an hour ahead.
note.zh: 酒庄描述：红果、黑樱桃与鲜脆单宁。年轻时建议提前约1小时开瓶。

note.en: Producer profile: black cherry, tobacco and pepper, silky tannins and length; suggested development 3–7 years, storage-dependent.
note.zh: 酒庄描述：黑樱桃、烟草与胡椒，单宁柔滑，余味较长；建议3–7年内视瓶况饮用。

note.en: Estate profile: floral and fruit notes, almond and a mineral accent. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 30 hl/ha; serve around 12°C; suggested cellaring 4–6 years.
note.zh: 酒庄描述以花香、果香、杏仁及轻微矿物感为主。2024：13.5% vol，产量 30 hl/ha；建议约 12°C，陈年参考 4–6 年。

note.en: Estate profile: peach and apricot with a rounded finish. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 40 hl/ha; around 12°C with fish or shellfish; suggested cellaring 5–10 years.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为桃、杏香气及较丰润的收尾。2024：13.5% vol，40 hl/ha；约 12°C，鱼类或贝类，陈年参考 5–10 年。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Les Cloux

note.en: Estate profile: fine texture, mineral notes and firm structure. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 40 hl/ha; around 12°C with Comté or goat cheese; suggested cellaring 5–10 years.
note.zh: 酒庄强调精细、矿物风格与口腔结构。2024：13.5% vol，40 hl/ha；约 12°C，可配 Comté 或山羊奶酪，陈年参考 5–10 年。

note.en: Estate profile: palate richness, strength and length. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 40 hl/ha; around 12°C with white meat or risotto; suggested cellaring 5–10 years.
note.zh: 酒庄风格描述以丰厚、力量与长度为重点。2024：13.5% vol，40 hl/ha；约 12°C，可配白肉或烩饭，陈年参考 5–10 年。

note.en: Unfined and unfiltered, so slight haze is possible. The estate recommends youthful drinking. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 45 hl/ha; around 12°C; suggested cellaring 2–4 years. The label does not establish zero measured total SO₂.
note.zh: 不澄清、不过滤，因此可呈轻微浑浊。酒庄强调鲜活及年轻饮用。2024：13.5% vol，45 hl/ha；约 12°C，陈年参考 2–4 年。酒名不代表实验室检测总 SO₂ 为零。

note.en: Estate profile: cherry, raspberry and a fine, juicy palate. 2024: 13% ABV; 40 hl/ha; serve at 16–18°C with grilled food; suggested cellaring 4–6 years.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为樱桃、覆盆子及细致多汁的口感。2024：13% vol，40 hl/ha；16–18°C，可配烧烤，陈年参考 4–6 年。

note.en: Estate profile: cherry and raspberry with silky texture and length. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 40 hl/ha; around 18°C with roast chicken or stir-fried vegetables; suggested cellaring 5–10 years.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为樱桃、覆盆子、丝滑质地与较长余味。2024：13.5% vol，40 hl/ha；约 18°C，可配烤鸡或蔬菜炒食，陈年参考 5–10 年。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Clos du Chapitre

note.en: Estate profile: fruit, elegance and structure for ageing. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 32 hl/ha; around 18°C with roast poultry or lightly cooked tuna; suggested cellaring 5–10 years.
note.zh: 酒庄强调果味、精细度与支撑陈年的结构。2024：13.5% vol，32 hl/ha；约 18°C，可配烤禽或半熟金枪鱼，陈年参考 5–10 年。

note.en: Producer description: pear, lemon, spice and a dried-fruit accent, with accessible, fruit-led texture.
note.zh: 生产者描述为梨、柠檬、香料及少量干果，果味清晰、口感易亲近。

note.en: Producer description: cherry, raspberry, redcurrant and concentrated yet fine tannins; suggested drinking at 4–10 years. This is cuvée-level guidance, not a vintage guarantee.
note.zh: 生产者描述为樱桃、覆盆子、红醋栗及细致而集中的单宁，建议 4–10 年饮用参考。此为酒款级描述，不是某一年份的评分或保证。

note.en: Producer description: taut, persistent and lemony, with acacia and flint associations; benefits from time to open and develop.
note.zh: 生产者强调紧致、长度、柠檬和矿物风格，并提到槐花、燧石；适合给予开瓶或瓶中发展时间。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Pucelle

note.en: Producer description: citrus, acacia and discreet toast, favouring subtlety and length; estate cellaring guidance is 5–7 years.
note.zh: 生产者描述以柑橘、槐花、轻微烘烤及细致长余味为主；酒庄给出的陈年参考为 5–7 年。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Les Cloux

note.en: Producer description: pear, peach and supple, generous texture; estate guidance suggests approaching the wine at about 3–5 years after harvest.
note.zh: 生产者描述为梨、桃与柔顺丰润的质地，建议采收后约 3–5 年饮用参考。

wines.name: Rully Blanc Clos de Remenot Monopole

note.en: Producer description: ripe fruit and concentration, combining richness with a fresh structural line; monopole ownership does not change its Village classification.
note.zh: 生产者强调成熟果香、浓度、丰满感与清新的结构并存；monopole 身份不改变其村庄级分级。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Champs Cloux

note.en: Producer description: flowers, blueberry, discreet oak and spice, with plump texture and fine tannins.
note.zh: 生产者描述为花香、蓝莓、少量木香与香料，质地饱满，单宁细致。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Pierres

note.en: Producer description: ripe red berries, rose, concentration and firm tannic structure; estate cellaring guidance is 5–10 years.
note.zh: 生产者描述为成熟红莓、玫瑰、浓度与较扎实的单宁结构；给出的陈年参考为 5–10 年。

note.en: The estate describes ripe white fruit, light toast, a rounded palate and a saline finish. This is the Chardonnay bottling; Chapitre Pinot Noir is a separate wine.
note.zh: 酒庄描述以成熟白色水果、轻微烤面包及圆润质感为主，收结带咸鲜感。这是 Chardonnay 白酒；同庄 Chapitre 红酒另有独立档案。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Fosse

note.en: The estate describes fresh fruit and a mineral register, a defined attack and balanced acidity and roundness, followed by a persistent finish.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为新鲜水果与矿物调性，入口清晰，酸度与圆润质感平衡，余味持久。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Les Cloux

note.en: Estate notes combine citrus and white fruit with buttery and toasted accents, a structured but rounded palate and a mineral finish. The estate labels this wine Les Cloux.
note.zh: 酒庄描述带柑橘、白色水果、黄油及烘烤香气，口感有结构和圆润度，收结呈矿物调性。酒标用 Les Cloux。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Pucelle

note.en: The estate describes white fruit and citrus, buttery and toasted nuances, clear structure, a rounded texture and a long finish.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为白色水果与柑橘、黄油及烤面包调性；结构清楚而质感圆润，余味较长。

note.en: The estate describes a rich white-fruit profile with spice, toast and mineral-saline accents. Its stated 16-month élevage is longer than the 12 months listed for most of the other estate Rully whites.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为较丰厚的白果、香料与烘烤调性，兼具矿物和咸鲜印象。该款熟成为16个月，长于同庄多数白酒网页所列12个月。

note.en: Pinot Noir red. The estate describes cherry, raspberry, spice, vanilla and a light pepper note, with a fine-textured palate and long fruity finish. It is distinct from Chapitre Blanc.
note.zh: Pinot Noir 红酒。酒庄描述以樱桃、覆盆子、香料、香草和轻微胡椒调性为主，风格细致、果味余韵较长。与 Chapitre 白酒分开记录。

note.en: Estate notes emphasize white flowers, hawthorn, lemon and tropical fruit, with fine aromas, energy and a crisp palate rather than weight.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为白花、山楂花、柠檬与热带水果，重在精细香气、活力和清脆口感，而非厚重力量。

note.en: Estate notes describe buttery and toasted aromas, a rich palate with freshness and a toasted finish. La Crée remains a Village wine, despite its position below La Pucelle.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为黄油、烘烤香气，口感丰厚但保留活力，收结带烤面包调性。La Crée 为 Village 酒，不能因邻近 La Pucelle 而标为 Premier Cru。

note.en: The estate describes white flowers, citrus, almond and light spice, with a fresh palate, lemon and tropical-fruit accents and a persistent finish.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为白花、柑橘、杏仁及轻微香料，口感鲜明，带柠檬与热带水果调性，余味持久。

note.en: Estate notes emphasize strawberry and raspberry, a smoky nuance and a delicate palate. The stated 15% new oak is lower than the 35% used for Chapitre Rouge.
note.zh: 酒庄描述以草莓、覆盆子等红果为主，兼具烟熏调性和细致口感；新桶比例15%，低于同庄红 Chapitre 的35%。

note.en: The estate describes strawberry, raspberry, smoky nuances and delicate fruit. This is Rully Pinot Noir; the estate also lists a separate Mercurey Les Villeranges white, so the appellation matters.
note.zh: 酒庄描述为草莓、覆盆子、烟熏和细致果味口感。本款是 Rully Pinot Noir；同庄另有 Mercurey Les Villeranges 白酒，名称相近但产区及品种不同。

note.en: The estate presents a fresh, fruit-led Chardonnay. Tank maturation distinguishes it from the two barrel-aged Premier Cru whites.
note.zh: 酒庄定位为清新、果味明确的 Chardonnay；罐熟风格与同庄桶熟的两款一级园形成对照。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Clos du Chaigne

note.en: The estate characterizes this Premier Cru white as powerful and generous. Clos du Chaigne and Clos Saint-Jacques are separate bottlings with different stated areas and vine ages.
note.zh: 酒庄定位为有力量、丰厚的白一级园。Clos du Chaigne 与 Clos Saint-Jacques 是分开标示的酒款，面积和藤龄也分别记录。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Clos Saint-Jacques

note.en: The estate presents a powerful yet elegant old-vine Premier Cru white. Premier Cru Clos Saint-Jacques must be distinguished from similarly named Village Les Saint-Jacques wines.
note.zh: 酒庄定位为兼具力量与优雅的老藤白一级园。Clos Saint-Jacques 的 Premier Cru 身份须与名称相近的 Village Les Saint-Jacques 区分。

note.en: The estate describes a fresh, crunchy Pinot Noir. Its tank ageing and extraction choices provide a useful comparison with the separate Cuvée Marey.
note.zh: 酒庄定位为清新、爽脆的 Pinot Noir；罐熟及不压帽的工艺说明是理解它与 Cuvée Marey 差异的依据。

wines.name: Rully Rouge Cuvée Marey du Clos de Bellecroix

note.en: The estate describes an intense, elegant Pinot Noir. Created by Jérôme and Elisabeth Noël-Bouton, Cuvée Marey is distinguished from tank-aged Clos de Bellecroix by its barrel élevage.
note.zh: 酒庄定位为浓郁而优雅的 Pinot Noir。Cuvée Marey 由 Jérôme 与 Elisabeth Noël-Bouton 开创；桶熟将其与罐熟 Clos de Bellecroix 区分。

note.en: Estate description: supple fruit, freshness and a persistent finish.
note.zh: 酒庄风格描述：果味柔和，保持鲜活感与延续性。

wines.name: Rully Blanc Clos du Moulin à Vent

note.en: Estate profile: ripe fruit, butter and waxy notes, with a broad yet sustained palate.

body.en: The vineyard has Roman and monastic roots. Saint-Bénigne, the Maison de Vergy and the Dukes of Bourgogne are part of its documented history.
body.zh: 葡萄种植历史与罗马时期及修道院发展相关；Saint-Bénigne 修道院、Maison de Vergy 与勃艮第公爵均见于产区历史。

body.en: AOC recognition came in 1939; the specification dates the first Premier Cru list to 1943. It records approximately 600 ha in 1895, contraction to about 90 ha after the Second World War, and subsequent recovery. These are historical figures.
body.zh: 1939 年获 AOC；规范记载首批 Premier Cru 名单形成于 1943 年。其历史叙述记载 1895 年约 600 ha、二战后约 90 ha，之后逐步恢复；这些均为历史面积。

body.en: Rully has also been an important sparkling-wine centre since the early nineteenth century. This history does not turn Rully AOP into a sparkling-wine appellation.
body.zh: 自 19 世纪初起，Rully 亦是重要的起泡酒生产中心；该历史不改变 Rully AOP 仅涵盖静态酒的规定。

body.en: At the northern end of the Côte Chalonnaise, south of the Côte de Beaune, the appellation spans Rully and Chagny in Saône-et-Loire. The Saône plain lies to the east.
body.zh: 位于 Côte Chalonnaise 北端、Côte de Beaune 以南，覆盖 Saône-et-Loire 省的 Rully 与 Chagny；Saône 平原位于其东侧。

body.en: The specification distinguishes vineyards at 220–300 m from surrounding hills at 250–400 m; the BIVB overview uses 230–300 m. East- and south-facing vineyards dominate, with local west-facing exceptions.
body.zh: 规范区分葡萄园海拔 220–300 m 与周边丘陵 250–400 m；BIVB 概览采用 230–300 m。葡萄园以东向、南向为主，局部亦有西向地块。

body.en: A climat is a delimited vineyard identity. An estate parcel is only part of that climat unless sole ownership is established; an estate area or vine age must not be applied to the whole climat.
body.zh: climat 是具明确界定的葡萄园身份；除有独占证据外，酒庄地块仅为其中一部分。酒庄持有面积或藤龄不能直接代表整个 climat。

body.en: Bourgogne combines oceanic, continental and southern influences. Rully’s specification describes a modified oceanic regime with continental and southern influences, rather than a purely continental climate.
body.zh: 勃艮第同时受海洋性、大陆性与南方气候影响；Rully 规范采用“变性海洋性气候，并受大陆性和南方影响”的描述，并非纯大陆性气候。

body.en: Sunny summers and favourable autumn conditions can assist ripening. Aspect, slope drainage and air movement modify humidity and ripening locally; regional climate averages are not measurements for each climat.
body.zh: 充足夏季日照与适宜秋季条件有利成熟。坡向、坡地排水与空气流动会改变局部湿度和成熟节奏；区域平均气候数据不能作为每个 climat 的实测值。

body.en: Spring frost, rain near harvest and fungal pressure require vintage-specific assessment. The frost-affected 2021 de Villaine Cuvée Ronde is a documented example of a multi-climat release, not a new Premier Cru site.
body.zh: 春霜、采收期降雨与真菌病害须逐年份判断。de Villaine 的 2021 Cuvée Ronde 是霜害年份多 climat 合酿实例，并非新增一级园。

body.en: Limestone and marl alternate, with predominantly Upper Jurassic calcareous formations and some Middle Jurassic marl in eastern relief. Eastward-dipping strata produce asymmetric ridges.
body.zh: 石灰岩与泥灰岩交替；以晚侏罗世钙质地层为主，东部部分低丘见中侏罗世泥灰岩。岩层向东倾斜，形成不对称山脊。

body.en: Shallower limestone-derived soils tend to be freer draining; marl-rich positions can have deeper soils and greater water reserves. These are regional tendencies, not identical conditions across an entire named climat.
body.zh: 石灰岩上的浅薄土层通常排水较快；泥灰岩较多的位置可形成较深土层与较强保水能力。这些是区域倾向，不代表每个同名 climat 内部条件完全一致。

body.en: The climat entries identify which observations concern a named producer’s parcel. Slope, soil depth, planted area and vine age retain that source’s scope and date.
body.zh: 各 climat 条目明确标注哪些描述仅适用于某生产者的地块；坡度、土层深度、栽植面积与藤龄保留原资料的适用范围及日期。

body.en: Chardonnay principal; Pinot Gris accessory.
body.zh: 主要品种 Chardonnay；辅助品种 Pinot Gris。

body.en: Pinot Noir principal; Chardonnay and Pinot Gris accessory.
body.zh: 主要品种 Pinot Noir；辅助品种 Chardonnay 与 Pinot Gris。

body.en: Accessories: ≤15% per parcel, interplanted only; mixed-planting grapes are vinified together.
body.zh: 辅助品种仅限混栽，每地块合计不超过 15%；混栽地块的葡萄须共同酿造。

body.en: Rully / Rully Premier Cru; 23 recognised Premier Cru climat names. A named climat and a commercial cuvée are different kinds of identity.
body.zh: Rully／Rully Premier Cru；23 个获承认的 Premier Cru climat。climat 名与商业 cuvée 名属于不同层次。

body.en: 21 climats are in Rully. Clos du Chaigne (à Jean de France) and Clos St Jacques are in Chagny.
body.zh: 21 个 climat 位于 Rully；Clos du Chaigne (à Jean de France) 与 Clos St Jacques 位于 Chagny。

body.en: Cloux and Champs Cloux are separate climats. Le Meix Cadot and Le Meix Caillet are separate. Village Les Saint-Jacques is not Premier Cru Clos St Jacques.
body.zh: Cloux 与 Champs Cloux 为不同 climat；Le Meix Cadot 与 Le Meix Caillet 亦不同。Village 级 Les Saint-Jacques 不是 Premier Cru Clos St Jacques。

body.en: Checked 29 October 2026: INAO cites decree 2011-1704; Légifrance marks it in force. The BIVB-linked specification supplies the baseline rules below; annual harvest authorisations remain vintage-specific.
body.zh: 2026 年 10 月 29 日核对：INAO 引用 2011-1704 号法令，Légifrance 标示其有效；以下为 BIVB 当前链接规范的基础规定，年度采收授权须按年份另核。

body.en: ≥8,000 vines/ha; rows ≤1.40 m; vines within rows ≥0.80 m.
body.zh: 至少 8,000 株/ha；行距不超过 1.40 m；同行株距至少 0.80 m。

body.en: Maximum fruitful buds: white 10/vine; red 8/vine. Authorised short-pruning and Guyot systems are specified.
body.zh: 白葡萄酒每株最多 10 个有效芽，红葡萄酒 8 个；规范列明许可短梢及 Guyot 修剪形式。

body.en: Irrigation prohibited. Base yield / ceiling (hl/ha): Village white 60/64, red 54/58; Premier Cru white 58/62, red 52/56.
body.zh: 禁止灌溉。基础产量／极限产量（hl/ha）：Village 白 60/64、红 54/58；Premier Cru 白 58/62、红 52/56。

body.en: Organic or biodynamic farming is producer-specific, not an automatic condition of the appellation. Certifications and current estate practice belong in producer records.
body.zh: 有机或生物动力栽培属于生产者实践，并非产区名称自动保证的条件；认证与现行操作应在酒庄档案中逐一说明。

body.en: Minimum grape sugar: 178/180 g/L; natural alcohol: 11/10.5% vol.
body.zh: 葡萄最低糖度 178／180 g/L；天然潜在酒精度最低 11／10.5% vol。

body.en: Minimum grape sugar: 187/189 g/L; natural alcohol: 11.5/11% vol.
body.zh: 葡萄最低糖度 187／189 g/L；天然潜在酒精度最低 11.5／11% vol。

body.en: These minima concern harvest maturity and natural alcohol, not the finished alcohol printed on every bottle.
body.zh: 这些最低值涉及采收成熟度与天然潜在酒精度，不等于每瓶成酒酒标必须显示的酒精度。

body.en: Direct pressing, barrel fermentation and lees ageing recur in white-wine dossiers. Red-wine examples use differing destemming, whole-cluster, extraction and oak regimes. Exact percentages and durations are wine- and vintage-specific.
body.zh: 白葡萄酒档案常见直接压榨、桶发酵与酒泥熟成；红葡萄酒的去梗、整串、萃取与木桶方案各异。比例和时长必须对应具体酒款及年份。

body.en: Wood pieces and continuous presses prohibited. Red malic acid ≤0.4 g/L at bottling. Fermentable sugars: red ≤2 g/L; white ≤3 g/L, or ≤4 with qualifying acidity.
body.zh: 禁用木片与连续式压榨机。红酒装瓶时苹果酸不超过 0.4 g/L；可发酵糖红酒不超过 2 g/L，白酒不超过 3 g/L，符合酸度条件时可至 4 g/L。

body.en: Minimum élevage to 1 April after harvest; consumer release from 15 April. No compulsory percentage of new oak.
body.zh: 至少熟成至采收翌年 4 月 1 日，面向消费者上市自 4 月 15 日起；无统一强制新桶比例。

body.en: Chardonnay-led dry whites range from citrus and white-fruit freshness to broader lees- and oak-shaped textures. With development, nut, quince or honey notes can appear; producer and vintage determine intensity.
body.zh: 以 Chardonnay 为主的干白可呈柑橘、白色水果与清新结构，也可因酒泥及木桶处理更为宽厚；陈年可发展坚果、榅桲或蜂蜜气息，强度因酒庄与年份而异。

body.en: Pinot Noir-led reds combine cherry and berry fruit with floral or spice tones. Tannin and weight vary materially; youth can show more firmness, while bottle age may soften texture.
body.zh: 以 Pinot Noir 为主的红酒常见樱桃、浆果、花香或香料；单宁及酒体有明显差异，年轻时可较紧实，瓶陈后质地可能更柔和。

body.en: Compare a Village and Premier Cru from the same producer and vintage, then the same climat across producers. This controls more variables than comparing classification alone.
body.zh: 先比较同酒庄、同年份的 Village 与 Premier Cru，再比较不同酒庄的同一 climat；这样比仅按等级比较更能控制变量。

body.en: BIVB guidance: whites 12–14°C; reds 14–16°C. Adjust for concentration, maturity and serving conditions.
body.zh: BIVB 建议白酒 12–14°C、红酒 14–16°C；按浓度、酒龄和实际服务条件调整。

body.en: Whites suit fish, shellfish, poultry with cream and Comté. Reds work with roast poultry, meat sauces or savoury offal preparations; match texture and tannin to the dish.
body.zh: 白酒可配鱼类、贝类、奶油禽肉与 Comté；红酒可配烤禽、肉酱或风味较浓的内脏料理，重点匹配质地与单宁。

body.en: Choose aeration and decanting after tasting the bottle. Avoid a universal ageing window or automatic decanting rule for the entire appellation.
body.zh: 先试饮，再决定醒酒或换瓶；不为整个产区套用统一适饮期或固定醒酒规则。

body.en: BIVB: white 248.34 ha (69.67 ha Premier Cru); red 118.10 ha (27.87 ha Premier Cru).
body.zh: BIVB：白葡萄酒 248.34 ha（其中 Premier Cru 69.67 ha）；红葡萄酒 118.10 ha（其中 Premier Cru 27.87 ha）。

body.en: White 9,772 hl (Premier Cru 2,796); red 4,783 hl (Premier Cru 1,097). These dated averages are not legal yield limits.
body.zh: 白葡萄酒 9,772 hl（Premier Cru 2,796）；红葡萄酒 4,783 hl（Premier Cru 1,097）。这些为有日期的平均产量，不是法定每公顷产量上限。

coverage.en: Appellation core, regulatory baseline and all 23 recognised Premier Cru identities reviewed on 29 October 2026. Parcel observations retain producer scope; figures carry their source dates. Annual authorisations and future vintages are separate updates.
coverage.zh: 产区主体、法规基础及全部 23 个获承认 Premier Cru 身份于 2026 年 10 月 29 日核对。地块观察保留生产者范围，数值保留资料日期；年度授权与未来年份属于后续独立更新。
